result.setting: Ten primary care practices in Sutton Coldfield (population 90,000)
result.standard: Quality and Outcomes Framework HbA1c targets

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Target-driven incentivised programme (Quality and Outcomes Framework).

cycle2.result: Small increase in median and mean HbA1c overall (other figures truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: Patients with poor control in 2000 had a decrease in HbA1c by 2008; the reverse was seen in those with good control.

result.setting: Paediatric emergency department, Adelaide and Meath Hospital incorporating the National Children's Hospital, Tallaght, Dublin
result.standard: 21 management standards derived from NICE 2004 and AAN 2003 guidelines

cycle1.result: No case fully compliant; median compliance score 15 (range 5-20).

result.intervention: Standards presented to stakeholders and a nurse-developed parental advice sheet introduced.
result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Royal Free Hospital, London
result.standard: National standard for acute upper GI bleeding management ('Scope for improvement' report)

cycle1.result: Inappropriate pre-endoscopy PPI 73.8%; post-OGD PPI 66%; discharge of patients with full Rockall 2 or less 40%.

result.intervention: Local guidelines, presentations and an electronic 'Action Set' in the Cerner Millennium record system.

cycle2.result: Pre-OGD Rockall documentation increased significantly (p 0.0001 or less); post-OGD full Rockall improved (p = 0.007); inappropriate pre-endoscopy PPI 33% (p = 0.02); post-OGD PPI 50% (p = 0.01); low-risk discharge 100% (p = 0.43).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: ENT departments in England and Wales (national questionnaire)
result.standard: Department of Health and Royal Colleges of Surgeons and Anaesthetists recommendations for paediatric surgical services

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: 56% response from 164 departments; children's ward facilities remained high; more staff qualified in paediatric life support; anaesthetic supervision and post-operative management improved.

result.other_findings: Acute pain service provision remained relatively low; variability by hospital size.

result.setting: Acute medical admissions, St James' Hospital, Dublin

cycle1.result: 104 of 265 (39%) at-risk patients prescribed appropriate thromboprophylaxis.

result.intervention: Hospital-wide educational initiatives and a new drug prescription chart.

cycle2.result: 108 of 188 (57%) at-risk patients prescribed appropriate thromboprophylaxis.

result.other_findings: Over 40% of at-risk patients still did not receive thromboprophylaxis.

result.setting: Tertiary ENT referral hospital, Guy's Hospital, London
result.standard: Recently published standard of best practice for epistaxis

cycle1.result: 8% had suitable nasal examination in ED before transfer; no documented nasal cautery attempts; surgery in 40% of eligible patients.

result.intervention: Epistaxis education sessions introducing a best-practice algorithm with emphasis on ED care.

cycle2.result: Continued improvement in initial evaluation and management (figures not given).

result.other_findings: An intermediate audit of 50 patients was done in 2010.

result.setting: Regional level hospital, KwaZulu-Natal
result.standard: 16 indicators based on national HIV and TB guidelines

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Revised case note proforma with training.

cycle2.result: Overall improvement in documentation; largest gains in maternal HIV status, child HIV status and child TB risk assessment (all P < 0.001).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Ophthalmology departments (Moorfields Eye Hospital, Bradford Royal Infirmary, University Hospitals Coventry and Warwickshire)

cycle1.result: Prescription errors 4.7% (29/623).

result.other_findings: Most errors occurred at the prescription-writing stage.

result.setting: Fixed prosthodontic laboratory, Dundee Dental Hospital
result.standard: UK General Dental Council, EU Medical Devices Directive and British Society for Restorative Dentistry guidance

cycle1.result: 28% of prescriptions satisfactorily completed.

result.intervention: Educational reminders on laboratory prescriptions for undergraduates and staff.
result.other_findings: Standard remained poor overall; further training planned.

result.setting: Queen's Medical Centre, Nottingham (otolaryngology and neuroradiology)
result.standard: Proforma based on national guidelines for temporal bone CT requests

cycle1.result: 52% of reports were clinically relevant.

result.intervention: New guidelines and training were implemented.

cycle2.result: 94% of reports were clinically relevant (p value truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: Aimed also to minimise inappropriate requests and unnecessary irradiation.

result.setting: Role 3 Hospital, Camp Bastion (military field hospital)
result.standard: Clinical Guidelines for Operations on LMWH and graduated elasticated compression stocking prescription

cycle1.result: VTE risk assessment performed in 111/301 (36.9%).

result.intervention: Multifaceted programme: physician and nurse education, pre-printed LMWH/GECS prescriptions and risk assessment stickers in the medication chart.
result.other_findings: Prophylaxis rates also improved significantly per the conclusions; exact figures truncated in abstract.

result.setting: Royal Free London Hospital radiology department
result.standard: Guidelines recommending testing of adrenal incidentalomas to exclude functioning lesions and malignancy

cycle1.result: 17 (2.46%) patients with adrenal incidentalomas; 1.01% newly identified. Few tested to exclude a functional lesion.

result.intervention: Decision pathway for adrenal lesions introduced in the radiology department.

cycle2.result: 26 (2.01%) patients with adrenal incidentalomas; 0.95% newly identified. Few tested to exclude a functional lesion.

result.other_findings: Inconsistent terminology in reporting adrenal lesions persisted.

result.setting: Acute hospitals, national house-staff audit of acute medical admissions
result.standard: ACCP guidelines for thromboprophylaxis in at-risk medical patients; aim to double the prophylaxis rate

cycle1.result: 549 (84%) at risk; 163 (29.7%) of at-risk patients received LMWH; mechanical prophylaxis in 75 (13.6%).

result.intervention: Stickers placed in patient charts to alert physicians about thromboprophylaxis.

cycle2.result: 487 (93%) at risk; 132 (27.1%) of at-risk patients received LMWH; mechanical prophylaxis in 86 (17.7%).

result.other_findings: Stickers produced no significant increase in treatment; authors say more complex interventions are needed.

result.setting: District general hospital (Calderdale Royal Hospital) ward computers
result.standard: Confidential data protection regulations (no unprotected confidential information on desktop)

cycle1.result: 55% of ward computers had accessible unprotected confidential information on the desktop.

result.intervention: Mandatory online learning module on data protection and confidentiality for clinical staff.

cycle2.result: 26% of computers had unprotected confidential information.

result.other_findings: 85% of computers were logged in under a generic username and password; authors propose a systemic approach.

result.topic: Radiotherapy for metastatic spinal cord compression
result.setting: UK cancer centres (Royal College of Radiologists national audit)
result.standard: National standards for metastatic spinal cord compression management

cycle1.result: 93% (358) had MRI within 24 h of referral; 111 (32%) good prognosis patients discussed with spinal surgeons, 10 proceeded to surgery; 69% of paraplegic patients received multiple fractions.

cycle2.result: 205 (97%) had MRI within 24 h; 94 (41%) good prognosis patients discussed with surgeons, 9 proceeded to surgery; 62% of paraplegic patients received more than a single fraction.

result.other_findings: An MSCC co-ordinator was available in 164/323 cases and involved in management in 26% in 2012. Centres: 42 (74%) in 2008, 52 (90%) in 2012.

result.setting: ECT services, Sussex Partnership NHS Foundation Trust, West Sussex
result.standard: Current guidance or consensus on continuation pharmacotherapy after successful ECT

cycle1.result: Relapse within 6 months: antidepressant plus lithium 16%, antipsychotic plus antidepressant 75%, antidepressant plus other mood stabiliser 69%, antidepressant alone 60% (102 courses across both audits).

cycle2.result: Clinicians did not change prescribing practice; no increase in lithium use.

result.other_findings: 102 full ECT courses in total across both audits.

result.topic: Two-week wait head and neck cancer referrals
result.setting: Wirral University Hospital NHS Trust, Arrowe Park Hospital (district general hospital)
result.standard: Two-week rule referral pathway for suspected head and neck cancer

cycle1.result: Cancer pick-up rate 9%.

result.other_findings: Annual referrals rose by over 450% in 10 years while pick-up fell by nearly 50%.

result.setting: Department of Medicine for the Elderly, Aberdeen Royal Infirmary
result.standard: Reduction of anticholinergic drug exposure (Anticholinergic Risk Scale score) at consultant review

cycle1.result: ARS 0 in 51 (73%) after consultant review vs 47 (67%) on admission; ARS 2 or less in 67 (96%) vs 63 (90%); anticholinergics stopped or reduced in 35%.

result.intervention: System of informing the responsible consultant of the ARS score at first review.

cycle2.result: ARS 0 in 59 (84%) after review vs 48 (69%) on admission; ARS 2 or less in 70 (100%) vs 69 (99%); anticholinergics stopped or reduced in 73% (OR 5.0, 95% CI 1.4-17.8).

result.other_findings: Anticholinergic drugs were prescribed preadmission to 45/140 (32%) patients.

result.setting: Children's epilepsy services, UK
result.standard: National clinical guidelines and quality standards for children's epilepsy care

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Narrative review of guidelines, training, national audit and networks in UK children's epilepsy care.

result.setting: 30 hospitals in 14 NHS boards (national trainee-led audit, Scottish Surgical Research Group)
result.standard: British Hernia Society Guidelines (2013) for bilateral and recurrent inguinal hernias

cycle1.result: Elective primary bilateral repairs laparoscopic in 97%; guideline compliance for elective recurrence 77%.

result.other_findings: Laparoscopic repair 33%; laparoscopic use for primary unilateral hernias varied by region (South East 43%, North 14%, East 7%, West 6%). Prophylactic antibiotics given in 18%.

result.topic: Energy use in the radiology department
result.setting: Department of Radiology, St Vincent's University Hospital, Dublin

cycle1.result: 29 of 43 desktop computers and 25 of 27 PACS stations left on needlessly overnight and/or at weekends; approximately $7253 per year running costs.

result.intervention: Staff encouraged to turn off computers when not in use.
result.other_findings: None of the PACS stations supported sleep or hibernate modes.

result.setting: Acute Medical Department, Solihull Hospital (urban district general hospital)
result.standard: Appropriate indications for lumbar puncture (red flags)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Discussion of findings and LP indications with the Acute Medicine Department.

cycle2.result: Total LPs fell by 65%; proportion on patients with red flags rose by 19% (p=0.0098); proportion with positive findings rose by 33%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Preoperative assessment for lung cancer surgery
result.setting: Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery, Heart and Lung Centre, Wolverhampton
result.standard: British Thoracic Society and NICE guidelines for lung cancer management

cycle1.result: Deficiencies in practice.

cycle2.result: Improvement: more patients had surgery within 4 weeks of CT and PET; improved carbon monoxide transfer factor measurement.

result.other_findings: Still needed: transfer factor in all patients, cardiology referral for at-risk patients and use of Thoracoscore. 68 had surgery, 4 excluded.

result.setting: Guy's and St Thomas' Hospital, Department of Ageing and Health
result.standard: Local hospital delirium guideline (use of Confusion Assessment Method)

cycle1.result: 24% of doctors recognised CAM as the diagnostic tool.

result.intervention: Guideline adapted into pocket cards and posters, teaching sessions, screen savers and delirium promotion days.

cycle2.result: 71% recognised CAM as the diagnostic tool.

result.other_findings: 100 questionnaires and 25 clinical notes in total; CAM use and knowledge of pharmacological management improved.

result.topic: HIV post-exposure prophylaxis after sexual exposure
result.setting: Sexual health clinics in the Thames Valley (regional audit)
result.standard: 2011 UK guidelines on post-exposure prophylaxis for HIV following sexual exposure

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: Significant improvements in clinician-led outcomes; no impact on completion or follow-up rates.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Recording of occupation in GP records
result.setting: Two Cornish general practices (plus a third practice at re-audit)
result.standard: Recording of occupation in working age patients' records

cycle1.result: 17% of records had occupation recorded.

result.intervention: Introduction of the electronic fit note.
result.other_findings: Recording remained infrequent and inconsistent; very low levels in a third practice not previously audited. 300 records checked manually in Practice A; 202 GPs surveyed.

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, Countess of Chester Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: Royal College of Surgeons of England (2007) minimum data-set for safe handover

cycle1.result: Name and responsible consultant recorded in all cases; age recorded in 52%.

result.intervention: New detailed electronic handover proforma and training.

cycle2.result: Age recorded in 85%; significant improvement in completeness of handover information.

result.other_findings: Room for improvement remained; authors recommend focused tuition for trainees.

result.setting: Department of Paediatrics, Sandwell and West Birmingham NHS Trust (post-take ward rounds)
result.standard: Documentation of nine aspects of the post-take ward round (acrostic items)

cycle1.result: Problem 84%, investigations 26%, fluids 16%, drugs 26%, patient/parental concerns 16%, nursing concerns 4%.

result.intervention: Acrostic mnemonic introduced at a teaching session and in mandatory induction for new doctors.

cycle2.result: Problem 94%, investigations 72%, fluids 74%, drugs 76%, patient/parental concerns 72%, nursing concerns 48%.

result.other_findings: Re-audit 2 years later also performed; 95% (19/20) of junior doctors found the acrostic easy to use.

result.setting: Oral surgery acute dental department, Guy's Hospital, London
result.standard: FGDP(UK) and Scottish Dental Clinical Effectiveness guidelines on antimicrobial prescribing; target 100% compliance

cycle1.result: 30% of prescriptions appropriate; 62% of practitioners recorded a diagnosis.

result.intervention: Two-month intervention of extensive training and education of staff and students.

cycle2.result: 80% of prescriptions appropriate; 100% recorded a diagnosis.

result.other_findings: Most inappropriate prescriptions in both cycles were for acute pulpitis without systemic involvement.

result.setting: Department of Surgery, Tallaght Hospital, Dublin (tertiary referral centre)

cycle1.result: Mean 294 patients per month; baseline weekend discharges, length of stay and emergency response team calls measured.

result.intervention: Standardised weekend handover using an electronic tool supplemented by verbal handover.

cycle2.result: 40% increase in weekend discharges, consistent at subsequent time-points.

result.other_findings: Data collected at three time-points over 6 months.

result.setting: Twelve acute paediatric departments across Wales
result.standard: SIGN bronchiolitis guidelines and local hospital guidelines

cycle1.result: Compliance: investigations 50% (46% to 53%), management 65% (61% to 68%), overall 38% (37% to 39%).

result.intervention: Nationwide multifaceted education bundle after dissemination of first audit results.

cycle2.result: Compliance: investigations 71% (68% to 74%), management 74% (71% to 77%), overall 59% (56% to 62%).

result.other_findings: 1599 infants in total; severity was equivalent in both years.

result.setting: Otolaryngology departments in London (West Middlesex University Hospital, St Mary's Hospital)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: No abstract; described as a repeat audit.

result.setting: Gastrointestinal surgery, West Midlands hospitals (University Hospital Birmingham)

cycle1.result: 31% of procedures followed the protocol; 73% of clean procedures received prophylaxis inappropriately.

cycle2.result: 73% followed the protocol; inappropriate prophylaxis in clean procedures fell to 20%.

result.other_findings: Questionnaire of 55 surgeons and anaesthetists showed a general lack of awareness of the protocol.

result.setting: Secure inpatient service, St Andrew's Healthcare, Northampton
result.standard: October 2013 Tribunals Judiciary practice direction (24 key items)

cycle1.result: Average 36.3% of key items present; mean length 2.9 pages.

result.intervention: New practice direction and a local report-writing template.

cycle2.result: Average 51.3% of key items present; mean length 4.0 pages.

result.other_findings: Only 27.5% of reports used the template; few were signed or explained why detention should continue.

result.setting: Three paediatric dental departments in the North of England (Sheffield, Liverpool, Manchester)

cycle1.result: 28% of prescriptions appropriate.

result.intervention: Education and provision of an aide-memoire.

cycle2.result: 71% of prescriptions appropriate in the third cycle.

result.other_findings: Three cycles in total; deficiencies found in all three centres.

result.setting: A&E department, Newham University Hospital, London
result.standard: Sickle Cell Society guidelines on vaccination

cycle1.result: 2 fully up to date; influenza 24 (30%); pneumococcal 33 (41%); MenC, HiB and HBV under 31%.

result.intervention: New database of vaccination history, raising GP awareness and patient education seminars.

cycle2.result: 7 fully up to date; influenza 43 (50%, P=0.0062); pneumococcal 38 (44%, P=0.7874); MenC, HiB and HBV under 31%.

result.other_findings: Significant improvement for all vaccinations except pneumococcal and HBV; record keeping was poor.

result.topic: Pregnancy status documentation in emergency admissions
result.setting: Emergency general surgery admissions (NHS Lothian, Tayside, Borders)
result.standard: Documented pregnancy status within 24 h of admission and before any surgical intervention

cycle1.result: 30 (30%) documented pregnancy status; gynaecological history 32%, contraception 25%, LMP 29%; 6/24 (25%) surgical patients had status before surgery.

result.intervention: Prompt added to the medical clerk-in document.
result.other_findings: Authors call for a national guideline on pregnancy status documentation.

result.topic: Routine HIV testing in acute admissions
result.setting: Acute Medical Unit, Croydon University Hospital, London
result.standard: British HIV Association recommendations for routine HIV screening in high prevalence areas

cycle1.result: Very high levels of late HIV diagnosis.

result.intervention: Routine HIV screening introduced in the Acute Medical Unit.

cycle2.result: Patients identified by screening were significantly less likely to be diagnosed late, had fewer AIDS-defining illnesses and shorter admissions.

result.other_findings: Screening identified patients outside traditional high-risk groups and those who had defaulted care.

result.setting: Outpatient psychiatry, general hospital, Penang

cycle1.result: Sub-optimal frequency of metabolic parameter recording.

result.intervention: New local monitoring protocol with staff briefing; later modification, clearer staff roles and standard recording template.
result.other_findings: Focus group found positive views but barriers, including cultural issues with waist circumference measurement.

result.setting: Two general practice surgeries, West Yorkshire
result.standard: NICE guidelines on psychological therapy for depression (IAPT)

cycle1.result: Variable concordance.

result.intervention: Discussion at local audit meeting and display of posters and leaflets on IAPT.
result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: South Essex University Foundation NHS Trust, Basildon (psychiatry)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Results presented with recommendations and a suggested discharge summary format.
result.other_findings: More items were added in the second cycle.

result.setting: The Coppice, learning disability psychiatric inpatient unit, Bedfordshire
result.standard: GMC Good Medical Practice (2013), RCPsych Good Psychiatric Practice (2009) and Records Management Policy

cycle1.result: Good practice maintained for most parameters; mild inaccuracies in date of birth/ward name, timing and signatures.

result.other_findings: Re-audit recommended within a year.

result.setting: Wood Lea clinic, inpatient low secure learning disability unit, Bedfordshire
result.standard: Local trust policy on PRN prescribing

cycle1.result: Most standards met; NHS number recorded in 100% but patient name and ward fell short.

result.other_findings: Re-audit recommended within a year.

result.setting: Acute medical take, Northwick Park Hospital, Harrow
result.standard: Contemporary SBP guidelines and Trust SBP guidelines

cycle1.result: Lack of awareness of SBP management among trainees.

result.intervention: Electronic requesting system updated with prompts and links to Trust SBP guidelines, one-hour lecture and educational booklet.

cycle2.result: Significant improvement in understanding of when to investigate (p<=0.001), samples (p = 0.002), containers (p<=0.001), urgency (p<=0.001) and starting treatment (p = 0.007); more ascitic samples sent.

result.other_findings: Specific suspicion of SBP was more readily documented on requests.

result.topic: Acute kidney injury recognition and management
result.setting: Large central London NHS hospital (Guy's and St Thomas'), all adult inpatients
result.standard: Standards suggested by the NCEPOD 2009 AKI report

cycle1.result: All audit measures met in 3.7% of patient-days; poor recognition and management of AKI.

result.intervention: AKI care bundle deployed hospital-wide with enhanced education.

cycle2.result: All audit measures met in 8.4% of patient-days; AKI recognition, fluid assessment and stopping nephrotoxic drugs significantly improved.

result.other_findings: No significant improvement in fluid administration for hypovolaemia or contrast nephropathy prevention.

result.setting: UK paediatric nephrology centres (British Association for Paediatric Nephrology national audit)

cycle1.result: Day-case procedures 32.9%; major complications 10.4%; information leaflets 45.5%; play preparation 9.1%.

result.intervention: Introduction of national biopsy standards and paediatric nephrology networks.

cycle2.result: Day-case procedures 49.5% (P = 0.17); major complications 4.5% (P = 0.002); leaflets 63.6% (P = 0.39); play preparation 90.9% (P = 0.0001).

result.other_findings: 18-gauge needles had more passes (3.2 vs 2.3) and more major complications (15.3% vs 3.3%) than 16-gauge.

result.setting: Emergency Department, Royal North Shore Hospital, Sydney

cycle1.result: First pass success 83.4% (previously published data).

result.intervention: Bundle of changes covering staff training, equipment and practice standardisation.
result.other_findings: Authors report improved safety; complication figures truncated in abstract.

result.setting: Walmley Dental Practice, Birmingham (general dental practice)

cycle1.result: Dietary advice was not being given for periodontal prevention.

result.intervention: Staff meeting to raise awareness of the link between diet and periodontal disease.

cycle2.result: Standard not met but significant improvement in delivery of dietary advice.

result.other_findings: Barriers included lack of knowledge and overloading patients with information.

result.setting: Two ECT sites, NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde

cycle1.result: Site A: repeat examination in 30 (100%), incomplete in 47%, histories accurate in 20%. Site B: repeat in 6/26 (23%), incomplete in 100%, histories accurate in 38%.

result.intervention: Amended examination sheet and prompts to use multiple sources for medical history (site A).

cycle2.result: Site A: all 12 had complete repeat examination; histories accurate in 8 (67%); multiple sources used in 11 (92%).

result.other_findings: Oral examination was frequently missed at both sites.

result.setting: General medical and surgical wards, a district general hospital and a university teaching hospital
result.standard: Standard hospital prescription charts per local pharmacy guidance

cycle1.result: DGH: allergy 31%, weight 5%, capital letters 40%; discontinued prescriptions properly deleted 49%. Teaching hospital: age 82%, generic name 63%, capital letters 65%.

result.intervention: Recommendations and changes in prescribing practice.

cycle2.result: DGH: name 100%, gender 54%, allergy 51%, generic name 71%. Teaching hospital: significant improvement in unit number, generic name, insulin prescription and ward.

result.other_findings: Authors recommend nationwide standardised charts and revised prescribing training.

result.setting: Ultrasound Department, Bradford Teaching Hospitals
result.standard: National guidelines for dating, foetal anomaly and growth scans; Fetal Anomaly Screening Programme detection rates

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: Marked improvement in practice of re-audited sonographers for dating and anomaly scans.

result.other_findings: Department met national FASP detection rates.

result.setting: Emergency Department, regional hospital, Western Australia
result.standard: National ACS diagnostic and management guidelines (chest pain pathway)

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: Pathway use improved; two troponins in 88% for both groups; admission 75.6% vs 78.6% (p=0.60); risk stratification improved only for non-Aboriginal patients (OR=3.34).

result.other_findings: Discharge against medical advice remained higher among Aboriginal patients (OR=4.22). Totals: 276 Aboriginal and 333 non-Aboriginal records.

result.setting: Respiratory Department, Birmingham Children's Hospital (cystic fibrosis and respiratory outpatients)
result.standard: Legal requirements and national and local prescribing guidelines

cycle1.result: All prescriptions legal; CF items 56/59 (95%) national and 47/66 (71%) local guidelines; respiratory 34 (100%) national and 31/32 (97%) local; duration/quantity missing for 27 (54%) respiratory items.

result.other_findings: Faxed items: 38 (100%) national and 32/33 (97%) local adherence; not documenting allergy status was the main local failure. Re-audit planned.

result.setting: All wards, children's hospital, Cardiff and Vale University Health Board
result.standard: Local guidelines: all patients receiving oxygen have a prescription with target saturations, device and nurse signature within 12 hrs; target 100%

cycle1.result: 0/14 had an oxygen prescription.

result.intervention: New paediatric medication chart with oxygen section and training package.

cycle2.result: 4/18 (22%) had a prescription, all medical patients; target saturation 100%, device 25%, nurse signature 100%.

result.other_findings: Critical care had not engaged with the new chart; numbers were small.

result.setting: Paediatric intensive care unit, Central Manchester University Hospitals

cycle1.result: Unit mean error rate 12.5%.

result.intervention: Automated individual feedback forms for prescribers, posters and discussion at clinical governance meetings.
result.other_findings: In 7 prescribers the error rate fell from mean 15.3 to 9.4 (p=0.29, not significant).

result.setting: Neonatal Intensive Care Unit, Birmingham Women's NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: Desired therapeutic vancomycin plasma concentration 15-25 mg/L

cycle1.dates: January to July 2014 (intermittent bolus regimen, retrospective)
cycle1.result: 28% of concentrations within the therapeutic range.

result.intervention: Switch to continuous intravenous infusion regimen (loading dose 15 mg/kg then 20-50 mg/kg/day by creatinine and CGA).

cycle2.result: 62% of 115 concentrations within range (first 60.8%, second 60%, subsequent 65.6%); 71.3% allowing 10% variability.

result.other_findings: Another hospital using pharmacy-prepared syringes achieved 77%; authors plan prefilled syringes and a re-audit.

result.setting: Pharmacy dispensary serving paediatric wards, Barts Health NHS Trust
result.standard: Trust KPI: 85% of urgent items (TTAs) dispensed within 1 hour; 85% of non-urgent items within 3 hrs

cycle1.result: TTAs averaged 2 hrs from logging in to checking (n=12, standard 1 hour); inpatient orders averaged 5 hrs 51 minutes to leave dispensary (n=22, standard 3 hrs).

result.other_findings: Labelling was the rate-limiting step; proposals include extra labelling staff at peak times and induction teaching; re-audit planned in 3 months.

result.setting: Oculoplastic day surgery theatres, Corneo-Plastic Unit, Queen Victoria Hospital, East Grinstead (tertiary centre)
result.standard: Operating list utilisation rate (anaesthetic plus surgical time as proportion of planned session time)

cycle1.result: Utilisation rate 64.5% (81.2% in the 2011 audit).

result.intervention: Streamlined patient pathway including standardised case scheduling and reduced staggered patient arrival.

cycle2.result: Utilisation rate 78%; whole-day lists 85% vs half-day lists 75% (p < 0.01).

result.other_findings: Three audits: 2011 (81.2%), 2014 (64.5%) after new management and theatre move, 2015 (78%).

result.setting: Tertiary heart failure outpatient service, Royal Brompton Hospital, London

cycle1.result: LVSD patients: beta-blockers 77%, ACE inhibitor or ARB 86%, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist 44%.

cycle2.result: LVSD patients (n=434): beta-blockers 89%, ACE inhibitor or ARB 91%, MRA 56%, ivabradine 6%; all reviewed at least 6-monthly.

result.other_findings: All patients educated about exercise but only 21 (4%) enrolled in supervised exercise; poor access to cardiac rehabilitation.

result.setting: Orthodontic diagnostic teaching clinics, King's College Hospital, London

cycle1.result: 37.2% of patients met the standards.

result.intervention: Referral guidelines and pathway sent back to referring practitioners.
result.other_findings: Poor IOTN use, low IOTN scores, poor oral hygiene, caries, early or adult referrals; authors suggest proformas.

result.setting: Two general surgery wards, Cork University Hospital
result.standard: NICE and SIGN VTE prophylaxis guidelines; kardex-based risk assessment tool

cycle1.result: Risk assessment tool completed in 2.7%; AES correctly prescribed in 75% and LMWH in 97%.

result.intervention: Audit results and risk assessment tool information presented at two departmental teaching sessions.

cycle2.result: 66% had a risk assessment performed (statistically significant improvement).

result.other_findings: AES prescribing rates varied.

result.setting: Dublin Dental University Hospital (undergraduate teaching)
result.standard: Four radiographic criteria: no voids, filling termination 0-2 mm of apex, all roots filled, original anatomy maintained

cycle1.result: Acceptable fillings in 48% of single-rooted and 38% of multirooted canals; 18.8% of multirooted teeth acceptable as a unit.

result.topic: Collateral circulation assessment before radial forearm free flap
result.setting: Department of Maxillofacial Surgery, Royal Surrey County Hospital, Guildford

cycle1.result: Routine MAT and DUS: 6 abnormal DUS, 1 abnormal MAT; no ischaemic complications.

cycle2.result: 2 abnormal MAT had contralateral flap; no ischaemic complications.

result.other_findings: National BAOMS survey: all used MAT; DUS always 40%, sometimes 13.3%, never 46.7%.

result.setting: Medical admissions, John Radcliffe Hospital, Oxford / Wexham Park Hospital
result.standard: Sepsis Six protocol and national severe sepsis guidelines

cycle1.result: 1% appropriately managed; 19% admitted to ITU (6% died); length of stay 10 days.

result.setting: Community leg ulcer clinics, South Bedfordshire Community Health Care Trust

cycle1.result: Average consumables cost per patient £8.53.

cycle2.result: Average consumables cost £10.14; clinic patients £7.91 vs home £10.78; healing 54% at 12 weeks and 68% at 24 weeks with high compression.

result.setting: General Intensive Care Unit, St George's University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, London (tertiary centre)

cycle1.result: Need for improvement across all domains.

cycle2.result: Post intervention errors 90/1677 in the intervention group vs 236/984 in the control group (p<0.005); mean change -11.5% intervention vs +5.9% control, mean difference 17.4% (95% CI -27.3 to -7.6), p<0.05.

result.other_findings: Controlled pilot study design with prospective prescribing audits.

result.topic: NSAID prescribing in chronic kidney disease

cycle2.result: CTG documentation improved by 1% and ultrasound scan requests fell by 6.6%; RFM prevalence rose by 10%.

result.other_findings: 1775 women across both periods, 632 (35.6%) with repeated presentations; 3 stillbirths, all at first presentation; new guideline AGREE II score 22% higher but still below RCOG guideline.

result.setting: Heartlands, Good Hope and Solihull Hospitals, University Hospitals Birmingham NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: Mean percentage overscan length target (value truncated in abstract); overscan >15% defined as excessive; both kidneys fully included

cycle1.result: Mean overscan 28.2%; overscan >15% in 94.4%; superior limit at T10 or below in 59%; both kidneys included in 99%.

result.intervention: New protocol using T11 as the superior scan limit delivered to radiographers.

cycle2.result: Mean overscan 10.6% (SD 4.4%); excessive overscan 35.2%; superior limit at T10 or below in 8%; both kidneys included in 100%.

result.other_findings: Overscan target was met without compromising scan quality.

result.setting: General gynaecology clinic, University Hospital Wales (teaching hospital)
result.standard: Current transvaginal ultrasound guidelines (not named); practice graded compliant, partially compliant or noncompliant

cycle1.result: Pilot audit: image optimisation noncompliant 65.1%; global gynaecological examination noncompliant 60.47%

cycle2.result: Image optimisation noncompliant 41.67% (P = .07); global gynaecological examination noncompliant 14.58%

result.other_findings: Data collected by random direct observation without staff knowing when, to reduce the Hawthorne effect.

result.topic: Family history assessment in breast cancer
result.setting: Breast unit, Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
result.standard: NICE 2013 familial breast cancer guidance: recording of family history, genetics referral and follow-up imaging surveillance

cycle1.result: Family history taken in 151 (76%); 37 (25%) moderate or high risk; 43% of high-risk women referred to genetics; 46% of moderate/high-risk women had inappropriate follow-up imaging

result.intervention: Standardised history-taking proforma introduced for clinic use

cycle2.result: Family history taken in 174 (87%); 35 (20%) moderate or high risk; 70% of high-risk women referred to genetics; inappropriate follow-up imaging 11%

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Clinical oncology inpatients, Guy's and St Thomas' Trust

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Title only; described as a closed loop audit but no abstract supplied.

result.setting: Radiology department, district general hospital
result.standard: RCR: excess CTKUB scan length above the upper pole of the highest kidney should not exceed 10% of total scan length

cycle1.result: Scan length exceeded the standard on 81% of scans (81/100)

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Routine NHS child ADHD assessment services (community paediatrics, Medway; Nottingham)

cycle1.result: Pre-QbTest group: mean 3.05 clinician consultations to confirmed ADHD diagnosis

result.intervention: Addition of an objective test of attention, impulsivity and activity (QbTest) to standard ADHD assessment

cycle2.result: QbTest group: mean 2.18 consultations to diagnosis (significantly fewer, Poisson regression)

result.other_findings: Authors suggest possible cost savings and call for a randomised controlled trial.

result.setting: Ophthalmology unit, Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: 350 operations on 304 patients (427 eyes); 40/304 (13%) required more than one operation; 26/40 (65%) re-operated patients would have been missed without cross-referencing

result.other_findings: 17 patients had post-operative complications recorded, 7 of whom had repeat surgery; paper mainly evaluates Medisoft as an audit tool.

result.topic: Analgesia for paediatric dental extraction under general anaesthesia
result.setting: East Surrey Hospital, day case dental extractions under general anaesthesia
result.standard: Association of Paediatric Anaesthetists of Great Britain and Ireland analgesia guidance

cycle1.result: 47% of children prescribed a recommended analgesic regimen

result.intervention: Protocol for analgesic delivery developed and disseminated to anaesthetic and dental teams

cycle2.result: Full compliance with audit standards (third cycle)

result.other_findings: Three audit cycles; full compliance shown in both the second and third cycles.

result.setting: Pre-assessment clinic for elective breast surgery, St James's University Hospital, Leeds
result.standard: NICE 2016 guideline on routine preoperative tests for elective surgery

cycle1.result: Unacceptable quantity of inappropriate blood tests (figures not given)

result.intervention: Education of pre-assessment clinic staff on the guideline and a poster to guide ordering

cycle2.result: Significant reduction in blood tests requested with a 71% reduction in financial expenditure

result.other_findings: Inappropriate tests added no relevant clinical information and abnormal results did not alter clinical course.

result.topic: Inpatient care for anxiety and depression
result.setting: All NHS inpatient mental health service providers in England (National Clinical Audit of Anxiety and Depression)
result.standard: Thirteen standards based on NICE guidelines, literature review and steering committee feedback

cycle1.result: 39% referred for psychological therapy; care plan review date documented in only two-thirds; almost half had not received a copy of their care plan; frequent gaps in initial assessment documentation

result.other_findings: Wide variation between services; no single outcome measure used routinely; many missed physical health interventions.

result.topic: Postoperative anaemia management after free flap surgery
result.setting: Regional Maxillofacial Unit, Aintree University Hospital, Liverpool
result.standard: Early correction of postoperative anaemia with intravenous iron; intraoperative tranexamic acid (no target stated)

cycle1.result: Initial audit: TXA intraoperatively 4%, RBC transfusion 26%, intravenous iron 0

cycle2.result: TXA intraoperatively 30%, RBC transfusion 20%, intravenous iron 55 patients (37%)

result.other_findings: No adverse reactions to IV iron; authors note it is a challenge to embed change in protocols.

result.setting: Endoscopy, Epsom and St Helier NHS Trust
result.standard: UK best practice: photographic evidence of caecal intubation for all complete colonoscopies (90% caecal intubation rate)

cycle1.result: 70% provided sufficient proof of caecal intubation; 50% labelled as proof of intubation; 30% insufficient proof

result.intervention: Results shared at departmental governance meetings

cycle2.result: 71% met best practice standards; 29% insufficient evidence

result.other_findings: 20% of initial colonoscopies had sufficient images not identified as proof of intubation.

result.setting: Inpatient Liaison Neuropsychiatry service, Beaumont Hospital, Dublin (neurology and neurosurgery referrals)
result.standard: Use of the hospital delirium protocol

cycle1.result: Delirium protocol used in 12% (n = 3); 4% (n = 3) referred with specific delirium query; delirium diagnosed in 33% (n = 25)

result.intervention: Psychoeducational intervention to raise awareness of delirium diagnosis and management

cycle2.result: Delirium protocol used in 47% (n = 15), significant increase; 2% (n = 2) referred for possible delirium; delirium diagnosed in 38% (n = 32)

result.other_findings: Mood remained the most common referral reason (38%) in both cycles.

result.topic: Extended VTE prophylaxis after cancer surgery
result.setting: Department of Surgery, The County Hospital, Hereford
result.standard: NICE guidance on extended VTE prophylaxis at discharge after colorectal cancer surgery

cycle1.result: Cyclical 4-monthly decline in compliance coinciding with foundation doctor rotations

result.intervention: Six multidisciplinary interventions including education of health professionals

cycle2.result: 100% compliance with prescribing extended VTE prophylaxis at discharge

result.other_findings: 181 elective and 29 emergency patients; no VTE events at 30 days.

result.setting: Sixteen wards, UK teaching hospital (St Helens and Knowsley Hospitals NHS Trust)

cycle1.result: Mean prescribing error rate 25.0% intervention group and 19.7% control group (prescribed medications audited)

result.intervention: Pharmacist-led individualised constructive prescribing feedback for 36 prescribers (41 controls)

cycle2.result: Mean error rate 6.7% intervention group and 25.1% control group; overall change between groups 23.7%

result.other_findings: Controlled before-and-after design with prospective prescribing audits.

result.setting: Eye casualty, University Hospitals Coventry and Warwickshire (tertiary referral centre)
result.standard: Audit criteria: discharge rates, subspecialty referral and reattendance

cycle1.result: All appointments face-to-face; discharge rate 55.3%

result.intervention: Walk-in attendance replaced by telephone triage with digital imaging via NHS email for remote review during COVID-19

cycle2.result: All telephone consults, resulting in 2639 (54.2%) face-to-face appointments; discharge rate 76.9%

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Acute kidney injury recognition and management
result.setting: Large tertiary care hospital, Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
result.standard: Pre-defined acute kidney injury recognition, assessment and management tasks

cycle1.result: AKI recognition documented in 15%; median time to first medical review after alert 4 hours 4 minutes

result.intervention: AKI electronic alerts from the laboratory information system with an associated AKI management pathway

cycle2.result: AKI recognition documented in 43%; median time to first medical review 3 hours 47 minutes; completion of assessment tasks improved

result.other_findings: AKI management tasks (hypovolaemia correction, obstruction, medication review, renal referral, sepsis) showed very little or no improvement.

result.setting: Emergency general surgery, central London tertiary care centre (Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust)
result.standard: RCS England Good Surgical Practice operation note criteria

cycle1.result: Average compliance 56.1% for laparoscopic appendicectomy operation notes

result.intervention: Laparoscopic appendicectomy operation note proforma designed and implemented

cycle2.result: Average compliance 98.2%, with above 80% of notes satisfying all criteria; significant 42.1% improvement

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: University teaching hospital (University Hospital Limerick), inpatient stroke services
result.standard: Benchmarked against Irish National Audit of Stroke 2019, 6th SSNAP Annual Report and American Heart Association 2013

cycle1.result: Thrombolysis 10%; median door to needle 60 min; 78.5% admitted to stroke unit; 81.1% swallow assessment; median door to imaging 104 min; thrombectomy 4%; mood screening 11.5%; median length of stay 12 days

result.other_findings: In-patient mortality 10.5%; process mapping and PDSA planned, with 2020 re-audit results expected in 2021.

result.setting: ICU of a veterinary university teaching hospital (Royal Veterinary College)
result.standard: Current guidelines on nutritional support, including within 72 hours of absent caloric intake

cycle1.result: 18/58 (31%) received nutritional support (dogs 16/50, 32%; cats 2/8, 25%), 16/18 (88.9%) parenterally; with >72 h absent caloric intake, dogs 4/11 (36.4%) and cats 0/2 fed

result.other_findings: Veterinary study of dogs and cats; no documented reason for omitting nutrition in many cases. Repeat audit after protocol change recommended.

result.setting: Adult emergency surgical patients, Victoria Hospital Kirkcaldy
result.standard: Proportion prescribed intravenous metronidazole when the oral route was available

cycle1.result: Oral 11 (20.4%), IV 43 (79.6%); IV prescribed without clear contraindication to oral in 35/43 (81.4%)

cycle2.result: Oral 23 (37.7%), IV 38 (62.3%); IV despite oral suitability 13/38 (34.2%) (risk ratio 0.42, 95% CI 0.26 to 0.67)

result.other_findings: Considerable reduction in healthcare costs reported.

result.setting: Ophthalmology department, tertiary referral hospital (outpatients)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Glaucoma prescription guide in outpatients and additional prescribing training for all staff grades

cycle2.result: Prescription errors 73/2342 (3.1%): writing errors 50/73 (68.4%), drug-related errors 23/73 (31.6%); significant reduction reported

result.other_findings: Prescriptions by doctors, optometrists and nurses were included.

result.setting: 14 critical care units, Greater Manchester Critical Care Network
result.standard: Delirium Standards for the Greater Manchester Critical Care Network (formal delirium screening)

cycle1.result: 48% had a formal delirium screen; 37% had two delirium screens in 24 h; delirium point prevalence 28%

result.intervention: Network standards, delirium care bundle, sharing best practice, staff education, guidance and a regional delirium study day

cycle2.result: Latest audit: 60% had two delirium screens in 24 h; point prevalence as low as 13%

result.other_findings: Multiple PDSA cycles (April 2015, May 2016, November 2016 and quarterly audits); sensory aid availability and pain assessments also improved.

result.setting: OMFS day-case local anaesthetic and IV sedation cases (Addenbrooke's Hospital / Bedford General Hospital)

cycle1.result: ICD-10 primary diagnosis accuracy 65%; coding accuracy 62%; OPCS accuracy 80%; secondary or bilateral procedures 83%

result.other_findings: About £20,000 revenue generated across the audit cycle.

result.setting: Clinical decisions unit, The Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust
result.standard: Standardised acute tonsillitis management protocol (five initial treatments)

cycle1.result: Median two of five initial treatments; admission rate 0.79

cycle2.result: Second cycle: median three of five initial treatments (z = 2.959, p = 0.003); admission rate 0.48, relative risk reduction 39.2% (95% CI 0.380-0.972; p = 0.038)

result.other_findings: First post-intervention cycle: median three of five treatments (p = 0.004) and admission rate 0.44 (44.6% relative risk reduction, p = 0.0547).

result.topic: Necrotising otitis externa length of stay

result.standard: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D in all suitable admissions, with supplementation below 50 nmol/L

result.setting: ENT emergency clinic, Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust

result.setting: Adult medical and surgical inpatients (Calderdale Royal Hospital / Nottingham)

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Paediatric Emergency Department, Children's Health Ireland at Crumlin, Dublin
result.standard: Documentation of 10 ECG interpretation items (8 relating to the waveform)

cycle2.result: Recording of the documentation items ranged from 95-100%

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde hospital inpatients receiving IV fluids and IV antibiotics
result.standard: NICE IV fluid therapy guidelines (fluid and electrolyte requirements)

result.standard: Contemporary society recommendations on restrictive red cell transfusion

result.setting: ENT department, Sandwell and West Birmingham NHS Trust
result.standard: Royal College of Surgeons operation note guidelines

result.intervention: Deficiencies shared with the department at monthly quality improvement meetings

cycle2.result: Compliance 100% across all parameters except one

result.setting: Glangwili General Hospital, Carmarthen (district general hospital)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.setting: One district nursing team in South Wales (Aneurin Bevan University Health Board)
result.standard: JBI evidence-based audit criteria for clinical supervision

cycle1.result: Baseline compliance lower than post-implementation (figures not given)

result.other_findings: JBI PACES best practice implementation project.

result.setting: Paediatric services, Medway Maritime Hospital and local hospitals

result.setting: Glaucoma service and virtual clinic, Moorfields Eye Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: Gonioscopy as reference standard for occludable angle

result.other_findings: Second audit (04-08/2019): 91/137 (66.4%) triaged face-to-face and 29/91 (31.9%) discharged; AS-OCT PPV 74.3% and NPV 82.1%.

result.topic: Reporting of incidental vertebral fragility fractures on CT

result.standard: 2019 RCR audit standards for reporting vertebral fragility fractures on CT

cycle2.result: 1586/7316 (21.7%) had a VFF on auditor review; comment on spine/bone 93.2% (14.4% improvement)

result.other_findings: Overall improvements in key initial/provisional reporting results.

result.standard: Local anticipatory prescribing guidance (four drug classes)

result.setting: Urology outpatient clinic, Frimley Park NHS Trust
result.standard: GMC guidance on chaperone use and documentation for intimate examination

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Raising awareness among the 12 team members

cycle2.result: Documentation improved by 9.85% in clinical notes and 36.65% in clinic letters

result.other_findings: Scoring system used for team and individual performance.

result.setting: Medical unit, Southmead Hospital, North Bristol NHS Trust
result.standard: Patients consented before LMWH prescription considering religious and dietary preferences

result.other_findings: Two QI cycles; positive feedback and high demand for a non-animal-derived alternative.

result.setting: UK radiotherapy departments, RCR national re-audit
result.standard: Guideline-recommended radical radiotherapy for NSCLC (RCR 2013 audit standards)

result.setting: Banstead Primary Care Network, NHS Surrey Heartlands

cycle1.result: Several cases of inadvertent unopposed oestrogen exposure identified, due to prescribing, dispensing and patient understanding factors (no figures given)

result.other_findings: Re-audit results awaited; many flash points hard to detect or measure.

result.setting: Municipal hospital in Moscow, clinical health workers

result.other_findings: Staff survey could not be assessed.

result.standard: Standards extrapolated from current testosterone guidance

cycle1.result: not reported
