result.intervention: Educational sessions for clinicians, reminder posters and updates to admission documentation.
result.other_findings: Urate testing remained well below full compliance.

result.setting: District general hospital, Mersey and West Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust (appendicectomy)
result.standard: GIRFT appendicectomy documentation guidance (34 recommended standards)

cycle1.result: Electronic system use 41.8%; mesoappendix documentation 78.1%; blood loss reported 1.35%.

result.intervention: Structured operative note template and staff education.

cycle2.result: Electronic system use 76%; mesoappendix documentation 100%; blood loss reported 13.6%.

result.other_findings: Blood loss reporting remained low.

result.setting: Emergency department, Royal Preston Hospital
result.standard: Oral rather than IV paracetamol in patients who can take oral medication (no target stated)

cycle1.result: IV paracetamol about 38% of all 1 g paracetamol doses in the ED.

result.intervention: Informal teaching sessions and staff engagement.

cycle2.result: No significant reduction; IV prescribing about 35% to 40% in most months.

result.other_findings: An interim re-audit (February to April 2024) also showed no significant reduction; a structured QI approach with formal teaching, visual prompts and feedback and a third data collection from August 2025 are under way.

result.setting: Dongola Specialized Hospital
result.standard: 2023 Sudan national malaria case management protocol

cycle1.result: General protocol adherence 13 (30.95%); correct IM artesunate site 13 (30.95%); second-line treatment for uncomplicated malaria in pregnancy 10 (23.81%); first-line P. falciparum treatment 38 (90.48%).

result.intervention: Physician training sessions and dissemination of updated clinical guidelines.

cycle2.result: Protocol adherence 35 (89.74%); correct IM artesunate site 31 (79.49%); second-line MIP treatment 25 (64.10%); IPT with sulfadoxine/pyrimethamine 36 (92.31%); first-line artemether/lumefantrine 100%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: MRCP use in low-risk gallstone disease
result.setting: Single NHS trust, Mid Yorkshire Teaching NHS Trust

cycle1.result: 42.2% of MRCPs were normal; bilirubin, ALP and dilated CBD on ultrasound did not predict abnormal MRCP (p=1.00, p=0.61, p=0.82).

result.other_findings: Avoidable normal MRCPs cost an estimated £38,000-65,000 a year; a composite MRCP-RS score showed modest discrimination and re-audit after implementation is recommended.

result.setting: Surgical inpatients, Prince Osman Digna Referral Hospital, Port Sudan
result.standard: ACCP and NICE VTE guidelines (Caprini risk assessment and prophylaxis)

cycle1.result: Caprini score documented 0 (0%); 49 (98%) received no prophylaxis; prophylaxis duration documented 1 (2%); guideline-consistent plans 1 (2%).

result.intervention: Educational workshops, standardised assessment forms, visual aids and feedback sessions.

cycle2.result: Caprini documented 39 (83%); early mobilisation 30 (63.8%); LMWH 9 (19.1%); TED stockings 8 (17%); no prophylaxis 7 (14.9%); duration documented 37 (78.7%); guideline-consistent plans 30 (65.2%); patient education 20 (42.6%); all p < 0.05.

result.other_findings: LMWH use remained low after the intervention.

result.topic: Follow-up chest radiograph after community-acquired pneumonia
result.setting: Emergency department, East and North Hertfordshire Teaching NHS Trust
result.standard: BTS/NICE guidance: follow-up CXR at about six weeks after CAP; audit standard 90% or more

cycle1.result: Follow-up CXR completed 16/50 (32%); VPC referral 12/50 (24%); CAS inclusion 3/50 (6%).

result.intervention: Eight-week bundle: staff education, electronic discharge documentation with mandatory prompts, multilingual patient leaflets and a standardised Critical Alert System routed to the requester.
result.other_findings: The 90% standard was not reached; cycle 2 VPC and CAS figures are truncated in the abstract.

result.setting: Department of Paediatrics, Atbara Teaching Hospital
result.standard: Completeness of 25 admission documentation parameters (no external standard stated)

cycle1.result: 0% completion of gender, triage, family/past medical/social histories and most examinations; height and MUAC under 5%.

result.intervention: Standardised inpatient admission sheet with staff training, documentation protocols, checklist prompts and enhanced supervision (two intervention rounds).

cycle2.result: Cycle 3: name, age, gender, weight and date 84.0% to 96.0%; address and triage improved; detailed histories and system examinations regressed to 0%.

result.other_findings: Cycle 2 (n=50) showed gender 34.0%, past medical history 68.0%, cardiovascular examination 68.0%, MUAC 20.0%. Vital signs, allergy and discharge status were never documented.

result.topic: Scrotal exploration for suspected testicular torsion
result.setting: District general hospital in Kent (Medway NHS Foundation Trust)
result.standard: BURST-BAUS FIX-IT consensus guidelines for scrotal exploration

cycle1.result: Median raphe incision, fixation and closure 100% compliant; orchidopexy in all (100%) non-torsion cases.

result.intervention: Review in July 2024 with feedback and recommendations for practice.

cycle2.result: Incision, fixation and closure 100% compliant; orchidopexy in non-torsion cases reduced to 75%.

result.other_findings: Documentation of torsion degree, testicular appearance and follow-up planning stayed inconsistent but improved.

result.setting: Kassala Teaching Hospital
result.standard: Royal College of Surgeons of England documentation guidelines

cycle1.result: Operative procedure 88.6%, findings 88.6%, postoperative instructions 93.2%; operative diagnosis 45.5%, date/time 65.9%; DVT prophylaxis 25.0%, prosthesis 40.9%, surgeon's signature 45.5%.

result.intervention: Staff education, standardised templates, visual reminders and enhanced supervision after root cause analysis.

cycle2.result: Operative diagnosis 86.4%; date/time 88.6%; DVT prophylaxis 27.3%; prosthesis 43.2%; surgeon's signature 47.7%.

result.other_findings: DVT prophylaxis, prosthesis identification and signatures remained poor.

result.setting: Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: ESUR-SPIWG and Royal College of Radiologists varicocele ultrasound reporting guidelines

cycle1.result: Testicular volume 0.0%; varicocele location 0%; largest vein diameter 50.0%; Valsalva/grading 0%.

result.intervention: Multidisciplinary meeting and structured reporting template.

cycle2.result: Testicular volume 91.6%; location 91.6%; largest vein diameter 100%; Valsalva/grading 97.2% (all p < 0.001).

result.other_findings: 66 reports reviewed across both cycles.

result.setting: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust, Poole
result.standard: NICE guidance: antibiotics only for systemically unwell, immunosuppressed or complicated diverticulitis; target 100%

cycle1.result: Uncomplicated diverticulitis compliance 0% (21/24 well, immunocompetent patients given antibiotics); complicated 100% (19/19).

cycle2.result: Uncomplicated diverticulitis compliance 66% (6 of 26 still received unnecessary antibiotics); complicated 100% (9/9).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Driving advice after inguinal hernia repair
result.setting: University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust, general surgery
result.standard: Trust and Royal College of Surgeons of England guidance on postoperative driving advice after inguinal hernia repair

cycle1.result: 21 (50%) discharge letters had no driving advice; 6 (14.3%) gave correct advice; leaflets 10 (43%) and verbal advice 11 (48%) of contactable patients; clinician understanding 17 (33%).

result.intervention: Teaching session, poster displays and a reminder email to include driving advice in discharge letters.

cycle2.result: 14 (35%) had no driving advice; 17 (43%) correct advice; leaflets 13 (76%) and verbal advice 14 (82%) of contactable patients; clinician understanding 27 (90%).

result.other_findings: Clinician surveys (50 then 30 clinicians) ran alongside the letter audits.

result.setting: Tertiary hospital in London, inpatients aged 65 or over
result.standard: National guidance recommending vision assessment after a fall

cycle1.result: Documented visual acuity assessment 7.8%; confrontational visual fields 5.9% in patients admitted after a fall.

result.intervention: Staff education sessions, visual prompts and improved access to bedside visual acuity tools.
result.other_findings: 337 records reviewed in total (181 pre, 156 post); changes were not statistically significant and assessment remained low.

result.setting: District general hospital, East Kent Hospitals University NHS Foundation Trust, A&E presentations
result.standard: Royal College of Radiologists imaging standards for acute pancreatitis (no routine early CT without severe features)

cycle1.result: 24 (54%) had CT, 15 of them within 72 hours; serum amylase checked in all; ultrasound within 24 hours infrequent.

result.intervention: Departmental presentations and posters to raise awareness of imaging guidelines.

cycle2.result: 15 (46.8%) had CT, three within 72 hours; serum amylase checked in all.

result.other_findings: Imaging findings were consistent with pancreatitis in 80% of cycle 1 scans.

result.topic: CT head within 1 hour for head injury
result.setting: Emergency department, UK district general hospital (The Hillingdon Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust)
result.standard: NICE NG232: CT head within 60 minutes of arrival in eligible patients

cycle1.result: 4.34% (n=6) imaged within 60 minutes.

result.intervention: Triage nurse pro forma to identify eligible patients, daily educational sessions, email dissemination and handover reinforcement.
result.other_findings: Staff compliance, patient transfer time and workload limited improvement.

result.setting: Dammar Teaching Hospital
result.standard: Oxygen therapy guidelines (nine parameters including device flow rates, documentation and weaning)

cycle1.result: Correct nasal cannula use 50.0%; non-rebreather 61.9%; target SpO2 recorded in type 2 respiratory failure 69.0%; routine SpO2 monitoring 50.0%; immediate oxygen for at-risk patients 16.7%; weaning 76.2%; timely discontinuation 78.6%.

cycle2.result: Nasal cannula 92.3%; non-rebreather 100.0%; target SpO2 recorded 100.0%; SpO2 monitoring 82.1%; immediate oxygen 70.0%; weaning 45.0%; timely discontinuation 47.5%.

result.other_findings: Weaning and discontinuation compliance fell after the intervention.

result.setting: General surgery admissions, district general hospital (Harrogate District Hospital)
result.standard: NICE and local guidelines for VTE risk assessment (within 24 hours) and prophylaxis

cycle1.result: Risk assessment completed 75.9%, within 24 hours 53.7%; pharmacological prophylaxis 81.5%; mechanical prophylaxis 29.6%.

cycle2.result: Risk assessment completed 93%, within 24 hours 59.6%; pharmacological prophylaxis appropriate in 100%; mechanical prophylaxis 25%.

result.other_findings: Mechanical prophylaxis fell slightly and timely assessment stayed low.

result.topic: Biopsy of red patches after flexible cystoscopy
result.setting: UK district general hospital (Surrey and Sussex Healthcare NHS Trust)

cycle1.result: 37 (58.7%) biopsied, three malignancies (8.1%); relook in 26 with resolution in 20 (76.9%).

result.intervention: Mandatory red-patch image capture, consultant review before biopsy listing and structured teaching on morphology, risk stratification and benign mimics.

cycle2.result: 23 (31.5%) biopsied, one malignancy (4.3%); relook in 48 with resolution in 32 (66.7%).

result.other_findings: All malignancies were in patients over 60; antibiotic prescribing remained frequent without culture-proven infection.

result.setting: Emergency department and Medical Admissions Unit, Royal Victoria Infirmary, Newcastle
result.standard: 2018 European Society of Cardiology syncope guidelines

cycle1.result: Admission 81% low-risk, 96% medium-risk, 100% high-risk; overall 92%; lying/standing BP 59%; family history 15%; telemetry 17%, 71%, 71%.

result.intervention: Syncope Risk Stratification Chart, staff education and visual prompts.

cycle2.result: Admission 89%, 89%, 100%; overall 93% (p = 1.00); lying/standing BP 72% (p = 0.27); family history 41% (p = 0.005); telemetry 38%, 88%, 91%.

result.other_findings: Admission and telemetry use remained misaligned with ESC recommendations.

result.setting: General surgery department, Diana Princess of Wales Hospital, Grimsby (district general hospital), emergency laparotomy patients
result.standard: NICE IV fluid guidelines (hypotonic, balanced, weight-based maintenance fluids)

cycle1.result: 9.5% received fluids in line with NICE; sodium and chloride over 200% above recommended; potassium 83% below target.

result.intervention: New default maintenance fluid (0.45% NaCl + 0.15% KCl + 5% dextrose), teaching sessions and prescribing guidance.

cycle2.result: 45% appropriate prescribing; sodium reduced by 165% and chloride by 128%; improved potassium and dextrose provision.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Sensory aid and dementia status documentation
result.setting: Old age ward, Princess Alexandra Hospital, Harlow

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: PDSA 1: three board round teaching sessions on the EPR property form checklist; PDSA 2: laminated bedside sensory impairment checklist.

cycle2.result: EPR form completion rose 14% over 4 weeks (not significant); 18% of bedside checklists completed; sensory aid unknown rates fell 32%, dementia unknown 40% and both 56%.

result.other_findings: Delirium status was not assessed because of documentation inconsistencies.

result.setting: Al-Managil Teaching Hospital

cycle1.result: Recognition of the 2023 protocol 38%.

result.intervention: AI-based clinical decision-support system with training (diagnostics, treatment and special group advice).

cycle2.result: Recognition of the 2023 protocol 100% (risk difference +62%, 95% CI: 48-76).

result.other_findings: Practice and knowledge were measured by physician questionnaire; the authors note a possible Hawthorne effect and no clinical outcome data.

result.setting: Four Complex Medical Units, John Radcliffe Hospital
result.standard: Mental capacity assessment for admission and DoLS application where capacity lacking, in inpatients aged 70 or over with AMTS below 8, delirium or cognitive impairment

cycle1.result: AMTS completed 66.2% (n=43); of 62 eligible, 27.4% had capacity assessment and 17.7% had DoLS.

result.intervention: MCA-DoLS teaching for CMU doctors and a week-long pilot discussing MCA-DoLS at daily board rounds in one unit.

cycle2.result: AMTS completed 72.7% (n=48); of 58 eligible, 25.9% had capacity assessment and 12.1% had DoLS.

result.other_findings: Capacity assessment and DoLS rates did not improve; educating the wider MDT is suggested.

result.topic: Appropriateness of ED referrals to general surgery
result.setting: Stepping Hill Hospital, Stockport, ED to general surgery referrals
result.standard: Appropriate referral (concordant diagnosis, no onward referral) with complete assessment (no external standard stated)

cycle1.result: Of 86 abdominal pain referrals: 34 (39.6%) lacked blood tests, 53 (61.6%) had no basic radiology, 18 (21.9%) no preliminary treatment, 24 (27.9%) inappropriate.

result.intervention: Acute abdominal pain pathway emphasising early CT imaging.

cycle2.result: No blood tests 5 (20%) (p=0.001); no treatment 3 (4.2%) (p=0.001); inappropriate referrals 7 (9.7%) (p=0.004), 65.2% relative risk reduction.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Geriatric medicine wards, Glasgow Royal Infirmary (tertiary hospital)
result.standard: National guidance on treatment escalation plans (no target stated)

cycle1.result: TEP completed in 21 of 75 (28%); median time to TEP 10.5 days (IQR 7-14); DNACPR documentation 55%; consultant involvement 12%.

result.intervention: Paper-based admission checklist, then a multidisciplinary teaching programme.

cycle2.result: TEP completed in 72 of 125 (58%); median time 5 days (IQR 3-8); DNACPR documentation 73%; consultant involvement 27%.

result.other_findings: After the checklist alone (cycle 1, n=75) TEP completion was 32 of 75 (43%). Consultant involvement was linked to earlier completion (median 4 vs 7 days, P = 0.03).

result.setting: Three general surgery wards, Broomfield Hospital
result.standard: GMC, Royal College of Surgeons and local Trust standards: date, time, full name, signature and GMC number in ward round notes

cycle1.result: Date 100%; time 27.7%; full name 67.5%; signature 72.3%; GMC number 12.0%.

result.intervention: Educational posters, email reminders and encouraging use of personal stamps.

cycle2.result: Date 100%; time 90.2%; full name 87.0%; signature 94.6%; GMC number 75.0% (p < 0.05 for all except date).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Surgical assessment unit, major trauma centre (University Hospitals Plymouth)
result.standard: Royal College of Surgeons and Professional Record Standards Body (PRSB) documentation standards

cycle1.result: Information was missing in the categories of responsible consultant, medication history, allergy status and differential diagnosis.

result.intervention: Structured Surgical Assessment Proforma introduced (PDSA cycle, designed after a clinician survey).

cycle2.result: Of 45 assessment criteria, 38 improved (23 significantly; p<0.05), two showed no change and five were reduced (two significantly; p<0.05). Documentation rates in nine categories improved by over 50%.

result.other_findings: Post-proforma survey: 73% of doctors and 86% of allied health professionals agreed documentation improved; 100% of AHPs said it improved handover.

result.topic: Low back pain management against NICE guidance
result.setting: Single general practice, Glasgow
result.standard: NICE guidelines for management of first-presentation low back pain

cycle1.result: 39.4% (n = 28) fully compliant with NICE guidance. NSAIDs prescribed in 21.1% and opioids in 9.9%, against guideline advice; physiotherapy self-referral 39.4%; fit notes 4.2%.

result.intervention: Poster summarising the NICE guidelines created and presented at a departmental meeting; re-audit planned.
result.other_findings: Patient education (weight loss and exercise advice) was the most compliant domain.

result.setting: Upper limb specialist team meeting, tertiary trauma centre (Queen Elizabeth Hospital Birmingham)

cycle1.result: No complex patient outcomes were documented in the electronic patient record; outcomes were kept as PowerPoint slides in a shared folder.

result.intervention: Structured documentation template, centralised storage and a shared worklist integrated into the clinical portal.

cycle2.result: 39/44 complex cases (89%) had outcomes recorded directly in the EPR through the shared worklist.

result.other_findings: The five undocumented cases occurred during the junior doctor changeover period.

result.topic: MDT to results clinic waiting time
result.setting: Uro-oncology service, Belfast Health and Social Care Trust (five consultant clinics)

cycle1.result: Mean wait from MDT to consultant results clinic 34.1 days (SD 7.89).

result.intervention: Weekly eight-slot nurse-led results clinic opened in October 2024, with select patients booked directly from MDT.

cycle2.result: Mean wait 16.0 days (SD 3.16), a 53.1% reduction (Welch's t-test p = 0.00003; paired t-test by month p = 0.0016).

result.other_findings: Eight patients a week were reviewed directly from MDT in less than a week.

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, Northwick Park Hospital
result.standard: NICE NG104; modified Atlanta, Modified Marshall and Glasgow-Imrie scoring on admission and at 48 hours

cycle1.result: 30% had documented scoring on admission; none had repeat scoring at 48 hours; Atlanta scoring on admission and at 48 hours 0%.

result.intervention: Departmental teaching, posters, and email and messaging reminders.

cycle2.result: Admission scoring 40%; Atlanta scoring on admission and at 48 hours 7.5%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: General surgery, Newham University Hospital, Barts Health NHS Trust
result.standard: Local guidance and national guidelines: cholecystectomy within two to six weeks of presentation

cycle1.result: Only 3% had pre-assessment clinic arranged; readmission rate 36%.

result.intervention: Structured cholecystectomy pathway, teaching sessions and a standardised booking email.

cycle2.result: Pre-assessment clinic 16%; follow-up avoided in 30%; readmissions 22%.

result.other_findings: Booking delays persisted: 36% scheduled at three months and 40% not booked at all.

result.setting: Radiology departments, two hospital sites (consultant radiologists and reporting radiographers)
result.standard: Royal College of Radiologists ergonomic guidance 'Correct Use of Reporting Workstation'

cycle1.result: Voice recognition access 25/25 (100%); variable lighting 9/25 (36%); regular breaks 9/25 (36%).

cycle2.result: Voice recognition 21/21 (100%); variable lighting 14/21 (67%); regular breaks 10/21 (48%); eye test compliance declined.

result.other_findings: Awareness of ergonomic guidelines improved but conformance remained low.

result.setting: Acute Medical Unit, Darent Valley Hospital
result.standard: NICE chronic heart failure monitoring standards plus local daily 12-lead ECG, six parameters within 24 hours of admission

cycle1.result: Baseline median adherence 50.9%; fluid status and nutritional status monitoring particularly poor.

result.intervention: Simplified CHF care bundle flowchart distributed to AMU staff with orientation (two PDSA cycles, student-led).

cycle2.result: Median adherence 86.8% after the second PDSA cycle; nutritional status +52.6%, daily ECG +63.2%, fluid status +52.6%.

result.other_findings: An intermediate cycle included 13 patients; run charts showed adherence stabilised by cycle 2.

result.setting: District general hospital (Kettering General Hospital)
result.standard: BAUS standards on ureteric stent documentation; target 100%

cycle1.result: Logbook completeness 98.2% (54/55).

result.intervention: New electronic stent-tracking database introduced alongside the handwritten logbook.

cycle2.result: Completeness 97.1% in both the electronic database (66/68) and the logbook (66/68).

result.other_findings: Missed entries linked to workflow variation, parallel systems and failure to capture antegrade stents.

result.setting: Croydon University Hospital
result.standard: NICE NG158 (two-level Wells score and D-dimer before CTPA); RCR expected CTPA diagnostic yield 15-35%

cycle1.result: Wells score documented in 4 (6.9%); D-dimer recorded in 45 (77%); diagnostic yield 19% (11 positive).

result.intervention: Mandatory Wells score and D-dimer fields added to the Cerner CTPA request form, plus educational messaging.

cycle2.result: Wells score recorded in 84 (87.5%); D-dimer in 86 (89.6%); diagnostic yield 16.7% (16 positive).

result.other_findings: PE found in 14/61 (23%) with Wells >4 and 2/23 (8.7%) with Wells 4 or less; alternative diagnoses on chest X-ray in 25 (26%).

result.setting: Bashair University Hospital, Khartoum
result.standard: Royal College of Radiologists request form standards

cycle1.result: Patient address 0 (0.0%), urgency 0 (0.0%), clinical background 8 (16.0%), clinical question 3 (6.0%).

result.intervention: Structured RCR-compliant request form and clinician educational sessions over one month.

cycle2.result: Address documentation 47 (94.0%); other statistically significant improvements reported (figures truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: Authors recommend reinforcement of contact information fields.

result.topic: Braden scale pressure injury risk documentation
result.setting: Al-Managil Teaching Hospital
result.standard: Complete Braden Scale documentation (subscales, total score, risk level)

cycle1.result: 0% recording of all Braden subscales, total score and risk level.

result.intervention: Two-month intervention: staff education and a standardised Braden documentation form.

cycle2.result: 100% completion across all Braden components; significant improvements in patient identifiers and administrative fields.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: The James Cook University Hospital and University Hospital North Tees
result.standard: NICE NG89 VTE risk assessment and timely prophylaxis, with culturally sensitive prescribing

cycle1.result: JCUH had 100% VTE risk assessment compliance; other cycle 1 figures not reported.

result.intervention: Staff education, posters, prescribing alerts and community outreach.

cycle2.result: Risk assessment improved by 14% at UHNT; JCUH maintained 100%. Timely prophylaxis fell at UHNT, with 80% receiving it late. Leaflet distribution rose by 10% at JCUH but was absent at UHNT.

result.other_findings: 98% (n = 137) of patients prioritised belief-aligned medication; 64% of clinicians (n = 50) were unaware LMWHs are animal-derived.

result.setting: York and Scarborough Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Of 142 lesions where tattooing was mandatory, 102 (72%) were tattooed at index colonoscopy; adequate tattooing details documented in 41.4%.

result.intervention: None yet; education, standardised proformas and system changes recommended, with repeat audit.
result.other_findings: 57 lesions (40.1%) were CT-invisible; of 16 non-tattooed CT-invisible lesions, only nine had repeat tattooing before surgery.

result.setting: Intensive Care Unit, Royal Liverpool University Hospital

cycle1.result: Senna and docusate prescribed on admission in 50% of medical and 25% of surgical patients; bowels opened within 48 hours in 64.3% of medical and 36.1% of surgical patients.

cycle2.result: Senna and docusate prescribed in 90% of medical and 13.2% of surgical patients; bowels opened within 48 hours in 90% of medical and 21.1% of surgical patients.

result.other_findings: No statistically significant change between cycles; surgical patients' care was set by parent teams.

result.topic: Braden scale pressure injury risk documentation
result.setting: Internal Medicine Department, Dongola Specialized Hospital
result.standard: Predefined standards from international pressure-injury prevention guidelines

cycle1.result: None of the Braden subscales, total scores, risk levels or preventive actions were documented (0%).

result.intervention: Two-month intervention: staff education, reinforcement of documentation expectations and a standardised Braden documentation form.

cycle2.result: All six subscales 96.4-100%; total score 89.1%, risk level 83.6% and preventive actions 89.1%.

result.other_findings: Gaps in administrative documentation persisted.

result.setting: Peshawar Institute of Cardiology
result.standard: Outpatient follow-up within 14 days of discharge after acute decompensated heart failure (international guidelines)

cycle1.result: 14-day follow-up compliance 32 (53.33%); follow-up documented at discharge in 45 (75%); mean interval 12.43 ± 5.12 days.

result.intervention: Intervention phase June to July 2025 (content not described).
result.other_findings: Non-attendance fell from 10 (16.67%) to two (3.33%); follow-up after 14 days fell from 18 (30%) to three (5%).

result.setting: Operating theatres, Prince Osman Digna Hospital
result.standard: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist (Sign In, Time Out, Sign Out)

cycle1.result: Team introductions 22 (21.8%); anticipated critical steps 18 (17.8%); surgical counts 41 (40.6%); specimen labelling 28 (27.7%); nursing sterility confirmation 25 (24.8%).

result.intervention: Two-month intervention: staff education, standardised checklist documentation and regular feedback.

cycle2.result: Team introductions 86 (42.4%); critical steps 66 (32.5%); surgical counts 132 (65.0%); specimen labelling 96 (47.3%); sterility confirmation 184 (90.6%).

result.other_findings: Surgical site marking barely changed: 83 (82.2%) vs 161 (79.3%), p = 0.554.

result.topic: VTE risk assessment and prophylaxis in cancer inpatients
result.setting: Oncology department, King's College Hospital London, Dubai
result.standard: British Society for Haematology 2024: VTE risk assessment and prophylaxis within 24 hours of admission

cycle1.result: Risk assessment documented in 64.6% (n = 64); prophylaxis prescribed in 71.7% (n = 71), started within 14 h in 36.6% (n = 26); reassessment within 24 h in 12.1% (n = 12).

result.intervention: None yet; electronic templates, mandatory fields, clarified myeloma pathways and staff education recommended, with re-audit.
result.other_findings: Hospital-acquired thrombosis in 6.1% (n = 6); catheter-related thrombosis prevention documented in 4.0%.

result.topic: CT KUB for suspected renal colic
result.setting: Manchester Royal Infirmary (tertiary hospital), referrals from the emergency department
result.standard: National guidelines on CT KUB for renal colic (not named)

cycle1.result: Mean time from presentation to CT KUB report 14.7 ± 9.5 hours; sufficient history documented in 76.6%; nonspecific abdominal pain requests 9.1%.

result.intervention: Dissemination of findings and an educational programme.

cycle2.result: Mean time to report 8.2 ± 5.1 hours; sufficient history 89.5% (p = 0.034); nonspecific abdominal pain 0% (p = 0.007).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Routine outcome measure completion in mental health
result.setting: Renfrewshire Intensive Home Treatment Team, NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde
result.standard: Local policy: CORE-10 completed at admission and discharge

cycle1.result: Admission completion 4/29 (13.8%); discharge completion 1/29 (3.4%).

result.intervention: Structured teaching sessions, visual reminders and weekly MDT prompts.

cycle2.result: Admission completion 15/28 (53.6%), p = 0.002; discharge completion 1/28 (3.6%), p = 0.97.

result.other_findings: Discharge completion stayed poor.

result.setting: Cardiology inpatients (hospital not named)
result.standard: DVLA guidance: driving advice documented for cardiology patients who drive

cycle1.result: Driving advice in 19/33 (57.6%) discharge summaries and 15/33 (45.5%) patient notes.

result.intervention: Educational sessions and a discharge flowchart poster with a QR code to DVLA guidance, repeated after junior doctor changeover.

cycle2.result: Final cycle: 24/27 (88.9%) discharge summaries and 19/27 (74.4%) patient notes.

result.other_findings: Intermediate cycles: 15/21 (71.4%) and 11/21 (52.4%), then a fall to 14/23 (60.9%) and 13/23 (56.5%) after junior doctors changed.

result.setting: Community general practice
result.standard: British Society for Sexual Medicine and EAU guidance: blood tests (85%), CVD risk assessment (80%), low-cost PDE5 inhibitor (90%)

cycle1.result: Blood tests 41/50 (82%); CVD risk assessment 38/50 (76%); low-cost PDE5 inhibitors 45/50 (90%).

result.intervention: None yet; structured templates, coding and clinician awareness recommended, with re-audit.
result.other_findings: Only the prescribing standard was met.

result.setting: Undergraduate Education Department, Sandwell and West Birmingham Hospitals NHS Trust

cycle1.result: Mean clarity 2.5/5 and navigation 2.7/5; access details current 33%, role clarity 17%, induction sufficiency 0%, digital tools 83%.

result.intervention: Formal handover presentation, rewritten and reorganised handover document, and updated access information and signposting.

cycle2.result: Mean clarity 4.6/5 and navigation 4.8/5; all four process measures 100%.

result.other_findings: Measures were questionnaire ratings of perceived usability.

result.topic: Chlamydia conjunctivitis diagnosis and sexual health
result.setting: Tertiary ophthalmic emergency department and external eye disease service, Moorfields Eye Hospital

cycle1.result: Median time to diagnosis 14 days; incorrect initial diagnosis 63.6% (170/267); sexual history documented in 24.0% (64/267); appropriate systemic antibiotics 52.4% (140/267).

result.other_findings: Samples taken at first visit in only 13.1%; swab positivity rose from 1.9% to 3.2% despite fewer swabs.

result.topic: COX-2 inhibitor prescribing in aspirin-exacerbated respiratory disease
result.setting: ENT department, Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Trust

cycle1.result: 19 (43%) comfortable managing pain in AERD; six (13.6%) confident prescribing a COX-2 inhibitor.

result.intervention: Standard operating procedure with a test dose protocol.

cycle2.result: 14 (82.4%) confident prescribing COX-2 inhibitors; 16 (94.1%) found the SOP helpful.

result.other_findings: Survey of self-reported confidence; effect on prescribing behaviour not measured.

result.setting: Tertiary ICU, St George Hospital, Sydney
result.standard: Local guideline: document occurrence and time of verbal ICU-to-ward handover

cycle1.result: Verbal handover documented in 25/42 (59.5%); handover time documented in 9/25 (36.0%).

result.intervention: Visual prompt, verbal reinforcement at a department meeting and digital dissemination.

cycle2.result: Verbal handover documented in 37/43 (86.0%), p = 0.006; timing documented in 30/37 (81.1%), p < 0.001.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: nAMD referral to first injection time
result.setting: Luton and Dunstable University Hospital
result.standard: National audit standard: first anti-VEGF injection within two weeks of community referral

cycle1.result: Two-week referral-to-first-injection compliance 41% (33/81).

result.intervention: One-week internal assessment deadline, increased injection capacity and clinician awareness of referral timelines.
result.other_findings: Median referral to first appointment fell from 2 weeks to 1 week; no significant difference in early visual acuity or macular thickness.

result.setting: Operating theatre complex, Atbara Teaching Hospital
result.standard: 27 criteria from international infection prevention guidelines across five domains

cycle1.result: Head cover 47.7%; scrubbing before gowning or gloving 50.0%; correct gowning 44.4%; anaesthetist hand hygiene 22.2%; correct sterile opening sequence 44.4%.

result.intervention: Education, audit feedback, visual reminders and multidisciplinary engagement.

cycle2.result: Head cover 70.7%; scrubbing 88.2%; gowning 91.3%; anaesthetist hand hygiene 69.6%; sterile opening sequence 95.7% (all domains p<0.05).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, rural district general hospital, NHS Grampian
result.standard: RCS England CCrISP framework: five criteria (A-E assessment, sepsis assessment, stability, blood gas or lactate, management plan)

cycle1.result: A-E assessment 0%; sepsis assessment 0%; patient stability 26.7%; management plan 60%; blood gas or lactate 73.3%.

result.intervention: CCrISP-based Surgical Take Proforma with staff education via Teams and face-to-face.

cycle2.result: A-E assessment 80%; sepsis assessment 46.7%; stability 93.3%; management plan 100%; blood gas or lactate 86.7% (p=0.333).

result.other_findings: The proforma was later built into a Patient Management Record template.

result.topic: Geriatric long-term and day hospital care standards
result.setting: 17 nursing homes and geriatric long-stay wards; 27 geriatric day hospitals
result.standard: Royal College of Physicians CARE scheme (long-term care) and RCP geriatric day hospital audit scheme

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.dates: Eight months (long-term care) and six months (day hospitals) after cycle 1
cycle2.result: Improvement outweighed deterioration in all domains of geriatric care.

result.other_findings: Paper mainly describes methods for analysing sequential audits.

result.setting: 16 of 18 endoscopy units, Northern region
result.standard: Regionally agreed 12-item standard for endoscopy information leaflets

cycle1.result: Leaflets included 35% (range 8-67%) of standard items.

result.intervention: Each unit given a comparison of its leaflet with the standard.

cycle2.result: All 11 units with new leaflets had made changes; 80% of items included overall.

result.other_findings: Common omissions were risks, follow-up, obtaining results, diabetes advice and a contact number.

result.setting: Large city teaching hospital (Glasgow Royal Infirmary)
result.standard: Checklist of important aspects of acute asthma management

cycle1.result: Oral corticosteroids 69 (68%); oxygen 62 (61%).

result.other_findings: Intermediate 1985-6 survey (85 patients): corticosteroids 67 (79%), oxygen 51 (60%).

result.topic: Meningitis notification, chemoprophylaxis and hearing referral
result.setting: Royal Belfast Hospital for Sick Children
result.standard: Statutory notification, nationally agreed chemoprophylaxis and hearing assessment for all survivors

cycle1.result: Notified 20/36 (56%); chemoprophylaxis to 5/23 (22%) index cases; audiology arranged for 19/32 (59%) survivors.

result.intervention: Written information for all doctors including each junior intake, and guidelines displayed on wards.
result.other_findings: Notification still below 100%.

result.setting: All health trusts in Scotland

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Implementation usually involved baseline audit, a local version and re-audit, led by guideline groups.

result.setting: Scottish Clinical Audit Project Register

cycle1.result: 613 of 7,073 entries (9%) related to children, who make up 19% of the population.

result.other_findings: Only 5% of projects were in primary care; loop closure could not be assessed from the register.

result.setting: Paediatric outpatient department, Manor Hospital, Walsall

cycle1.result: Non-attendance 34% (32.5% Europeans, 50% Asian patients).

result.other_findings: Lowest non-attendance of 30 West Midlands hospitals in 1996-7.

result.setting: Milton Keynes Hospital

cycle1.result: Day-case rate 16%; successful day-case allocation 56%.

result.intervention: 23-hour stay ward established, adding a third option.
result.other_findings: 537 patients over five years.

result.setting: Academic Surgical Unit, Castle Hill Hospital
result.standard: British Society of Gastroenterology 1998 acute pancreatitis guidelines (e.g. mortality <10%, <30% in severe AP)

cycle1.result: Mortality 17% (standard <10%), 56% in severe AP (<30%); diagnosis within 48 h 100%; severity stratification about 80%; CRP measured in 51%; aetiology found in 77% (75-80%).

result.intervention: None yet; prospective re-audit of 1999 admissions planned.
result.other_findings: All severe cases managed in HDU/ITU with CT; 86% with suspected CBD stones had ERCP.

result.setting: All 13 hospitals in the South West of England
result.standard: Minimum clinical dataset; proposed targets 100% FIGO staging and 95% appropriate radical surgery

cycle1.result: Retrospective audit; results not reported in abstract.

result.intervention: Prospective collection of a defined minimum dataset on paper forms.

cycle2.result: FIGO staging 92% (98% for cases above Stage Ia); tumour diameter not measured in 20% and thickness in 28%.

result.other_findings: Possibly inappropriate conservative surgery in 10/165 (6%).

result.setting: Ninewells Hospital, Dundee
result.standard: Local thromboprophylaxis protocol for caesarean section

cycle1.result: Overtreatment of low-risk and undertreatment of high-risk women.

result.intervention: Routine computer-generated risk assessment profile added to the maternity information system.

cycle2.result: Significant improvement in protocol adherence in all risk groups.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: O&G departments in UK NHS hospitals (hospital recognition visits)
result.standard: Seven RCOG Clinical Audit Unit quality criteria for audit

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: Significant improvement in audit quality over time.

result.other_findings: Improvements in critical incident monitoring, patient satisfaction surveys and re-audit.

result.setting: Academic Division of Child Health, University Hospital Nottingham
result.standard: Local management protocol for community acquired pneumonia

cycle1.result: 26% received intravenous penicillin or erythromycin.

result.other_findings: PCR raised diagnostic yield: 51 diagnoses in 48 of 89 children.

result.setting: Fast Access Breast Clinic, Eastbourne District General Hospital
result.standard: Two-week wait guarantee for suspected breast cancer

cycle1.result: Cancer detection 22%; all cancers seen within 1 week; GP referral accuracy 42%; routine wait 4 weeks.

cycle2.result: Cancer detection 19%; 85% seen within 2 weeks; GP accuracy 49%; routine wait at least 8 weeks.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Teaching hospital vitreoretinal unit (Addenbrooke's) and three district general hospitals

cycle1.result: Single-procedure reattachment 76.1%.

result.intervention: Primary retinal reattachment surgery centralised in the specialist vitreoretinal unit.
result.other_findings: VRU specialists 90% vs DGH general ophthalmologists 47-77%.

result.setting: Department of Otolaryngology, Leeds General Infirmary

cycle1.result: 36 responders; 50% consulted their GP for pain; many had moderately severe to severe pain.

result.intervention: Five days of discharge analgesia and improved written discharge advice.

cycle2.result: 56 responders; GP consultation 27%; moderately severe to severe pain not reduced.

result.other_findings: Paracetamol and ibuprofen gave better analgesia than paracetamol and dihydrocodeine (p <0.05).

result.setting: Radiology Department, Royal Infirmary Edinburgh

cycle1.result: Resuscitation knowledge below 70% in all staff groups; radiologists' mean 50%.

result.intervention: Retraining, guidelines and handouts, then wallcharts, lectures and regular feedback.

cycle2.result: All staff groups surpassed the required standard.

result.other_findings: Three full audit cycles completed.

result.topic: Audit cycles in GP registrar assessment
result.setting: Training practices, West of Scotland

cycle1.result: All 57 registrars completed an audit cycle, seven (12%) after resubmission; marking sensitivity 95%, specificity 77%.

result.other_findings: 116 trainers (89%) agreed two data collections are essential or desirable.

result.setting: ENT unit, University Hospital Lewisham
result.standard: Treatment protocol for acute otitis externa

cycle1.result: Heterogeneous approach and clinical isolation of junior staff.

result.intervention: Treatment protocol, GP liaison and education, and open access aural toilet.

cycle2.result: Treatment protocols effective and adhered to by junior staff.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Accident and emergency department, Gloucestershire Royal Hospital
result.standard: Nine predetermined documentation standards for NAI in pre-school burns and scalds

cycle1.result: Documentation of NAI was poor; referral for further opinion 0%.

result.intervention: NAI education programme and a reminder checklist in A&E notes.

cycle2.result: Significant increases in several documentation items; checklist included in 60% of notes and completed in 97% of those; referral 3%.

result.other_findings: The child protection register was rarely consulted.

result.setting: HIV clinics, Yorkshire region

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: Overall improvement in ART prescribing; one clinic still had many patients on suboptimal treatment.

result.other_findings: Patient choice explained much of the suboptimal prescribing.

result.setting: Experienced general practitioners

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Grounded theory study; trainers modelling change based on completed audit cycles was valued.

result.setting: All 17 neonatal intensive care units, Northern Region of England
result.standard: National ROP screening guidelines; standard 100% compliance

result.setting: ICU, Emergency Department and Short Stay Rooms, Aswan University Hospital

cycle1.result: Antibiotics prescribed in 26% of admissions; 16% of patients not meeting criteria received antibiotics; 62% of prescriptions met consensus criteria. (126 episodes across both periods.)

result.intervention: Targeted education: guideline-focused presentations at unit meetings, emails and posters in clinical areas, and brief electronic reminder messages.

cycle2.result: Antibiotic prescribing 22% of admissions (p = 0.57); prescribing in patients not meeting criteria 6% (p = 0.30); prescriptions meeting criteria 80% (p = 0.43).

result.other_findings: Baseline antibiotic use was lower than published rates but still exceeded expected coinfection prevalence; changes were not statistically significant.

result.topic: Prescription quality and rational drug use

result.standard: Prescription completeness and rational drug use indicators (OPD number, legibility, generic prescribing, drugs per prescription, antibiotic use, allergy documentation)
