result.standard: BHIVA national clinical audit of routine monitoring and assessment of HIV/HCV coinfection

cycle1.result: 56% of people with detectable HCV RNA had not received HCV treatment, mainly due to lack of engagement (54.7%) or being uncontactable (16.4%).

result.other_findings: 29 (30.5%) clinics reported COVID-19 impact on coinfection care; only 4.9% of about 3951 coinfected people had detectable HCV RNA.

result.setting: Participating trusts in a regional trainee-led audit (West Midlands)
result.standard: Malnutrition screening using MUST and Royal Free Hospital-Nutritional Prioritisation Tool

cycle1.result: Prevalence of malnutrition 76.6%.

result.other_findings: RFH-NPT more sensitive than MUST; more screening on gastroenterology wards; earlier dietitian involvement proposed.

result.setting: Blank anaesthetic charts from 132 ANZCA-accredited hospitals across Australia and New Zealand
result.standard: 17 clinically important airway data fields (ANZCA guidelines do not specify)

cycle1.result: 99% of charts prompted for intubation; 95% had at least one supraglottic airway field; 58% had a bag-mask ventilation difficulty field and 1.5% any bag-mask outcome measure.

result.other_findings: Fields for bag-mask ventilation and supraglottic airway were inconsistent.

result.setting: Eight expert centres of the VASCERN paediatric and primary lymphoedema working group

cycle1.result: Congenital 30.4%, late-onset 35.9%, vascular/lymphatic malformations 19.3%, secondary 4.4%; median delay to expert centre 2.4 years.

result.other_findings: Nearly 10% had cellulitis; genetic testing in 44.4% of primary cases with 35.8% molecular diagnosis.

result.topic: Mismatch repair testing in recurrent colorectal cancer
result.setting: High-volume surgical unit, Royal Prince Alfred Hospital, New South Wales

cycle1.result: MMR profile changed in 9 (10.6%); IHC testing completed after 88.7% of primary and 39.3% of recurrent resections.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Preoperative sickle cell screening in children
result.setting: Anaesthesiology departments of 14 HSE-funded Irish public hospitals delivering paediatric anaesthesia

cycle1.result: 11 of 14 hospitals responded; 3 of 11 had formal policies, with varying ethnicities identified for screening.

result.other_findings: No national policy exists; a targeted national guideline is recommended.

result.setting: 15 of 19 maternity units, national clinical audit on critical care

cycle1.result: Critical care rate 1 in 131 live births; 900 of 960 needed level 2 care only; hypertensive disorders 1 in 242, haemorrhage 1 in 422, infection 1 in 926.

result.other_findings: 15.7% had more than one diagnosis, accounting for 40% of level 3 care; ICU admission not a reliable proxy for level 2/3 care.

result.setting: Eight NHS hospitals, head and neck cancer surgery with immediate free flap reconstruction

cycle1.result: Complete flap failure 4.7%, with no statistical difference between hospitals; champion model AUROC 0.66 used to risk-adjust CuSUM charts.

result.other_findings: CuSUM charts proposed for a live dashboard in the oral and maxillofacial surgery quality outcomes audit.

result.topic: Tympanostomy tubes in paediatric otitis media
result.setting: Otolaryngology outpatient department, Galway University Hospital (tertiary referral centre)
result.standard: 2022 AAO-HNS Clinical Practice Guideline for Tympanostomy Tubes in Children

cycle1.result: Decision to offer tympanostomy tubes was guideline appropriate in 76.1% (35/46).

result.intervention: Educational session within the otolaryngology department.
result.other_findings: 72.7% of children presented with suspected otitis media with effusion.

result.topic: Compression therapy for lower limb wounds
result.setting: Six community provider sites in England (community nursing, podiatry and primary care)

cycle1.result: Compression use over 96% in community leg ulcer clinics (234 residents), 14-62% at home (692 residents) and 12% where wound cause unknown (263 residents).

result.other_findings: 65% of those aged over 80 not receiving compression at three sites; non-use of compression increased nursing activity by 37%.

result.setting: Teaching hospital and district general hospital firms (Leeds General Infirmary)

cycle1.result: Both firms saw similar numbers of inpatients, half with non-respiratory disease; 80% of outpatient work was respiratory.

result.other_findings: The teaching hospital firm saw more referrals from other consultants and referred more patients.

result.setting: UK GUM/Integrated Sexual Health Services (level 3 STI services), BASHH national audit
result.standard: BASHH national guidance for management of infection with Neisseria gonorrhoeae (2018), six audit standards

cycle1.result: Standard for first-line treatment narrowly missed; the other five national audit standards were not met (no figures in abstract).

result.other_findings: No case of possible ceftriaxone treatment failure reported to PHE.

result.topic: Investigation of hypercalcaemia in primary care
result.setting: Primary care in Glasgow (about 125 GP practices), laboratory requests

cycle1.result: 1423 (2.3%) had hypercalcaemia; 45.8% normalised on repeat; of 400 with persistent hypercalcaemia, 210 (52.5%) had PTH measured.

result.other_findings: Serum calcium checked in 10.6% of the population per year.

result.setting: UK multisite small animal primary-care emergency practice
result.standard: Nine audit criteria for clinical management of canine dystocia (21 variables in later phases)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Knowledge dissemination activities between data collection phases.

cycle2.result: Statistically significant increases between 2014 and 2021 (details truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: Three data collection phases (2014, 2019, 2021).

result.setting: Three oral and maxillofacial units in south east England

cycle1.result: Positive peripheral or deep margin 15.4% at Unit 1, 21.1% at Unit 2 and 15.4% at Unit 3; models AUROC 0.67 (BCC) and 0.71 (SCC).

result.other_findings: Risk-adjusted margin rates proposed for fair comparison of unit performance.

result.topic: Androgen deprivation therapy before prostate cancer surgery
result.setting: 187 hospitals in 31 European countries
result.standard: EAU guideline: do not offer neoadjuvant ADT before surgery for prostate cancer

cycle1.result: Overall nonadherence 2% (range 0-32%); high-risk subgroup nonadherence 4% (range 0-43%).

result.other_findings: Reasons for nonadherence included improving oncological outcomes, long waiting lists and patient preference.

result.setting: NHS mental health services in England and Wales, national audit of policies
result.standard: Relevant guidance and legislation on leave (65 criteria across four domains)

cycle1.result: 57 (91.9%) policies obtained; domain consistency 72.3% administrative, 64.0% Responsible Clinician, 44.7% types of leave, 41.9% nursing.

result.other_findings: Definitions of leave terms varied widely and often differed from guidance.

result.topic: Persistent headache after accidental dural puncture
result.setting: Pain medicine clinic, University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust

cycle1.result: Pharmacological management effective in 17/52 (33%); GON block gave durable benefit in 18/21 (86%); all 3 PRF patients benefited.

result.other_findings: Mean follow-up 5.7 years; 14/35 refused nerve block.

result.setting: Hospitals, hospices and specialist palliative care units across the UK, one-day flash-mob audit
result.standard: National guidelines requiring risk assessment and appropriate thromboprophylaxis for hospitalised patients

cycle1.result: Appropriate thromboprophylaxis in 90% of hospital and 90% of hospice patients; documented risk assessment in 79% and 71% respectively.

result.other_findings: Pharmacological prophylaxis contraindicated in 88% of hospice patients and 24% of hospital patients.

result.setting: Federally Qualified Health Center (CMC Healthcare for the Homeless, Manchester, New Hampshire)

cycle1.result: Mean CRC screening rate 33.7%.

result.intervention: Team-based approach with strong provider recommendation, chart audit, and mailed FIT and colonoscopy reminder letters over 4 months (PDSA).

cycle2.result: Screening rate reached 40% within 4 months; second chart audit showed 41.5% among patients aged 50-75.

result.other_findings: 55% return rate for mailed FIT within 2 months; benchmark not yet achieved.

result.setting: 3426 primary care physicians and paediatricians in Switzerland, randomised trial

cycle1.result: Median antibiotic prescribing rate per 100 consultations 8.2 in intervention vs 8.4 in control in year two; relative difference -0.1%.

result.intervention: Quarterly personalised antibiotic prescribing audit and feedback with peer benchmarking.
result.other_findings: Randomised trial; only quinolone prescribing fell (-0.9%).

result.setting: Tertiary pain medicine clinic, University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust

cycle1.result: 56 received Intervention I; 48/56 (86%) significant benefit at 12 weeks, 38/56 (68%) durable relief at 24 weeks; all 9 given Intervention II reported durable relief.

result.other_findings: Emergency admissions and opioid use were reduced.

result.topic: Potentially inappropriate medications at ED discharge in older adults
result.setting: Eight VA emergency departments, cluster-randomised trial

cycle1.result: Baseline PIM prescribing 8.01% (academic detailing) vs 8.04% (dashboard); after 12 months 7.07% vs 8.10% (OR 1.14, p <= 0.0001).

result.intervention: Audit and feedback via academic detailing vs centralised dashboard in the EQUIPPED programme.
result.other_findings: Randomised comparison of implementation strategies using Beers Criteria.

result.setting: Private obstetric practice, University of Limerick Maternity Hospital

cycle1.result: Caesarean section rate maintained at 19% for the last 10 years.

result.other_findings: Low rate attributed to VBACs and rotational Kiwi deliveries.

result.setting: Gynaecology Emergency Department, Liverpool Women's NHS Foundation Trust (single-site gynaecology and maternity hospital)
result.standard: Trust Outpatient Medical Management of Miscarriage Guideline (Guideline 2), five standards

cycle1.result: Compliance fell short mainly on standard 1 (baseline point-of-care haemoglobin test) and standard 5 (follow-up phone call); compliance was higher for standards 3 and 4 (prescribing and administering treatment).

result.intervention: Proposed: further training in the clinical setting and creation of a checklist.
result.other_findings: 15% of patients required further intervention: admission for observation (9%) and surgery to complete the miscarriage (6%).

result.setting: BreastSurgANZ Quality Audit prospective population-based database, low- and high-volume hospitals
result.standard: 2017 EUSOMA breast cancer quality indicators and thresholds

cycle1.result: Low-volume hospitals met the quality threshold for 10 EUSOMA QIs and high-volume hospitals for 8 (MDT discussion, surgical approach, adjuvant radiotherapy in low-volume hospitals, avoidance of overtreatment, endocrine therapy). Thresholds not met for neoadjuvant chemotherapy use and adjuvant radiotherapy in high-volume hospitals.

result.other_findings: Data capture completeness needs improvement, including genetic syndrome and Ki67% fields.

result.topic: National anaesthetic activity and patient characteristics
result.setting: 352 of 416 UK hospital sites delivering anaesthesia (NAP7 activity survey)

cycle1.result: Descriptive survey: median age of non-obstetric patients rose from 50.5 to 52.8 years and median BMI from 24.9 to 26.7 kg/m2 between NAP5 (2013) and NAP7; ASA 1 fell from 37% to 24%; TIVA use rose from 8% to 26% of general anaesthetics.

result.other_findings: Patients with confirmed COVID-19 accounted for 149 (1%) cases.

result.setting: The Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust, ward-based care

cycle1.result: Scoping exercise found a need to address the lack of oral healthcare provision in the trust (no figures given).

result.intervention: Multidisciplinary group developed an oral healthcare assessment tool rolled out trust-wide, with online training for nurses.
result.other_findings: An audit of oral healthcare products used in the trust and their appropriateness was undertaken at the same time.

result.topic: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy use in breast cancer
result.setting: BreastSurgANZ Quality Audit of Breast Cancer Care prospective database

cycle1.result: Use of neoadjuvant chemotherapy increased annually (OR 1.26); rest of results truncated in abstract.

result.other_findings: Authors call for expanded data fields and detailed audit of NACT rates in stage II-III TNBC and HER2-enriched cancer.

result.topic: Hydroxyurea prescribing in sickle cell anaemia
result.setting: Three paediatric haematology centres (EMBRACE SCD project), Florida
result.standard: Project aim: increase hydroxyurea prescription rate by at least 10% from baseline in eligible children aged 9 months-18 years with sickle cell anaemia not on chronic transfusion

cycle1.result: 50.2% of 524 eligible patients had hydroxyurea prescribed at initial measurement.

result.intervention: Model for Improvement PDSA cycles: health belief model discussions, visual aid and ASH brochure, Barrier Assessment Questionnaire, re-discussion when declined, and chart audits for missed prescribing opportunities with feedback.

cycle2.result: Mean performance 59% (11% increase in mean performance); last measurement 64.8% prescribed (29% increase from initial).

result.other_findings: Mean performance after 10 data points was 53%. Of 168 who completed the barrier questionnaire, 32 (19%) refused, mostly from not perceiving enough severity or fearing side effects.

result.setting: Inpatients, Northumbria Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Pilot in 304 patients: 172 excluded and 132 successful direct oral penicillin challenges; one adverse event (acute kidney injury, delayed after 22 days of penicillin).

result.intervention: Development of CATALYST five-step pharmacist-led process (assessment, criteria, consent, direct oral challenge, removal of label) with continuous PDSA cycle.
result.other_findings: Only 64% of permanent GP-held records were appropriately updated when audited at the end of the pilot.

result.setting: 12 centres in England
result.standard: NICE guidance: FFR-CT only in patients with stable chest pain and equivocal stenosis (50%-69%)

cycle1.dates: 3 years of central funding in England
cycle1.result: Stable chest pain was the main symptom in 77% and 40% had equivocal stenosis (NICE criteria met in three-fourths for symptoms and 40% for stenosis).

result.other_findings: FFR-CT positive and negative predictive values were 49% and 76%; strategy cost £2,102 per patient versus £1,411 for stress imaging.

result.topic: Equity of access to special care dental services
result.setting: Crawley Special Care Dental Centre, Sussex Community NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Ethnic group proportions of service users reflected the demographic profile of Crawley; failed appointments showed no correlation with deprivation decile or ethnic group.

result.other_findings: Audit found minimal inequities in utilisation.

result.topic: Opioid prescribing on discharge after surgery
result.setting: Department of Surgery, Galway Clinic (single institution)

cycle1.result: Considerable variability in opioid prescribing after inguinal hernia repair (112), laparoscopic cholecystectomy (116) and colonic resection (72); detailed figures truncated in abstract.

result.other_findings: Authors call for opioid prescription guidelines.

result.topic: Melanoma diagnostic accuracy in general practice
result.setting: 27 Australasian GPs on the Skin Cancer Audit Research Database

cycle1.result: Average number needed to treat 5.73 and percentage in situ 65.07%; GPs discovered 73.9% of melanomas as lesions of concern.

result.other_findings: For 21 GPs in both studies, NNT fell from 10.78 (2008-2010) to 5.56 (p = 0.0037).

result.setting: Nine clinical areas of an Australian metropolitan health service

cycle1.result: Qualitative focus groups: nurses value QI but want involvement, feel failed audit does not equal failed care, and report unintended consequences of documenting for audit.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Medical inpatients, district general hospital (Royal Cornwall Hospitals NHS Trust)
result.standard: National audit tool of antibiotic prescribing appropriateness (UK AMR strategy)

cycle1.result: Of 1658 antibiotic days of therapy, 403 (24%) were excess, in 92 patients (50%); 112/403 (27.8%) at initiation, 184/403 (45.7%) at pre-72-hour review, 107/403 (26.6%) from protracted courses.

result.other_findings: The pre-72-hour antibiotic review was the greatest opportunity to reduce use.

result.topic: Pancreatic enzyme replacement in pancreatic cancer
result.setting: OpenSAFELY-TPP primary care electronic health records, England
result.standard: UK guidelines: pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy for all people with unresectable pancreatic cancer (100% standard)

result.standard: Roper, Logan and Tierney Activities of Living model and the nursing process

result.standard: All postmenopausal women with acute MI, barring contraindication, prescribed HRT before discharge

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: Local guidelines 91% (41/45); endoscopy 86%; within 24 hours 56%; CVP monitoring 43%; mortality 14.4% (no significant change).

result.setting: Greater Glasgow (West of Scotland Cancer Registry)

cycle1.result: 39 of 127 basal cell carcinomas (31%) and 11 of 25 squamous cell carcinomas (44%) not registered.

result.other_findings: Dermatologists rarely treated suspicious tumours without histological proof.

result.setting: Northern Ireland Haematology Audit Group (Northern Ireland Blood Transfusion Service)

cycle1.result: Blood bank filtered platelets: reactions 2/101 (2%); filtered and washed: 0/91; bedside filtration: 19/95 (20%), two very severe.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.standard: CESDI Pathology Audit Form 93; recommended autopsy rate 75%

cycle1.result: Autopsy rate 47.4%; 46.6% of autopsies failed to reach an adequate standard (only 4.9% of inadequate ones from the Regional Centre).

result.other_findings: 21% had metastatic disease at presentation.

result.topic: Audit and postgraduate education uptake in dental practice

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Survey compared with a 1989 survey; results not given in the abstract.

result.setting: Maternity services in one NHS Trust (Changing Childbirth pilot)

cycle1.result: No evidence of lower clinical standards in the study group.

result.other_findings: Casenote records found to be an imperfect source for audit; direct observation to be added.

result.setting: Free-standing children's hospital (Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford)
result.standard: Institutional and/or national guidelines for antimicrobial choice, dose, frequency, duration, formulation and indication

cycle1.result: 243/1192 (20%) discharge prescriptions suboptimal; reasons duration (16%), dose (8%), frequency (5%), choice/formulation/route (≤1%). Cephalexin 80/167 (48%), amoxicillin-clavulanate 89/203 (44%) suboptimal.

result.other_findings: Inpatient prospective audit and feedback was identified for 675 (57%) prescriptions and was associated with fewer suboptimal discharge prescriptions (8% vs 36%).

result.setting: 30-bed independent care home intermediate care unit with NHS multidisciplinary team (SEHSCT, Dundonald)
result.standard: Template based on National Audit of Intermediate Care quality indicators

cycle1.result: Baseline nursing team confidence in handover measured by semi-structured interviews and weighted questionnaire; figures not reported.

result.intervention: Care-home specific shared electronic nursing handover template developed over four iterations.

cycle2.result: 70% reported increased or slightly increased confidence in addressing questions from residents or relatives, responding to change in health status, and giving handover to ambulance crew, doctor or nurse.

result.other_findings: Outcome was staff confidence by questionnaire rather than compliance with a standard.

result.topic: Fitness to drive assessment and DVLA advice
result.setting: General adult and old age psychiatry inpatient units across Dudley and Walsall (3 sites)
result.standard: Assessment and documentation of fitness to drive at admission and discharge, patient education and awareness of duty to inform the DVLA

cycle1.result: 18/49 patients had physical health screening prior to medication initiation (only result reported).

result.other_findings: Authors conclude clinicians need educating about fitness to drive assessment, especially at inpatient discharge.

result.setting: Acute psychiatric ward (John Dickson Ward, Maudsley Hospital, London)
result.standard: Documented ECG for patients admitted to the acute ward

cycle1.result: 37/50 (74%) had a documented ECG; 2/50 (4%) not offered.

result.intervention: New live, editable handover tool on MS Teams replaced an MS Word handover document on 5/8/20.

cycle2.result: 37/50 (74%) had a documented ECG; no improvement.

result.other_findings: Patients admitted before and discharged after the junior doctor changeover had fewer ECGs: 6/18 (33%), with 3/18 (17%) not offered.

result.setting: Three mental health inpatient units (Heddfan, Ablett, Hergest), Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board, North Wales
result.standard: RCPsych Standards for Inpatient Mental Health Services (2014) and PRSB Mental Health Discharge guidelines (2018)

cycle1.result: Allergy status not mentioned in 96% of Hergest summaries; summary reached GP on day of discharge in 13% Ablett, 0% Hergest, 100% Heddfan; risk history 0% Hergest and Heddfan, 12% Ablett; crisis contacts 0% across the Health Board.

result.other_findings: In 49% of Ablett summaries medication was the only field completed; care coordinator details were in 0% of Heddfan and Ablett summaries.

result.setting: Psychiatry of Old Age service, North-West of Ireland (Liscarney House)
result.standard: NICE 2014, BNF 2019 and Maudsley Prescribing Guidelines 2018: 3-monthly serum lithium and renal tests

cycle1.result: 78% (n = 14) on track for 3-monthly lithium level; 83% (n = 15) met 3-monthly renal tests; thyroid function 89% (n = 16); serum calcium 63%; 39% (n = 7) lithium level in therapeutic range 0.6-0.8mmol/L.

result.other_findings: 100% had abnormal renal function on most recent bloods, and 56% (n = 5) of those started by the service had renal impairment before initiation.

result.topic: Suicide and self-harm risk assessment in depression
result.setting: Primary care practice (Reedyford Healthcare Group, Nelson, England)
result.standard: NICE guideline for adults with depression: 100% asked direct questions about suicidal ideation and intent; 100% at significant risk referred to specialist mental health services same day

cycle1.result: 42/62 patients asked direct questions about self-harm and suicide; 2 patients at immediate risk were urgently referred.

result.other_findings: A quality improvement approach was planned.

result.topic: Physical health checks in psychiatric inpatients
result.setting: Acute psychiatric inpatient ward (Kingfisher Court, Watford)
result.standard: Completion of electronic physical health form within 24 and 72 hours of admission

cycle1.result: Form completion 88%; 24-hour completion 47% and 72-hour completion 55%.

result.intervention: Ward handover sheet columns added showing outstanding parts of physical clerking; later a physical health huddle in the MDT.
result.other_findings: 266 admissions analysed in total across both periods; a biweekly physical health clinic was recommended.

result.setting: Mental Health and Learning Disabilities division, Aneurin Bevan University Health Board (Royal Gwent, Ysbyty Ystrad Fawr, Nevill Hall)
result.standard: NMC guidance on remote prescribing (written follow-up of verbal orders)

cycle1.result: Round 1 survey of 26 nurses and 27 doctors on PRN sedating medication attitudes; e.g. 19% of nurses would request haloperidol without a recent ECG and 12% lorazepam above BNF maximum.

result.intervention: Digital verbal-order form completed by the nurse and emailed back by the junior doctor, with prompts on QTc, vital signs and medication; publicised by email, forums and induction.

cycle2.result: Round 2 survey of 8 nurses and 8 doctors: 6 doctors and 2 nurses reported the new system safer; 7/8 nurses found it more time consuming and 75% said it put up barriers.

result.other_findings: Survey-based QI rather than audit against measured practice; response rate fell in round 2.

result.topic: PRN psychotropic use in intellectual disability
result.setting: Community intellectual disability service, Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board
result.standard: Standards for PRN psychotropic protocols for behavioural disturbance (protocol accessible, indications, de-escalation, maximum dose, recording)

cycle1.result: Medical file standards 100% achieved; PRN protocol standards achieved in only 53% of cases.

result.other_findings: Gaps included descriptions of when to use PRN, non-drug de-escalation, expected effect, minimum interval between doses and 24-hour maximum dose.

result.setting: Two acute inpatient psychiatric units, Fieldhead Hospital, South West Yorkshire Partnership Trust
result.standard: POMH-UK: BMI, blood pressure, blood glucose and lipids checked at least once per year in patients on continuing antipsychotics

cycle1.result: Lipid profile 68%, BMI 71%, blood glucose 74%, blood pressure 87% screened.

result.other_findings: Authors recommend a tailored physical health monitoring guideline and staff training.

result.setting: High dependency psychiatric rehabilitation unit (Delfryn House, Cygnet Health Care)
result.standard: Safe prescription and administration of psychotropic medication; Mental Health Act 1983 treatment certificate compliance

cycle1.result: Prescription errors 19%; administration errors 34%; Mental Health Act documentation compliance 77%; patient knowledge of medication 15%.

result.intervention: Medication management committee with PDSA cycles: inpatient depot clinics, daily 10-point nurse self-audit, handover medication compliance updates, monthly pharmacist and prescription audits, patient leaflets and policy awareness.

cycle2.result: Prescription errors 3%; administration errors 11%; Mental Health Act documentation compliance 98%; patient knowledge 32%.

result.other_findings: No significant improvement in documenting drug interactions or adverse events raised by pharmacists; depot errors fell then rose again and the weekly depot clinic was abandoned.

result.setting: High dependency unit and acute ward, Nepean Mental Health Centre, Sydney
result.standard: Individual and combined antipsychotic doses within recommended maximum (TGA, Medsafe, Therapeutic Guidelines): target 100%

cycle1.result: 13/30 (43.3%) on >100% of cumulative maximum dose; 3 (10%) above maximum for regular antipsychotics; 0/30 above maximum for PRN.

result.setting: Large rural GP practice, Cumbria
result.standard: Individualised shared-care lithium monitoring agreement with the local mental health trust

cycle1.result: 26% of patients needing an annual ECG had one in the past year; lithium level in previous 3 months 78%; renal function within requirements 81%; lipids in previous year 52%.

result.other_findings: Standards with a QOF incentive were more likely to be met.

result.setting: 19 of 39 inpatient and outpatient mental health units across North Wales (BCUHB)
result.standard: Public Health England guidance on PPE donning and doffing

cycle1.result: About 50% donned PPE correctly (Central 85%, West 22%); only 21% doffed correctly.

result.other_findings: No designated donning/doffing areas in outpatient units; teaching, reminders and designated areas were planned.

result.setting: Four community mental health team clozapine clinics, Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board
result.standard: BCUHB guidelines and NICE annual physical health monitoring for clozapine

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Audit followed a coroner's investigation; results were not given in the abstract.

result.topic: Physical health checks in psychiatric inpatients
result.setting: High dependency unit and acute ward, Nepean Hospital Mental Health Centre, Sydney

cycle1.result: 88.4% had baseline blood tests; almost half had no baseline ECG and one third had no physical examination.

result.other_findings: Physical examination rates were better than in 2017 and 2018, when half and more than a third respectively had none.

result.setting: Memory clinic outpatient setting, Southern Health and Social Care Trust
result.standard: Completion of 'notification of diagnosis' forms for the dementia register; project aim 50% of new MCI or dementia patients within 3 months

cycle1.result: 12/40 (30%) patients with MCI or dementia were on the dementia register (random sample of 52 from 380 on the memory clinic list).

result.intervention: Awareness raising and placing the form in all new patients' notes.

cycle2.result: 50% completion (plus one patient already on the register).

result.other_findings: Completion was 75% in November 2020 and 66.7% in December, declining as forms stopped being placed in notes.

result.setting: Three mental health inpatient units, Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (Bryn Y Neuadd Hospital)
result.standard: NICE Quality Standard QS3: all patients receive a VTE and bleeding risk assessment on admission

cycle1.result: 8% of patients in one unit (n = 48) had a documented risk assessment; none in the other two units (n = 39, 44).

result.other_findings: Where assessments were documented, subsections were 100% complete; a checklist in the clerking proforma was recommended.

result.setting: Two inpatient wards (General Medicine and General Surgery), trust-wide project
result.standard: Trust antimicrobial stewardship criteria: sample collection before antibiotics, timely antibiotic review and documentation, microbiology discussion for restricted antibiotics

cycle1.result: Estimated baseline compliance: sample collection 60%, timely review and documentation 65%, microbiology discussion of restricted antibiotics 50%.

result.intervention: Teaching sessions, two trust-wide posters, on-site teaching and barrier analysis.

cycle2.result: Improvements of 5%-10% for sample collection, 20%-25% for timely reviews and 20%-25% for microbiology discussions.

result.other_findings: Surgical specialties needed extra support, leading to a weekly microbiology ward round.

result.topic: Central venous access device indications and antibiotic choice
result.setting: not reported

cycle1.result: Good evidence of infection needing IV antibiotics in 49/52; antibiotic selection in line with guidelines in 71.4%, most exceptions discussed with a microbiologist.

result.other_findings: Poor online documentation meant compliance with CVAD request guidelines could not be confirmed in all cases.

result.setting: Single centre, University of Calgary
result.standard: Clinical guidelines: surveillance cross-sectional imaging (CT or MRI) for at least 10 years after resection

cycle1.result: Mean follow-up 71 months; mean 7 scans, 1.1 scans per person-year; CT 38% (n=166), MRI 39% (n=170), nuclear medicine 15% (n=61) of surveillance scans.

result.other_findings: In cases resected over 10 years before (n=8) mean follow-up was 119 months; practice was judged generally in line with guidelines.

result.setting: Tertiary-care comprehensive cancer centre

cycle1.result: 5-year progression-free survival 87.9% and overall survival 92.8% at median follow-up 66 months (n = 54 in survival analysis).

result.other_findings: Traditional high-risk features did not predict survival.

result.standard: Monash Health clozapine patient management guidelines and RANZCP clinical practice guidelines

cycle1.result: Monthly weight, physical examination, medical review and full blood examination 97% compliant; BMI monitoring 66.7%; six-monthly consultant review 42.4%.

result.topic: Obesity identification and weight management referral in mental illness
result.setting: Three GP surgeries (Rigg Milner Medical Centre)

cycle1.result: 189 (32%) of SMI and depression register patients met referral criteria; 154 (81%) accepted and 35 (18%) declined weight management referral.

result.setting: Old age psychiatric ward (Meridian Ward, Hammersmith and Fulham Mental Health Unit)
result.standard: Vaccination status assessed and recorded for all inpatients

cycle1.result: 50% fully vaccinated, 20% one dose, 30% unvaccinated; 20% of unvaccinated patients had a first dose during admission.

result.other_findings: Recommendations: record vaccination status on admission and GP outreach to unvaccinated patients.

result.topic: Physical health checks in psychiatric inpatients

result.standard: Health Board acute admission policy: clerking and physical examination within 12 hours, bloods and medication chart within 2 hours, ECG at admission

result.standard: NICE CG178: documented prescribing rationale, side effect discussion, weekly weight for six weeks after starting

result.topic: Lifestyle and physical health screening in psychiatric outpatients

result.other_findings: Medication monitoring clinics did not perform better than outpatient follow-up clinics.

cycle1.result: 42% had a CFS documented during admission.

cycle2.result: CFS compliance 68% after the second intervention.

result.other_findings: Compliance was 65% after the first intervention; 80 patients reviewed in total, and all with CFS 5 or above had DNACPR decisions.

result.topic: Advanced nurse practitioner direct streaming from A&E

result.standard: Safety of new criteria-based direct streaming pathway (adverse events and delays)

cycle1.result: 361 patients referred directly from A&E to the surgical ANP team (81% within 2 hours of presentation); 85 (24%) admitted and 276 (76%) discharged the same day; no adverse events.

result.other_findings: Prospective audit of a pilot service rather than against a stated numeric standard.

result.setting: District general hospital general surgical department (Ealing Hospital, London)
result.standard: NICE-derived criteria for appropriate admission with acute uncomplicated diverticulitis

cycle1.result: 14/18 (77.8%) admitted; 11 of 14 admitted and 15 of 18 overall could have been safely ambulated under national guidelines.

result.topic: Sentinel lymph node biopsy for melanoma

result.standard: Predetermined performance indicators; interim COVID-19 criteria (SLNB for pT3a or greater)

cycle1.result: 94.4% had complete datasets; 141 eligible patients had SLNB (18.4% positive, 75.9% negative, 5.7% failed); 7.9% unsuitable and 4.5% declined.

result.topic: Juvenile idiopathic arthritis standards of care

result.standard: BSPAR/ARMA standards of care: referral to specialist appointment (PRH03), time to intra-articular steroid injection (PRH04), time to first uveitis screening (PRH05)

cycle1.result: Referral to Sheffield appointment standard met in 30.7% (3 to 73 days); steroid injection 84.6% (0 to 64 days); uveitis screening 46.2% (3 to 223 days).

result.other_findings: Standards date from 2009 and none were met at 100%.

result.setting: 12-bed polytrauma ICU and 20-bed neurosurgery ICU, AIIMS Trauma Center, Delhi

cycle1.result: Empirical therapy: DDD 532 and DOT 484 per 1,000 patient days; culture-based: DDD 486 and DOT 442 per 1,000 patient days.

result.other_findings: Findings used to identify education, early specimen collection and audit and feedback opportunities.

result.setting: Australian tertiary health facility
result.standard: Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome

cycle1.result: Mean time from endocrinology referral to diagnosis 13.5 months; ACTH ordered before confirming hypercortisolism in 14 patients; 1 patient tested before excluding exogenous steroid use.

result.other_findings: A linked survey of 102 clinicians and students found most would follow guidelines; half wanted clearer diagnostic flowcharts.

result.setting: 90-bed Veterans Affairs hospital

cycle1.result: 61 (30.7%) started empirical antibiotics; 50 (82%) had them stopped, 47 (94%) by the stewardship team.

result.other_findings: Only 5 (2.5%) had confirmed bacterial co-infection; mortality 19% intervention vs 10.1% non-intervention (p = 0.09).

result.setting: Paediatric hospital infectious diseases consult service

cycle1.result: Prospective audit and feedback recommendation rate 359/1234 (29%) without pharmacist rounding.

result.other_findings: Measured recommendation rates rather than compliance with a standard.

result.topic: Antimicrobial prescribing by WHO AWaRe category
result.setting: 70-bed COVID area, South Indian tertiary care centre

cycle1.result: 2152 (61.7%) prescribed antimicrobials; Watch 1937/2152 (90%), Access 151/2152 (7.2%), Reserve 64/2152 (3%).

result.other_findings: Azithromycin (34.7%) and ceftriaxone (27.3%) were most used; linezolid led Reserve use (1.0%).

result.setting: General Surgery, acute hospital in south-west England
result.standard: Public Health England antibiotic audit tool: appropriateness at initiation, pre-72h review and treatment duration

cycle1.result: 192/1162 (16.5%) days of therapy were excess, in 38 patients (44%); 39% at initiation, 29% after 72-hour review, 32% from protracted courses.

result.other_findings: 79 of 620 (12.7%) IV days of therapy were unnecessary; the surgeon apportioned fewer excess days (13.8%).

result.setting: 60 English centres, National Ophthalmology Database

cycle1.result: Good VA outcome (≥70 letters) 35.9% in most deprived vs 45.5% in least deprived decile; poor outcome 18.4% vs 14.5%; loss to follow-up 13.7% vs 11.8%.

result.other_findings: Median injections in year one were similar (7-8) across deciles.

result.setting: Newborn units in 22 hospitals

cycle1.result: Baseline gentamicin prescribing error rates in 16 intervention hospitals (36,668 neonates over the study); figures not given separately.

result.intervention: Pharmacist-led enhanced audit and feedback with continuing medical education.

cycle2.result: No step change (IRR 1.115, p = 0.265) or trend change (IRR 1.014, p = 0.344); relative to 6 control hospitals, trend improved (IRR 0.933, p = 0.014).

result.other_findings: Controlled interrupted time series study; errors rose across all hospitals during and after the intervention.

result.setting: Obstetric and gynaecology wards, Dow University Hospital, Karachi
result.standard: Antimicrobial stewardship programme compliance; WHO AWaRe 2023

cycle1.result: AMS compliance 0%; 65.1% of prescriptions had no documented indication; Access 53.6%, Watch 46.1%.

result.topic: Paediatric HIV dolutegravir transition and viral load monitoring
result.setting: 54 clinics in eThekwini Municipality
result.standard: 2023 South African ART guidelines: dolutegravir-based ART for children and adolescents; viral load in last 12 months

result.other_findings: TIER.Net data capture errors in 941 (28%) ART regimens, 438 (13%) start/stop dates and 199 (6%) viral loads, which were corrected.

result.setting: Tertiary cancer centre, Dr B Borooah Cancer Institute, Guwahati

cycle1.result: 19 of 119 cancer patients with COVID-19 died; cancer was the underlying cause in 19 (100%).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Tertiary referral centre

cycle1.result: 21 had cavernous sinus thrombosis (34.4%); 20 COVID-19 positive; 15 (25%) died.

result.other_findings: 93% had diabetes; sinus involvement was not associated with cavernous sinus thrombosis.

result.setting: Department of Radiology, Massachusetts General Brigham, Boston

cycle1.result: AUROC for 20 radiographic features 0.955 (PA) and 0.909 (AP); accuracy for high flow oxygen and mechanical ventilation 0.953 and 0.934 at 24 hours, 0.932 and 0.836 at 72 hours.

result.setting: Australian primary care and Primary Health Networks

cycle1.result: Interviews with 29 Primary Health Network staff and pilot testing identified low, medium and high resource implementation strategies.

result.other_findings: Qualitative implementation study; strategies included linking tools with audit and feedback reports and clinical audit software.

result.setting: 147 laboratories and 392 pathologists across Australia
result.standard: Recommended items in breast cancer pathology reports (before Australian Cancer Network recommendations)

result.setting: Specialist respiratory ward, West Norwich Hospital
result.standard: Hospital asthma management protocol: PEF variability 20% or less before discharge and written check of inhaler technique

cycle2.result: PEF variability criterion met in 17/23 (74%); written inhaler technique check 22/23 (96%).

result.other_findings: Across both periods (78 patients) 65 of 68 local patients were seen in chest clinic within six weeks.

result.topic: Evidence base of paediatric inpatient treatment

result.standard: Level of evidence (Ellis score and Oxford Centre for Evidence Based Medicine levels)

cycle1.result: Ellis level I evidence in 21%, level II 73%, level III 6%; Oxford grades A 16%, B 8%, C 1%, D 75%.

result.other_findings: Most children with mild to moderate dehydration received slow IV fluids and most with uncomplicated pneumonia received IV antibiotics.

result.setting: Sunnybrook Family Practice Center, Toronto
result.standard: Quality indicators for dizziness assessment (onset, own words, medications, postural BP, mood, falls, syncope, diagnosis, referrals)

cycle1.result: Documentation of key quality indicators was sub-optimal (figures not given in abstract).

result.other_findings: Charts recording symptoms in the patient's own words were more likely to have a diagnosis (P = 0.002).

result.topic: Summary quality index for primary care
result.setting: Practice Partner Research Network, over 100 ambulatory practices
result.standard: 36 process and outcome measures from the electronic record

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Methods paper describing the SQUID composite measure used in audit and feedback.

result.topic: Prescribing quality indicators and pharmacotherapy audit meetings
result.setting: 84 pharmacotherapy audit meetings of GPs and pharmacists

cycle1.result: No association between level of pharmacotherapy audit meeting functioning and prescribing quality for any indicator in seven drug classes.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Intensive care, Montreal Chest Institute

cycle1.result: 16% of CPAP-treated patients needed intubation vs 62% of medically treated (p = 0.001); median ICU stay 5, 7 and 8.5 days.

result.other_findings: Mortality was higher with initial intubation (adjusted OR 15.7) or medical therapy (OR 5.1) than mask CPAP.

result.other_findings: Most parameters were inadequate; best recorded items were exacerbations in the previous year (81.4%) and influenza vaccination (87.7%).

result.setting: ICU of an urban tertiary care hospital, Memorial Health System, Springfield, Illinois
result.standard: Clinical practice guidelines: ICU patients assessed for delirium at least once per shift

cycle1.result: Delirium assessments performed 31% of the time; documentation 40% (12/30) dayshift and 27% (8/30) nightshift.

result.intervention: Simulation-based nurse education with screening videos, then a standardised delirium screening tool and critical care progress note with a delirium section discussed on rounds
result.other_findings: After education alone, documentation was 69% (41/59) dayshift and 61% (36/59) nightshift.

result.topic: Acute kidney injury in critical care
result.setting: ICUs in the Intensive Care Over Nations audit (worldwide)

cycle1.result: 59% met AKIN criteria for AKI within 72 hours; 68% of septic versus 57% of non-septic patients had AKI.

result.other_findings: AKI affected mortality even with apparent full renal recovery by day 7.

result.setting: Outpatient respiratory clinics nationwide (EPOCONSUL audit)

cycle1.result: Triple therapy in 2,428 (53.9%); incorrect inhaled therapy prescriptions in 261 (5.9%); 3,494 (77.5%) had no change in prescription.

result.other_findings: Stepping up was linked to symptoms, exacerbations and positive bronchodilator test; stepping down to lung function impairment and ICS regimens.

result.setting: Surgical department, AIC Litein Hospital, rural faith-based non-governmental hospital
result.standard: Criteria for appropriate antibiotic choice, duration and indication (no named guideline)

cycle1.result: Inappropriate prescriptions in 45.4% of prophylactic, 33.4% of treatment and 52.6% of discharge antibiotics; duration indicated in only 11% of treatment sheets; most common reason inappropriate duration (45.9%).

result.other_findings: Intravenous route used in 91.2%; 81.4% of cases were discharged on antibiotics. Authors recommend documentation, daily antibiotic review and a local antibiotic policy.

result.setting: Two general internal medicine wards, large academic health sciences centre (The Ottawa Hospital)
result.standard: SafetyLEAP programme; primary outcome urinary catheter prevalence (no target stated)

cycle1.result: Initial audit and feedback of 534 patients; pre-intervention daily catheter point prevalence 22%; catheter utilisation ratio 0.14.

result.intervention: SafetyLEAP programme (systematic detection and reduction of safety incidents) with audit and feedback; programme adherence 97.4%.

cycle2.result: Daily catheter point prevalence fell to 13%; catheter utilisation ratio 0.12.

result.other_findings: CAUTI rates were unchanged.

result.setting: 40 maternity facilities in the Mediterranean perinatal network, South of France

cycle1.result: Mean caesarean rate 22.0% (55,097 caesareans); higher in private facilities (23.9%).

result.other_findings: Performing caesarean audits and teaching trainee doctors were associated with lower caesarean rates.

result.setting: Post-anaesthesia care unit, large quaternary university-affiliated paediatric hospital (Hospital for Sick Children, Toronto)
result.standard: Documented pain assessment (pain intensity score with validated measure) during PACU stay; no target stated

cycle1.result: 69% of charts had at least one documented pain assessment.

result.intervention: PDSA: PACU flowsheets modified; knowledge translation strategy with educational meetings, huddle discussions, reminders (screensavers, posters, emails) and audit feedback.

cycle2.result: >90% at 4 and 5 months and 100% at 6 months.

result.other_findings: Further work needed on monitoring moderate to severe pain.

result.setting: International clinical audit coordinated by the IAEA with readers from low- and middle-income countries

cycle1.result: Phase 1 (raw data processed locally): concordance among core participants good to excellent; experts excellent.

result.intervention: Phase 2 distributed studies pre-processed at the core lab.

cycle2.result: SSS and SRS concordance rose to excellent among core participants; categorical reporting improved.

result.other_findings: Significant LVEF differences between cardiac analysis software packages; 11 experts formed a comparison group.

result.topic: Audit and feedback tool engagement emails
result.setting: Cancer Care Ontario, Screening Activity Report for primary care providers

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes co-creation of behaviour-change emails; 8 emails created for a factorial randomised experiment.

result.setting: Heart Institute, Children's Hospital Colorado
result.standard: Postoperative feeding algorithm: pursue gastrostomy or oral-only feeds within 3 days once indicated by sentinel feeding readiness assessment

cycle1.result: 49/69 (71%) complied with the algorithm; noncompliers had longer length of stay (34 v 25 days; P = 0.01).

result.other_findings: 45 (65.2%) received gastrostomy; noncompliers waited 6 extra days for it; subjective decisions to extend oral trials drove noncompliance.

result.setting: Children's Medical Center, NYU Winthrop University Hospital
result.standard: Aim: reduce antibiotic exposure and DOT/1000 patient days in hospitalised RSV-positive patients by 25%

cycle1.result: 56.2% of RSV-positive patients received antibiotics.

cycle2.result: Antibiotic exposure fell to 30.9%; DOT/1000PD fell by 164.6 from baseline (P = 0.017).

result.other_findings: 290 children in total analysis; reduction was sustained.

result.setting: Perinatal Audit Registry of the Netherlands (PARS)

cycle1.result: At least one substandard care factor in 68.8% of deaths at 41 weeks or more; most frequent inadequate CTG evaluation/classification (10.1%).

result.setting: Community mental health services in City of Johannesburg, Ekurhuleni, Sedibeng and West Rand districts, Southern Gauteng
result.standard: National Mental Health Policy Framework norms: minimum coverage 2.7% of adults and 1.5% of children and adolescents

cycle1.result: Coverage approximately 0.3% of adults and 0.02% of children and adolescents; only 2.23% of clinic visits were for mental health; no norms met.

result.other_findings: Staffing, residential facilities and day care were far below norms; specialist services were inappropriately sited in primary care.

result.setting: 21 health centres and health posts, Tabriz

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Cluster-randomised trial of customer self-audit (group prenatal care); service quality score 8.91 v 7.63 in controls.

result.setting: Rural village clinics

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Prescription audit and feedback programme started September 2011.

cycle2.result: Immediate drop of 6.15% per month (P = 0.089); decrease of 1.12% per month after the programme (P = 0.034).

result.other_findings: Interrupted time series with segmented regression; authors conclude the programme was associated with significant decreases in antibiotic use.

result.setting: 10 intensive care units

cycle1.result: About 75% received an antimicrobial; no clinical justification documented for 20% of prescriptions.

result.other_findings: Agreement between VAP checklist and physician diagnosis only 17%; piperacillin/tazobactam was a third of prescriptions, half for prophylaxis.

result.setting: Tertiary high-volume cancer hospital (Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai), elective surgery

cycle1.result: Compliance 100%, 78% and 76.5% for the first, second and third parts; interaction of all three team representatives in 265/509 (52%).

result.other_findings: 131/2200 (5.95%) items were done only after checklist prompting; parts mostly initiated by surgeons.

result.setting: 11-bed level III mixed ICU, Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital

cycle1.result: Overall mortality 246 (32.8%).

result.standard: Number of current problems listed in medical ICU transfer documents (no target stated)

cycle2.result: Average rose to 2.7 after the problem list and education, then 3.85 after adding the checklist.

result.other_findings: Improvements were made permanent and ongoing audits using statistical process control showed sustained improvement.

result.setting: Palliative care outpatient department, tertiary care hospital (AIIMS, New Delhi)

cycle1.result: Most patients had not heard of palliative care; 90% were referred for severe pain.

result.other_findings: About 20% travelled more than 300 km; late referral and lack of services identified.

result.setting: Department of Anaesthesiology, NU Hospitals, Bengaluru

cycle1.result: 69/246 (28.04%) had high residual gastric volume on ultrasound despite ASA fasting.

result.other_findings: No correlation between fasting hours and gastric volume (P = 0.47); gastric volume rose with body mass index.

result.setting: Tertiary academic emergency centre, Johannesburg

cycle1.result: Therapeutic INR at discharge reached in only 36.5%.

result.other_findings: HIV, tuberculosis and immobilisation were the commonest risk factors; median stay 14 days.

result.setting: Tertiary care hospital (King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre, Riyadh)
result.standard: Current guideline criteria for prescribing omalizumab

cycle1.result: 28/50 (56%) met all guideline prescribing criteria; 18 (64%) by pulmonary and 10 (36%) by allergy physicians (P < .05).

result.other_findings: Both groups prescribed lower initial doses than recommended; healthcare use fell from 16.28 to 2.08 per year (P < .0001).

result.setting: IVF and Fertility Research Centre, ESIC-PGIMSR Model Hospital, New Delhi

cycle1.result: 113 pregnancies (14.1%) per cycle; pregnancy rate per couple 17.3%.

result.other_findings: Highest pregnancy rate with ovulatory dysfunction (21.2%) and in women aged 25 or under (18.9%).

result.setting: Bahawal Victoria Hospital, tertiary care centre, Bahawalpur
result.standard: Adequate completion of CT request form fields (no named guideline)

cycle1.result: Name 100%, surname 27.66%, age 73.33%, gender 64.33%, clinical history 50.66%; requesting junior doctor identified in 10.33%.

result.other_findings: No forms recorded allergy, last menstrual period or contact numbers; address present in 1%.

result.setting: Seth G.S. Medical College and KEM Hospital, Mumbai

cycle1.result: 36% (187/521) had at least one bleed; 56% (269/479) were below target INR.

result.setting: Tertiary paediatric intensive care unit, Emma Children's Hospital, Amsterdam
result.standard: Prevalence of medication errors per 100 prescriptions (no target stated)

cycle1.result: 153 medication errors; 2.27 per 100 prescriptions.

result.intervention: Structured medication audit and feedback by a clinical pharmacist in the multidisciplinary team.

cycle2.result: 90 medication errors; 1.71 per 100 prescriptions; significant change in slope (P = .04).

result.other_findings: No significant immediate drop at the start of the intervention (P = .07).

result.setting: University of Gondar Hospital, specialised university hospital
result.standard: 22 practice quality indicators based on a modified global quality index

cycle1.result: No preanaesthetic evaluation tool fully completed; consent, histories, examination and diagnosis >90% complete.

result.other_findings: Anaesthetic plan, vital signs, name, oral status, premedication and age were below average.

result.setting: Hospital blood bank, Amritsar
result.standard: Complete blood request form fields (second identifier, diagnosis, haematology, component, transfusion history, urgency, signatures)

cycle1.result: 91.42% of request forms incomplete; incomplete second identification 91.03%.

result.other_findings: 6894 forms in total; phlebotomist signature still missing in 45.19% in December.

result.setting: Three family health teams (two academic, one community), Ontario
result.standard: Evidence-based adult asthma practices: symptom-based asthma control assessment, controller escalation, written action plan

cycle1.result: Asthma control assessed in 4.9% of visits and 15.4% of patients; controller escalated in 3.3% of visits.

result.other_findings: Assessment was more frequent at visits for asthma symptoms (35.0%) than other visits (1.6%).

result.setting: Outpatient respiratory clinics in 28 hospitals (EPOCONSUL national audit)

cycle1.result: Clinical control more frequent in specialised than general clinics for non-severe patients (70.5% v 56.1%).

result.other_findings: Only 47.5% of centres had a specialised COPD clinic; 4508 cases recruited overall.

cycle1.result: 93.5% managed without escalation to other specialist services.

result.other_findings: 82.2% of caregivers needed support, and 99.5% of these needs were addressed.

result.setting: Four maternity and paediatric hospitals

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Survey of 84 physicians and 218 nurses; lack of time was the main barrier to perinatal death audit.

cycle1.result: Organisms isolated from 1401 (45.69%) samples; E. coli commonest (36.11%).

result.topic: Antimicrobial stewardship in neonatal intensive care

result.setting: Single public emergency department

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Mixed-methods design study (13 interviews); culture and social network affected perceived dashboard usefulness.

result.setting: Surgical service, state hospital, KwaZulu-Natal

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Survey response 36/47 (76.6%); deficiencies in audit infrastructure and resources.

cycle1.result: Higher resistance in ICU isolates; overall ICU resistance Acinetobacter 93.00%, Klebsiella 72.30%, Pseudomonas 49.03%.

result.setting: All radiology departments in Luxembourg (national audit)

cycle1.result: Appropriateness rate 79% for MRI v 61% for CT (388 CT and 330 MRI requests).

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Qualitative study of 39 GPs; feedback must be reliable, specific, recent and recurrent to motivate change.

cycle1.result: Hydromorphone dose lower with epidural PCA than intravenous PCA (P = 0.001).

result.other_findings: No difference in nausea (P = 0.663) or pruritus (P = 0.639).

result.standard: Aim to increase patient portal enrolment significantly (no numeric target)

cycle1.result: not reported
