result.other_findings: Postoperative complications did not affect quality of life or common cancer symptoms.

result.topic: Antibiotic management of paediatric septic shock
result.setting: Kenyatta National Hospital (tertiary care), children aged 0-5 years with septic shock

cycle1.result: Blood cultures taken before antibiotics in 12 (24%); culture bottles unavailable in 80%; antibiotics started within the golden hour in 44 (88%); cephalosporin monotherapy commonest (60%).

result.other_findings: Mortality at 72 hours was 35 (70%); all 9 children started on meropenem monotherapy died; de-escalation limited by lack of culture results.

result.setting: 3 hospitals in Hamilton, Ontario (retrospective cohort)
result.standard: Adequate coverage defined as blood culture isolate susceptible to the empiric antibiotic

cycle1.result: Empiric coverage inadequate in 56 (27.9%) cases.

result.other_findings: Unknown source (aOR 2.76) and antibiotics within 90 days (aOR 2.46) predicted inadequate coverage; a clinical pathway ruled out Pseudomonas better than clinicians.

result.setting: Tertiary care hospital (Aga Khan University, Karachi, per affiliations)

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: Marked improvement in key request form parameters (figures not given in abstract).

result.other_findings: Remaining shortcomings pointed to training for junior doctors.

result.topic: Alcohol use screening in psychiatric inpatients
result.setting: Psychiatric hospital, men admitted over 3 years

cycle1.result: 45.3% had high-risk drinking or dependence and 54.7% low risk on the AUDIT questionnaire.

result.other_findings: Higher AUDIT score was associated with longer stay, suicidal thoughts and raised liver enzymes.

result.setting: 20-bed critical care unit, Makkah (quasi-experimental before and after)
result.standard: National antimicrobial stewardship toolkit; Start Smart and Then Focus

cycle1.dates: 9 months before implementation (study January 2016 to July 2017)
cycle1.result: Mean monthly antimicrobial consumption 742.86 DDD per 100 bed days; IV ceftriaxone 94.32; oral levofloxacin 26.75.

result.intervention: Multidisciplinary stewardship programme: revised hospital prescribing policy, Start Smart and Then Focus algorithm and toolkit, prospective audit and feedback, prescribing forms and education

cycle2.result: Consumption 555.33 DDD per 100 bed days (25% reduction; p = 0.110); IV ceftriaxone 16.68 (82% fall; p = 0.008); oral levofloxacin 172.29 (p = 0.008).

result.other_findings: Control tracer medications changed by 7%; there was a negative impact on cost after the intervention.

result.setting: Ontario Return Visit Quality Programme, 23 of 86 participating emergency departments (qualitative interviews)

cycle1.result: Perceived value depended on local QI culture, how the programme was implemented, medicolegal concerns and resources.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Face mask adverse effects in healthcare workers
result.setting: Saveetha Medical College and Hospital, Chennai (prospective cross-sectional questionnaire over 6 months)

cycle1.result: Complaints increased in severity with duration of mask use, with a proportional impact on SF-12 quality of life; 8.48% (n = 174) had comorbidities.

result.other_findings: 299 of 2750 personnel were excluded.

result.topic: Antipsychotic use in dementia in long-term care
result.setting: 170 long-term care sites, Alberta Health Services (province-wide)
result.standard: Antipsychotic use only with a documented indication

cycle1.result: Inappropriate antipsychotic use 26.8%.

result.intervention: Education plus audit and feedback delivered in a learning collaborative format
result.other_findings: No increase in restraint use or aggressive behaviour; incremental cost $5 678.71 per inappropriate antipsychotic avoided; 75% implementation fidelity.

result.setting: Dutch ColoRectal Audit national registry

cycle1.result: 30-day mortality 2.7% (n = 1693); best machine learning model AUC 0.82 vs ASA score 0.74.

result.other_findings: Machine learning identified patient groups at risk and may improve case-mix correction for benchmarking.

result.setting: Department of endodontics, dental specialty centre (retrospective record review of 12 months)
result.standard: Evidence-based endodontic treatment and success predictors (audit tool)

cycle1.result: Vitality test recorded in 1.98% of cases; intracanal medicament used and named in 3.96%; 3.96% of teeth extracted for endodontic failure; 6.93% had voids but root canal filling overall satisfactory.

result.other_findings: Vitality testing, medicament type and root filling assessment were largely not documented.

result.topic: Off-label novel drug use in paediatric oncology
result.setting: Paediatric oncology centre, Royal Children's Hospital, Melbourne (retrospective)

cycle1.result: 100 patients received 133 novel drugs in 124 regimens; 91 of 124 regimens (73.4%) gave objective responses, 35 (38.5%) ongoing in June 2020; median cost $15 521 AUD.

result.other_findings: Decision-making about novel drugs was inconsistently documented; funding mainly by hospital (45.1%) or compassionate access (39.1%).

result.setting: Kimberley region of Western Australia: police data and Emergency Department Data Collection (retrospective cross-sectional)

cycle1.result: ED attendance for self-harm was three times higher in the Kimberley than the rest of Western Australia, with disproportionate involvement of Aboriginal people aged 15-24.

result.other_findings: Almost 80% of police-recorded self-harm events in people aged 25-50 involved alcohol.

result.topic: Local recurrence after transanal total mesorectal excision
result.setting: Six centres in the Netherlands (independent external audit of consecutive TaTME)

cycle1.result: Estimated 2- and 3-year local recurrence 4.6% and 6.6%; corrected 3-year rates 9.7%, 3.3% and 3.5% for implementation, continued adoption and prolonged experience cohorts.

result.other_findings: Procedural experience, advanced stage and pelvic sepsis were independent risk factors for local recurrence.

result.setting: Emergency departments, Saskatchewan Health Authority
result.standard: Appropriate use of urine drug screen tests

cycle1.result: Monthly departmental average of 26 urine drug screens per 1000 patient visits.

result.intervention: Audit and feedback report co-designed with ED physicians using the behaviour change wheel, with education and feedback sessions over 18 months

cycle2.result: 8 urine drug screens per 1000 patient visits, sustained.

result.other_findings: Involving end users in designing the report and departmental leadership were key to engagement.

result.topic: Lymph node assessment in lung cancer resection
result.setting: Spanish Lung Cancer Group SCAT trial centres (thoracic surgery)
result.standard: IASLC recommendations for lymph node dissection

cycle1.result: Regions 7, 10 and 11 not assessed in 33.7%, 17.7% and 49.9%; fewer than three regions biopsied in 21.1%; fewer than six nodes in 19.6%; only one N1 region in 53.4%.

result.other_findings: Of patients with positive N2, 8.9% had no N1 regions biopsied; 30-day mortality was unknown.

result.setting: Six Swedish clinics performing high-dose-rate prostate brachytherapy (questionnaire and planning case)

cycle1.result: Target dose aim 10.0 Gy at all clinics but covered volume 95% to 100%; D90 10.0 to 11.1 Gy (26.0 to 31.3 Gy EQD2); organ-at-risk constraints varied by up to 2 Gy; conformity index 0.52 to 0.59.

result.other_findings: Total treatment of 102 Gy EQD2 was in the upper part of GEC/ESTRO prescription doses.

result.setting: Cape Coast Teaching Hospital (prospective review)

cycle1.result: No form fully completed; X-ray serial number and previous examinations never documented; name, investigation, date, doctor and clinical history over 90%; age 88%, ward/address 75%, doctor's address 18.4%.

result.other_findings: 20% of request forms were not useful to the radiologist in reaching the final diagnosis.

result.topic: Intrathecal fentanyl dose and fetal heart rate decelerations
result.setting: University of Washington labour unit (retrospective review)
result.standard: Institutional limit of intrathecal fentanyl below 15 mcg for labour

cycle1.result: Prolonged fetal decelerations 4.4%, 2.3%, 7.6% and 3.0% for 2.5, 5, 10 and 15 mcg fentanyl (p-value = 0.11).

result.other_findings: No differences in emergency caesarean, pain reduction, pruritus or hypotension.

result.setting: Paediatric urology and nuclear medicine department, Hospital of the Sisters of Charity, Linz

cycle1.result: Sedation rate 27.1%; 86% (60/70) would repeat the investigation under identical conditions; 77% (17/22) of patients over 5 felt good.

result.intervention: Revised sedation policy with clear age limits, individual indication, staff education and optimised sedatives
result.other_findings: High patient satisfaction was maintained.

result.setting: Computer science study (machine learning model)

cycle1.result: Ensemble model accuracy 98.67% on training and 95.52% on test images; symptom classifier optimised accuracy 88.96%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: PSA testing and prostate cancer detection
result.setting: SGPGIMS, Lucknow (symptomatic men) and Medanta the Medicity, Gurugram (executive health checks)

cycle1.result: PSA positivity 28.4% in 9906 men with LUTS and 3% in 24919 healthy men; in LUTS group only about half with an indication had a biopsy; cancer in 93 of 241 biopsied with PSA 4-10 (38.5%).

result.other_findings: 61.5% of cancers in the LUTS group were metastatic vs none in the health-check group; only 9.3% of health-check men with raised PSA had a biopsy.

result.setting: Emergency department, The Indus Hospital, Karachi (tertiary care, retrospective chart review)

cycle1.result: 322 deaths among 507,759 adult ED visits (7.6 per 10,000); mean length of stay before death 3.4±2.8 hours; acute coronary syndrome caused 109 (33.8%).

result.other_findings: Delayed presentation (mean 44±147 hours) and systemic gaps in management contributed; no prior care was associated with high-priority cases (p=0.013).

result.setting: Emergency department, Redcliffe Hospital, Queensland (Emergency Audit Initiative programme)

cycle1.result: 27 audits completed; 88% of interns and 100% of specialists rated it valuable; interns reported adequate time (94%) and resources (81%).

result.other_findings: Only a modest impact on clinical practice was reported.

result.setting: Dubbo inpatient mental health units (Gundaymarra and Barraminya), rural New South Wales
result.standard: Discharge summary completion, co-design of discharge plan and next of kin involvement

cycle1.result: Discharge summary completion rates were high; co-design occurred frequently; next of kin involved with few exceptions (no figures given).

result.intervention: Junior doctors facilitated patients to co-design discharge plans in an open forum including next of kin
result.other_findings: Staff wanted this approach for every patient.

result.setting: Six comprehensive cancer centres in four European countries (IROCA project)
result.country: Portugal, Poland and Spain (four European countries)
result.standard: Standard clinical practice indicators for prostate cancer radiotherapy

cycle1.result: Staging MRI 27.5-87.5% of cases; multidisciplinary tumour board 2.5-100%; time from first visit to treatment 42-102.5 days; treatment interruptions ≥ 1 day 7.5-97.5%.

result.other_findings: Commonest deviation was inconsistent data recording of diagnosis, treatment and adverse events.

result.topic: Audit and feedback in primary care
result.setting: Seven health centres in Swedish primary care (focus groups)

cycle1.result: Existing audit and feedback mainly external and non-clinical (revenue, resources, volume) and not seen as improving quality.

result.other_findings: Lack of time, autonomy and system-level QI support were barriers.

result.setting: Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University (pretest-post-test trial of 16 endoscopists)

cycle1.result: Adenoma detection rate 10.8% at baseline in feedback group.

result.intervention: Weekly automated quality report cards from the Endo.Adm deep-learning audit and feedback system

cycle2.result: Adenoma detection rate rose to 20.3% (P value not legible in abstract).

result.other_findings: 3,515 gastroscopies were also analysed for gastric precancerous condition detection.

result.setting: Five primary care centres, Chile (randomised controlled trial)

cycle1.result: At 6 months low-risk drinking in 119 (80%) BI group vs 103 (71%) leaflet group (p = 0.1).

result.other_findings: AUDIT score fell by 5.76 vs 5.07 points (adjusted difference 0.86, p = 0.043).

result.setting: 26 primary care units, municipality of Rio de Janeiro
result.standard: Ten quality criteria and one indicator for care of pregnant women with syphilis

cycle1.result: Overall compliance 64.4%.

result.intervention: Multifaceted: ongoing education, improved records and information systems, audit and feedback, patient education, organisational and work process changes

cycle2.result: Overall compliance 71.0% (absolute improvement 6.7%, relative 28.8%, p > 0.05); eight of ten criteria improved, four significantly.

result.other_findings: Ample room for improvement remained.

result.topic: Drug and alcohol referral for mental health inpatients
result.setting: Dubbo Hospital inpatient mental health units, rural New South Wales

cycle1.result: Drug and alcohol consultation in 48 of 228 (21%) patients.

result.intervention: Staff education and discussion, plus a standing morning meeting agenda item to identify and refer patients
result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Radiation dose audit against diagnostic reference levels
result.setting: Medical imaging department, Ministry of the National Guard - Health Affairs, Jeddah (retrospective)
result.standard: International diagnostic reference levels (IDRLs) and UK DRLs for dose area product

cycle1.result: 75th percentile DAP below IDRLs for all examinations except lateral lumbar, AP and lateral thoracic spine, which exceeded IDRLs by up to 40.7%, 2.8% and 365.5%.

result.other_findings: Mean DAP significantly exceeded UK DRLs for lateral thoracic and lateral lumbar spine; 699 examinations in total.

result.setting: Paediatric emergency room, PGIMER Chandigarh (tertiary care)
result.standard: IV line insertion and maintenance checklist; aim to reduce infiltration and phlebitis by 50% over 2 months

cycle1.result: Infiltration 82.9% and phlebitis 96.1%.

result.intervention: IV line insertion and maintenance bundle over PDSA cycles: sterile mobile trays, audit and feedback, organisational change, infection control nurse and QI team

cycle2.result: Infiltration 45% and phlebitis 55%; checklist process scores increased.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Hospital Serdang, Malaysia (pharmacy and cardiology)

cycle1.result: 30-day readmissions 36.0%; mortality 4.0%.

result.other_findings: Post-intervention cohort was younger and more often male.

result.setting: 73 public primary care clinics, Hospital Authority of Hong Kong
result.standard: Six evidence-based audit criteria for COPD care

cycle1.result: Of 3102 active smokers, 1788 (57.6%) referred for smoking cessation and 1578 (50.9%) attended; influenza vaccine 4866 (46.9%); pneumococcal vaccine 4227 (40.7%); spirometry 1983 (19.1%); AECOPD admission 1327 (12.8%).

result.intervention: Series of quality improvement strategies in a one-year implementation phase (systematic team approach)

cycle2.result: All criteria significantly improved, with marked rises in vaccine uptake and spirometry; AECOPD admission rate fell to 9.6%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: CT report recommendations in suspected lung cancer
result.setting: McGill University Health Centre, Montreal (retrospective review)
result.standard: Current guidelines for lung cancer diagnosis and staging

cycle1.result: Only 12% of CT reports had guideline-concordant imaging recommendations (PET suggested in 6%); invasive procedures suggested in one fifth, 58% of these guideline-concordant.

result.other_findings: Transthoracic needle aspiration was suggested in 26% of patients despite advanced disease.

result.setting: Outpatient department, St Philomena's Hospital, Bangalore (teaching hospital)
result.standard: RSSDI (Research Society for the Study of Diabetes in India) screening criteria (9 recommended)

cycle1.result: Blood pressure at every visit about 95%; smoking cessation counselling 90%; microalbuminuria, retinopathy and neuropathy screening about 60% or less; 90% had only 4 of 9 recommended screens.

result.other_findings: Comprehensive foot care advice was not routine.

result.setting: Two intermediate care units in 2 hospitals, Methodist Hospitals, Indiana
result.standard: Target of 80% of dressings with all 4 corners intact without reinforcement at day 7

cycle1.result: Existing dressing with education did not achieve the 80% goal.

result.intervention: Sequential 2-week trials of updated and new dressings with education, then addition of a liquid gum mastic adhesive

cycle2.result: Dressings with added gum mastic adhesive exceeded the 80% goal; no exposed insertion sites and no MARSI in any protocol.

result.other_findings: Post-project data on 30,049 vascular access sites showed the same effect; it became standard of care.

result.setting: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research, Puducherry (patients with generalised peritonitis)

cycle1.result: Overall bundle compliance 9.2%; IV bolus, CVP-guided fluids and inotropes 100%.

result.intervention: Audit-based feedback in PDSA cycles with multidepartment input to modify practice

cycle2.result: Overall bundle compliance 64.7%; significant improvement in blood cultures before antibiotics, antibiotics within three hours and serum lactate.

result.other_findings: Four audit cycles were run; reasons for non-compliance were explored by questionnaire.

result.topic: Antimicrobial prescribing in outpatient parenteral therapy
result.setting: Hospital-in-the-home services (HITH-NAPS national survey, 50 services offered)
result.standard: National Antimicrobial Prescribing Survey (NAPS) appropriateness criteria

cycle1.result: 87% of 1154 prescriptions appropriate, 11% inappropriate, 2% not assessable.

result.other_findings: Prolonged duration or unnecessarily broad-spectrum antibiotics in 9% of prescriptions; cellulitis the commonest infection (30%).

result.setting: All 22 hospital trusts in Norway (document review and on-site interviews)

cycle1.result: ASP structures established in most trusts but leadership commitment and implementation of interventions often lacking; 446 people interviewed.

result.other_findings: Median 36 days from audit to report; total cost €133 952.

result.topic: Audit and feedback in primary care
result.setting: 27 primary care centres in five Swedish regions (manager interviews)

cycle1.result: Existing audit and feedback seen as coercive top-down control with limited support for complex change.

result.other_findings: Five contextual factors affected impact: performance, staff continuity, size, leadership flexibility and external flexibility.

result.setting: Two family medicine clinics (one intervention, one control), Houston
result.standard: Evidence-based guideline for antibiotic choice and duration in uncomplicated cystitis

cycle1.result: Guideline-adherent regimens 33.2% at intervention site (control 5.3%).

result.intervention: Didactic lecture, decision algorithm and case-based audit and feedback

cycle2.result: Guideline-adherent regimens 66.9% at intervention site (control 17.0%); difference-in-differences 22 percentage points, p=0.001.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: 14 health regions in Ontario (administrative data)

cycle1.result: Preoperative MRI in 1624 (43.2%) high-intensity vs 4774 (40.0%) low-intensity group.

result.other_findings: High-intensity knowledge translation (workshops, audit and feedback, operative demonstrations) was not associated with better measures or outcomes.

result.setting: COVID intensive care units, JIPMER Puducherry (tertiary care)
result.standard: WHO five moments of hand hygiene

cycle1.result: Monthly total adherence 26.7%.

result.intervention: Hand hygiene auditing with timely feedback

cycle2.result: Monthly total adherence rose to 68.4%; overall complete 30.8%, partial 34.5%, total 65.3%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Centre, Moshi (referral hospital)

cycle1.result: Long nails 15 (25%); polished nails 11 (18%); hand wash with water 73%; correct glove removal 20 (33%); alcohol rub use 2 (3%); no hand wash after procedure 35 (58%).

result.intervention: Feedback, discussion of findings, training, visual reminders and distribution of alcohol-based hand rub

cycle2.result: Long nails 3 (5%); polished nails 1 (2%); hand wash with water 100%; correct glove removal 66%; alcohol rub use 21 (35%); no hand wash after procedure 10 (17%).

result.other_findings: Poor knowledge fell from 7 (39%) to 3 (17%).

result.setting: Four emergency departments, University of Massachusetts (randomised trial)

cycle1.result: Mean CT ordering rate 35.7 per 100 patients in intervention group before feedback.

result.intervention: Audit and feedback showing peer distribution and actual performance after self-estimate, plus brief education for all

cycle2.result: CT ordering increased to 40.3 per 100 patients (t = 4.13) in the intervention group; increased in both arms.

result.other_findings: Most physicians had overestimated their CT ordering, so feedback did not prompt reduction.

result.topic: Antimicrobial stewardship in a community hospital
result.setting: Tarumizu Chuo Hospital, 126-bed community hospital (retrospective pre-post)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Antimicrobial stewardship team weekly rounds and recommendations, with post-prescription audit pharmacists and ward pharmacists closely communicating

cycle2.result: Recommendation rate to prescribers significantly increased (figures not given in abstract); appropriate antimicrobial use improved without worse clinical outcomes.

result.other_findings: Culture ordering, de-escalation, AUD and DOT for carbapenems and tazobactam-piperacillin, 30-day mortality and recurrence were measured.

result.setting: Dutch Upper GI Cancer Audit, nationwide

cycle1.result: Tumour positive resection margins in 150 (4%) patients.

result.other_findings: Risks included tumour length, cT4 stage and Ivor Lewis oesophagectomy; minimally invasive surgery and volume >60 per year lowered risk.

result.topic: Head and neck cancer care during COVID-19
result.setting: Head and neck disease management group, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Tata Memorial Centre, Varanasi (retrospective)

cycle1.result: 80% oral cavity cancer; 78% stage IV; 382 new registrations (68% symptomatic); 69 underwent surgery; 60 ED visits (67% dyspnoea).

result.other_findings: 12 of 189 follow-up patients were diagnosed with recurrence.

result.setting: Three general practices in Melbourne (Guidance GP pilot, qualitative evaluation)

cycle1.result: Audit and feedback, decision support and education were acceptable to GPs if they fitted workflow and gave clinically meaningful information.

result.other_findings: Barriers were coordination time and cost; facilitators were a whole-of-practice approach and a practice champion.

result.topic: Sex differences in oesophagogastric cancer surgery
result.setting: Dutch Upper GI Cancer Audit, nationwide

cycle1.result: Antrum gastric adenocarcinoma more frequent in women (47% vs 38%).

result.other_findings: Women with oesophageal adenocarcinoma less often had neoadjuvant therapy and women with gastric adenocarcinoma had inferior relative survival.

result.setting: 18 family medicine practices (qualitative programme evaluation)

cycle1.result: Nine opportunities to improve ENDS cessation identified in three categories: leading change, creating processes and assisting patients.

result.other_findings: Chart audits suggested where electronic records cannot support ENDS cessation.

result.setting: Single-surgeon breast cancer unit, Pune

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Consultations moved to phone or appointment-only clinic visits.

result.setting: Zimbabwean public sector healthcare facilities (national audit)
result.standard: WHO recommendation of 20 ultrasound units per million people

cycle1.result: 66 of 1798 facilities (3.67%) have ultrasound; 99 units (8 per million); 97% offer obstetrics and gynaecology, 33% general abdominal scanning.

result.other_findings: An estimated 140 more units are needed; two facilities with equipment could not offer a service.

result.setting: Large regional hospital, KwaZulu-Natal (retrospective)

cycle1.result: 118 RPR reactive (maternal syphilis prevalence 1.1%); HIV prevalence 41.2%.

result.other_findings: 72 (61.0%) had both HIV and syphilis; authors propose dual point-of-care testing and reverse algorithm.

result.setting: Paediatric haematology and oncology, Kasturba Medical College, Manipal (retrospective)

cycle1.result: 27 (21.4%) children referred to palliative care; 21 (77%) inpatient consults; symptom management the commonest trigger.

result.other_findings: 8 of 9 families (88.8%) needing end-of-life care preferred home.

result.setting: Cardiovascular ICU, University of Minnesota

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Standardised operating room to CVICU handover process

cycle2.result: Odds of greater provider satisfaction 18 times higher post implementation; more team members participated and information transfer increased at 1 year.

result.other_findings: Some clinical outcomes improved, but causality not proven.

result.topic: Caesarean risk calculator use in labour induction
result.setting: University of Pennsylvania labour and delivery unit (secondary analysis of prospective cohort)

cycle1.result: Calculator use documented in 676 of 822 (82.2%); weekday admissions with audit and feedback 82.0% vs weekend without 83.0% (aOR 0.90, p = 0.76).

result.other_findings: Weekday-only verbal audit and feedback appeared to sustain use over weekends.

result.setting: Outpatient department, JSS Medical College and Hospital, Mysuru (tertiary teaching hospital)

cycle1.result: Overall satisfaction 97.2%.

result.other_findings: Some patients were dissatisfied with toilet cleanliness and medicine availability.

result.setting: Multicentre prospective study including Baghdad Heart Centre
result.standard: Guideline-recommended risk stratification with TIMI and GRACE scores to guide invasive strategy

cycle1.result: TIMI score calculated in 5.3% and GRACE in none; invasive strategy in 85.24% and 82.7% of low GRACE and TIMI risk vs 42.85% and 40% of high-risk patients.

result.other_findings: Most patients with acute heart failure (60%), ongoing chest pain (80.76%), dynamic ST changes (85%) and cardiogenic shock (80%) were managed conservatively.

result.setting: Two Australian health services comprising 16 hospitals (retrospective review of incident reports over 18 months)

cycle1.result: 11,540 medication errors reported; electronic prescribing (OR 0.580) and dispensing (OR 0.350) and double-checking (OR 0.905) associated with fewer harmful errors.

result.other_findings: Insufficient patient counselling (OR 3.511) and misread or unread orders (OR 2.411) increased harm; patients or families detected 1100 (9.5%) errors.

result.topic: CT use in suspected paediatric appendicitis
result.setting: Community general emergency department system, 3 institutions in Connecticut
result.standard: Aim to reduce CT use by 50% (from 32% to 16%) in 1 year

cycle1.result: CT rate 32%; ultrasound rate 63%; nondiagnostic ultrasound 77%; transfer 23.5%.

result.intervention: Paediatric appendicitis clinical pathway, ultrasound report templates, and case audit and feedback
result.other_findings: Over-transfer rate was 0% at baseline; frontline staff reported knowledge gains and standardised practice.

result.setting: Paediatric ward, paediatric ED and maternal services, tertiary hospital in Saskatoon (single-day audits)

cycle1.result: Pain prevalence 75% to 88%; moderate to severe pain 78% ward, 65% ED, 55% maternal services; pain assessment documented 93% ward, 13% ED, 0% maternal services.

result.other_findings: Documented pain scores underestimated patient report by a mean 4.5/10; needle pokes were the commonest cause of worst pain.

result.setting: New Somerset Hospital, Cape Town (regional hospital, retrospective)
result.standard: Perioperative pain management guidelines for caesarean section (multimodal analgesia)

cycle1.result: Pain assessed on the day of operation in 55 (18%); analgesia prescribed in over 98% but given as prescribed in 32.6%; NSAIDs prescribed in 5%.

result.other_findings: No patient received PCA, TAP block or wound catheter; 93.3% had spinal anaesthesia.

result.setting: Eastern Newfoundland (retrospective chart review)
result.standard: Canadian Task Force on Preventive Health Care: screen ages 55 to 74 with 30+ pack-years using low-dose CT

cycle1.result: Under 6.0% of eligible population screened; only 28.13% met age and smoking criteria and were screened with low-dose CT.

result.other_findings: Screening detected cancer at earlier stage (50% vs 20% stage 1).

result.setting: Joondalup Health Campus, Western Australia

cycle1.result: Cognitive assessment tool used in 8.5% of case notes.

result.intervention: Interprofessional delirium education and implementation of a delirium screening tool
result.other_findings: Risk factor knowledge increased significantly (6.8%) but overall knowledge scores did not change.

result.setting: Outpatient hospital pharmacies implementing auditable pharmaceutical transactions and services (national cross-sectional)

cycle1.result: 585 (90%) satisfied; availability of prescribed medicines 1061 (75%); label score 3.1 of 8.

result.other_findings: Medicines were unaffordable (1.93 working days' wages); infrastructure was the only factor associated with satisfaction.

result.setting: 58 tertiary NICUs in the Chinese Neonatal Network (re-abstraction audit)
result.standard: Predefined agreement rates for critical, important and less important data elements

cycle1.result: Agreement 96.1% overall; 97.2% critical, 94.3% important, 96.6% less important (24,904 fields).

result.other_findings: Site discrepancy rates ranged from 0.0 to 18.4%.

result.topic: Appropriate use of myocardial perfusion imaging
result.setting: Nuclear medicine department, Nizams Institute of Medical Sciences, Hyderabad (tertiary teaching hospital)
result.standard: ACCF/ASNC appropriate use criteria for cardiac radionuclide imaging (2009)

cycle1.result: Appropriate 784 (77.2%); inappropriate 121 (12%); uncertain 110 (10.8%).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: COVID-19 in genitourinary cancer patients on immunotherapy
result.setting: 24 Italian oncology departments

cycle1.result: COVID-19 incidence 3.5% (mortality 1%) in 287 mRCC and 7.7% (mortality 3.1%) in 130 mUC patients.

result.other_findings: 40% of patients with COVID-19 permanently stopped anticancer treatment.

result.setting: Private familial cancer clinic, Western Australia (prospective questionnaire)

cycle1.result: 70 (96%) highly satisfied with explanation; 69 (95%) highly satisfied with the service; 68 (93%) satisfied with cost.

result.other_findings: Response rate 34%; 61 (83.6%) proceeded to genetic testing.

result.setting: Emergency departments, Alberta Health Services (realist evaluation interviews)

cycle1.result: 17 physician interviews identified five outcomes, positive (better follow-up and discharge communication) and negative (physician anxiety, possible extra resource use).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Two medical and two surgical wards, tertiary hospital (Peking University First Hospital, per affiliations)

cycle1.result: Risk assessment on admission 100%; regular repositioning about 84% (n = 486); patient education documented in 75% (n = 433); skin care, nutritional screening and support surfaces suboptimal.

result.other_findings: Surgical patients generally received and had documented better preventive care than medical patients.

result.topic: Cancer screening uptake in general practice
result.setting: General practices supported by a Primary Health Network (qualitative interviews)

cycle1.result: Four themes: programme set-up, patient education, engaging patients in screening and practice enhancement.

result.other_findings: IT was a challenge; PDSA cycles, better data entry and audit, and recall systems were facilitators.

result.setting: Psychiatry unit, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi (tertiary general hospital)

cycle1.result: Intellectual disability 58.3%, schizophrenia and related disorders 31%; about 60% moderate, 37.4% severe and 1.7% profound disability.

result.other_findings: Women (about 30%) and people with severe mental illness appeared under-represented.

result.setting: Cape Coast Teaching Hospital (tertiary)
result.standard: Appropriate clinical indications for obstetric ultrasound

cycle1.result: 314 of 527 request forms stated a clinical indication; 76 (68.5%) first-trimester scans had no indication; only 29 requests with history were inappropriate.

result.other_findings: 174 (81.7%) of forms without history came from the teaching hospital itself.

result.setting: Letsholathebe II Memorial Hospital, Maun (district hospital)
result.standard: Mental health care act requirement for required admission forms

cycle1.result: Required admission MHCA forms used in nil cases.

result.intervention: Continuing medical education session on MHCA forms
result.other_findings: At three months use was 64.6% (n=51/79), with no difference between 3 and 6 months; 36/235 (15.3%) forms not used with required companion forms.

result.topic: Surgical antibiotic prophylaxis in fracture fixation
result.setting: Metropolitan teaching hospital, Northern Health, Victoria (ORIF of closed fractures)
result.standard: Australian Therapeutic Guidelines: Antibiotic v15 (2018) and v16 (2019), v16 advocating single-dose prophylaxis

cycle1.result: Overall guideline adherence 63.2%; 78.3% received prophylaxis for the correct duration.

result.intervention: No local intervention; national guideline updated to single-dose prophylaxis between audit periods

cycle2.result: Overall adherence 18.0%; only 20.4% received single-dose prophylaxis.

result.other_findings: Lower limb fractures, ASA 3 and emergency admission were associated with lower adherence; cefazolin was the commonest agent.

result.setting: Le Bonheur Children's Hospital, Memphis (paediatric tertiary referral centre)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Antimicrobial stewardship programme: guideline development, provider education and prospective audit with feedback (no formulary restriction)

cycle2.result: Overall antibiotic use fell 32%; antibiotics under audit fell 51%; meropenem and similar broad-spectrum use fell 72%.

result.other_findings: Organism susceptibility increased and drug costs fell by over USD 560,000 a year with no change in sepsis mortality.

result.setting: Rural and regional Tasmania, maternity digital records
result.standard: Recommended gestational weight gain standards and oral glucose tolerance test screening

cycle1.result: 55% overweight or obese; 43.6% gained above recommended weight; 35.8% did not have an oral glucose tolerance test.

result.other_findings: Obesity and low screening were associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.

result.topic: Perioperative red cell transfusion in neonates and infants
result.setting: 165 centres in 31 European countries (NECTARINE study)
result.standard: Guideline haemoglobin transfusion thresholds of 8.5 to 12 g dl-1 by postnatal week

cycle1.result: Transfusion in 447 procedures (6.9%); median triggering haemoglobin 9.6 g dl-1 week 1, 9.6 week 2 and 8.0 week 3.

result.other_findings: Median transfusion volume 17.1 ml kg-1; 30-day morbidity 47.8% and mortality 11.3%.

result.setting: Cheng Hsin General Hospital, Taipei (single-group pre-post)

cycle1.result: Supervisor satisfaction with completeness of nursing quality improvement plans 41%.

result.intervention: Multilevel interactive nursing quality control and audit app for online learning and supervisor review

cycle2.result: Supervisor satisfaction 88%; 92% of nurses satisfied with online learning convenience.

result.other_findings: Older age and senior job title were associated with lower app usability.

result.setting: Multicentre national PET-CT study, Kuwait (second phase dose audit, 2019)
result.standard: UK IPEM methodology; comparison with UK, Swiss and French national DRLs

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: Half body third-quartile DLP 537 mGy x cm and CTDIvol 5 mGy, above UK NDRL (400, 4.3); whole body 684 and 4.1.

result.other_findings: NDRL improved by 9.1% compared with 2018; mean effective dose 6.9 mSv half body and 4.6 mSv whole body.

result.topic: Radiotherapy dosimetry and outcomes in lung cancer
result.setting: Amsterdam University Medical Centers radiotherapy department (institutional analysis)

cycle1.result: Overall survival 29 months with concurrent chemoradiotherapy (n = 64) vs 17 months with sequential or RT alone (n = 65); grade 3 or higher pneumonitis 3%.

result.other_findings: Oesophagitis grade 2 or higher was linked to lower survival after concurrent treatment.

result.topic: Pain, agitation and delirium assessment in intensive care
result.setting: Community ICU, Niagara Health System, St Catharines
result.standard: PAD clinical guidelines for routine assessment

cycle1.result: Guideline-compliant assessment by nurses: pain 23.4%, agitation 42.9%, delirium 35.2% of patient-days.

result.intervention: 4-week multifaceted intervention: rounds script, posters, visual reminders, education modules, pamphlet and video
result.other_findings: Barriers were low module completion, under-collection of data and competing accreditation education; next steps include order sets and audit and feedback.

result.topic: Choosing Wisely inappropriate prescribing in older people
result.setting: 43 health facilities in a cross-regional French geriatric campaign
result.standard: French Society of Geriatrics and Gerontology Choosing Wisely recommendations (urinary tract infection management, prolonged anxiolytics, neuroleptics in dementia, statins in primary prevention, dialogue on level of care)

cycle1.result: Important variability in practice between institutions and a significant percentage of inappropriate prescriptions, notably of psychotropic medication (figures not given in abstract).

result.other_findings: High participation of target institutions; frequent overuse of psychotropic medication highlighted need for deprescribing campaigns.

result.topic: Compliance with allotted elective surgery date
result.setting: Department of paediatric surgery, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi; tertiary public-funded teaching hospital
result.standard: Compliance with provisional date of admission for elective surgery (DAES) allotted in outpatients

cycle1.result: 12% (288/2409) defaulted on the allotted date; >49% of defaulters were day-care surgery cases, 32% simple reconstructive, 18% major reconstructive (P = 0.0001).

result.other_findings: 82% of defaulters were male; genitourinary cases made up 80% of day-care defaulters; children needing staged procedures complied better.

result.setting: University inpatient general paediatrics department including neonatal and paediatric intensive care, Saarland University Hospital, Homburg

cycle1.result: Antibiotic consumption analysed in grams and Defined Daily Doses per 100 patient days from pharmacy dispensing data (figures not given in abstract).

result.other_findings: Identified potential antibiotic stewardship targets and methodological limitations of the Robert Koch Institute surveillance method in paediatrics.

result.topic: Guideline-directed medical therapy at discharge after acute coronary syndrome
result.setting: Department of Cardiology, PSG Institute of Medical Sciences and Research, Coimbatore
result.standard: Guideline-directed medical therapy at discharge (statins, dual antiplatelet therapy, beta-blockers, ACE-I/ARB) with no unjustifiable omissions

cycle1.result: Unreasonable omissions in first month: DAPT 1%, statin 0%, ACE-I/ARB 14%, beta-blockers 11%.

result.intervention: Clinical pharmacist-led monthly audit with feedback report presented to cardiologists.

cycle2.result: Unreasonable omissions reduced to nil by the end of the 11th month and stayed nil to the 12th month.

result.other_findings: 1072 is the total audited over 12 months; improvement sustained to month 12.

result.setting: Dental schools in Japan and Vietnam

cycle1.result: Post-test scores significantly higher than pre-test; questionnaire response rate 78.8%.

result.other_findings: Learners reported no major problems with learning operations; faculty cooperation was important.

result.topic: Cervical medial branch block progression to radiofrequency neurotomy
result.setting: Academic institution spine centre, Vanderbilt University Medical Center, Nashville

cycle1.result: 21/51 (24%) progressed from MBB1 to MBB2; 13/21 (62%) from MBB2 to RFN; 13/51 overall progressed to RFN.

result.other_findings: MBB1 and MBB2 stopped progression in 30/51 (59%) and 8/21 (38%) patients respectively, using an ≥80% pain relief cutoff.

result.setting: General surgery department, Jordan University Hospital, Amman; tertiary hospital

cycle1.result: Baseline STAR scores in 2016 (figures not given in abstract); 488 records evaluated across 2016 to 2021.

result.intervention: Electronic record entry system, personnel education and systematic auditing.

cycle2.result: Total STAR scores improved steadily each year versus 2016 baseline, reaching the highest in 2021; all domains improved except anaesthesia records, which were already high.

result.other_findings: Largest improvements in Initial Clerking and Consent domains.

result.topic: Mental health presentations in remote primary care
result.setting: Three remote Aboriginal community controlled health clinics, Kimberley region, Western Australia

cycle1.result: Mental ill-health and psychological distress were prominent in clinical presentations; file review of 30 patients.

result.topic: National imaging equipment and workforce provision

result.setting: Chronic pain outpatient service, Ramathibodi Hospital, teaching hospital

cycle1.result: 282 patients (728 visits) by telemedicine and 283 patients (1018 visits) in person; telemedicine gave comparable outcomes.

cycle1.result: Perineal support recorded in 19 (68%); antibiotics 26 (93%); physiotherapy referral 27 (96%); laxatives 22 (79%); gynaecology follow-up referral documented in 21 (75%).

result.setting: Shalamar Hospital, Lahore

cycle1.result: Postoperative complications in 43 (12%), surgical site infection 5%, bile duct injury 2.5%; conversion rate 3.4% (emergency 9.3%, elective 2.2%).

result.topic: AI review of imaging report errors

cycle1.result: GPT-4o detected 79.0% (158 of 200) of errors, comparable to general ophthalmologists (78.0%); review time reduced by 86%.

result.topic: Maternal and child health service quality in primary care
result.setting: 2,583 primary health care facilities (dispensaries, health centres, district hospitals) across 10 regions
result.standard: Star Rating Assessment: 12 maternal and child health indicators; facilities scoring 80% or more meet the quality standard

cycle1.result: Only 280 (10.8%) facilities met the MCH quality standard; maternal audit and review aligned with guidelines in 2,057 (79.6%); family planning 48.3%, partogram completion 47.9%, immunisation 46.3%; cervical screening 199 (7.7%); essential obstetric medicines 424 (16.4%).

result.other_findings: Only 60/394 (15.2%) hospitals and health centres offered postnatal and newborn care with neonatal and Kangaroo Mother Care spaces; nurse availability, functional management and QI teams predicted quality.

cycle1.result: 30 observed donor-laboratorian interactions showed variation in recruitment practice; donor information leaflet not used (97.0% staff, 98.5% donors) and medication deferral list not used (93.3% staff, 97.8% donors); only 5.9% of donors were voluntary non-remunerated and 34.8% were deferred.

result.other_findings: 88.2% of successful donors were unaware of a contact person for post-donation symptoms; questionnaires from 135 donors and 134 laboratory staff; standard operating procedures recommended.

result.topic: Validation of AUDIT alcohol screening tool in nurses
result.setting: Nationwide survey of Australian nurses

cycle1.result: Original 10-item AUDIT was not valid or reliable among nurses; items 5, 6 and 9 performed poorly; a five-item AUDIT-N fitted better.

result.setting: Neonatal intensive care unit, Graphic Era tertiary care centre, Dehradun
result.standard: 10-point NICU prescription checklist; aim of 70% or more completeness

cycle1.result: Baseline mean completeness score 4.54/10; only 11.6% of prescriptions achieved 70% or more completeness.

cycle2.result: Sustained mean score 8.4/10; 100% of prescriptions scored 70% or more.

result.other_findings: 672 prescriptions analysed in total; no significant increase in prescription completion time.

result.topic: Paediatric diabetes HbA1c and technology benchmarking
result.setting: 13 regional paediatric diabetes centres (KiwiDiab network)
result.standard: National benchmarking of HbA1c target achievement (threshold not given in the supplied text)

cycle1.result: 1849 children and adolescents with diabetes, 1642 (88.8%) type 1; 23% of those with type 1 diabetes achieved the HbA1c target level.

result.other_findings: Differences in diabetes technology use and HbA1c across groups were reported; regular benchmarking recommended.

result.setting: Department of Otorhinolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery, Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, Islamabad

cycle1.result: Commonest associated ENT conditions were chronic rhinosinusitis 12 (12.24%) and orbital cellulitis 11 (11.22%); commonest ocular features were epiphora 44 (18.80%) and chemosis 39 (16.66%).

result.topic: Breathlessness assessment and non-drug management documentation

result.standard: 100% documentation of breathlessness and of non-pharmacological interventions

cycle1.result: 68% had breathlessness documented and no NPIs documented (March 2022, n = 433, after MDT induction: 80% and 16%).

cycle2.result: Breathlessness documented in 96.7% and NPIs in 93.5%.

cycle1.result: 1,163 (31.5%) restricted antibiotic prescriptions assessed as not appropriate; trainee prescriptions no different from staff (aOR 1.09, P = .25).

result.setting: Division of Radiation Oncology, King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital, Bangkok

cycle1.result: No significant difference in dose parameters across photon and proton modalities (P = 0.976); largest deviation -3.7% on TrueBeam.

result.topic: Turning incident analysis into practice change
result.setting: University-affiliated polyclinics, King Faisal University, Al-Ahsa

cycle1.result: Qualitative study of 17 nurses: four themes on making recommendations actionable, feasibility, social infrastructure and sustaining change.

result.other_findings: Simple artefacts such as checklists and prompts, leadership follow-through and psychologically safe huddles supported adoption.

result.setting: Niagara Health community hospitals, Ontario
result.standard: Choosing Wisely Canada: pre-transfusion haemoglobin 80 g/L or less and single-unit transfusion

cycle1.result: 85% compliance with the pre-transfusion haemoglobin threshold and 54% with single-unit transfusion.

result.intervention: Technologist-led prospective screening of red cell orders, policy updates and educational campaigns (Model for Improvement).

cycle2.result: Compliance sustained at 90% (haemoglobin) and 77% (single unit); within three months of launch it had reached 90% and 71%.

result.setting: Department of Ultrasound, Peking Union Medical College Hospital, large tertiary general hospital, Beijing
result.standard: Scan and view completeness of 70% or more, and logbook image quality score of 42 or more (70% of maximum), acceptable

cycle1.result: Overall scan completeness 77.4%; 189 logbooks (73.8%) had acceptable completeness; median image quality score 37 (IQR 28-46) with 96 (37.5%) acceptable; 23 sonographers (63.9%) had completeness above 70%.

result.other_findings: Sonographers with intermediate titles did more scans and had better completeness (87% vs 69%) and image scores (43.24 vs 31.62) than senior ones.

result.topic: Comprehensive care dentistry clinic in undergraduate training
result.setting: Comprehensive Care Dentistry internship clinic, tertiary care dental institute, Lahore

cycle1.result: Key performance indicators (cross-infection protocols, patient turnover and satisfaction, material use, coordination, completion rates) assessed; high patient satisfaction and improved intern accountability reported without figures.

result.topic: Immediate skin-to-skin contact and breastfeeding initiation

result.setting: Respiratory outpatient clinics in 45 hospitals (EPOCONSUL audit)

cycle1.result: 1562 (37%) patients had cardiovascular disease; poor COPD control more common with CVD (44.2% vs 29.1%, p < 0.001).

result.topic: Axillary and breast-conserving surgery in breast cancer

result.topic: Clear aligner accuracy in extraction cases
result.setting: Orthodontic practice (setting not clearly stated)

cycle1.result: Clinically significant linear discrepancies (> 0.5 mm) at several tooth groups, e.g. maxillary central incisors 0.61 mm and 0.87 mm; all angular discrepancies exceeded 2 degrees.

result.standard: In-house appropriateness algorithm based on international and national guidelines and institutional protocols

cycle1.result: Of 1825 carbapenem therapies across all phases, 458 (25%) were inappropriate, mainly unnecessarily broad spectrum (72%, 331/458).

cycle2.result: Immediate 11% fall in inappropriate prescribing in the first intervention month (P = 0.001), then an immediate 14.9% rise at the start of the post-intervention phase (P = 0.001), a rebound after withdrawal.

result.topic: Olanzapine prophylaxis for chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting

result.standard: ASCO and NCCN antiemetic guidelines recommending olanzapine for highly emetogenic chemotherapy

result.setting: Expert consultation for low- and middle-income countries (MOMENTUM Safe Surgery project)

result.setting: Department of Otolaryngology, Birmingham Heartlands Hospital

cycle1.result: Minicraniectomy gave significantly less pain from three months than wide craniectomy (p < 0.05); bone flap replacement reduced pain only after 12 months.

result.other_findings: Mean Glasgow Benefit Inventory score -6.6 with no difference between techniques.

result.setting: Department of Oral and Facial Surgery, Sunderland Royal Hospital

cycle1.result: 24 (35%) had early sensory abnormality, persisting beyond two years in one; frontalis weakness in 15 (22%) fully recovered by one year.

result.other_findings: Three developed male pattern baldness exposing the scar; a modified incision with preauricular extension is proposed.

result.topic: Carotid endarterectomy monitoring and quality control
result.setting: Department of Vascular Surgery, Leicester Royal Infirmary

cycle1.result: 30-day death or stroke 2.2%; intraoperative stroke 0.2%; ipsilateral embolic stroke 0.8%.

result.intervention: Intraoperative transcranial Doppler, completion angioscopy and 3 hours postoperative TCD guiding selective dextran.

cycle2.result: Operative risk fell by 60% compared with before the protocol.

result.other_findings: 22 patients had sustained embolisation needing dextran; no carotid thrombosis strokes.

result.setting: Specialist breast clinic, Victoria Infirmary, Glasgow

cycle1.result: 35% of referrals urgent; 28% of urgent and 37% of non-urgent referrals inappropriate according to guidelines.

result.other_findings: 10% of referrals had breast cancer and 90% benign disease or no pathology.

result.setting: Genitourinary Medicine Department, Newcastle General Hospital
result.standard: National gonorrhoea guideline with auditable targets

cycle1.result: Chlamydia screening or presumptive treatment 98%; effective first-line therapy 95.4%; test of cure within one month 68.2%; partner notification discussion documented 94.3%; partner attendance 65%.

result.other_findings: Microscopy sensitivity 90.4% for male urethral and 26.6% for female genital gonorrhoea; culture sensitivity 98.5%.

result.setting: UK Cardiothoracic Transplant Audit

cycle1.result: Benefit of splitting lung blocks for two single lung transplants may not be double that of one bilateral transplant.

result.other_findings: Population-based outcome comparison; no figures in abstract.

result.topic: Team features in diabetes audit success
result.setting: 18 general practices in Leicestershire

cycle1.result: Four team features associated with improvement: personal involvement in audit, good teamwork, systematic plans for obstacles and positive attitude to monitoring.

result.other_findings: Positive attitude to audit and personal interest in diabetes were not associated with improvement.

result.setting: Fast-access breast clinic, Eastbourne District General Hospital

cycle1.result: 80% of referrals adhered to guidelines; 73% deemed urgent and seen within 2 weeks; all patients later diagnosed with breast cancer seen within 2 weeks.

result.other_findings: Suggests specific changes to the referral guidelines.

result.setting: Clatterbridge and Aintree Stroke Rehabilitation Units, Merseyside

cycle1.result: No major differences between encouraged and discouraged self-propulsion groups on any outcome.

result.other_findings: Pilot randomised trial showing a multicentre trial is feasible.

result.setting: 184 sites in the National Sentinel Audit of Stroke

cycle1.result: Kappa ranged 0.49 to 0.87 (median 0.70, IQR 0.63-0.78); very good agreement for 7 of 45 items, good for 30 and moderate for 8.

result.other_findings: Auditors from different disciplines used in 77% of cases; careful piloting and clear instructions promoted reliability.

result.setting: Queenscourt Hospice, Southport

cycle1.result: Almost half of calls and visits were received outside office hours, mostly handled by nursing staff.

result.intervention: Organisational and educational initiatives developed as a result of the audit.
result.other_findings: Describes nature of calls and advice given.

result.setting: Genitourinary medicine clinics, Victoria Hospital, Kirkcaldy

cycle1.result: 80% concerned about heterosexual transmission, 9.5% MSM, 4.8% IDUs; 83% accepted an STI screen with 44 STIs diagnosed.

result.other_findings: About half presented within the window period, and half of those choosing deferred testing did not return.

result.topic: Vascular wound and graft infection outcomes
result.setting: Multi-centre audit in Great Britain and Ireland

cycle1.result: 75 complex wound infections and 55 graft infections, MRSA the commonest single organism in both; 30 (55%) graft infections led to death or amputation.

result.topic: Breast cytology C3 and C4 categories
result.setting: Department of Histopathology, Nottingham City Hospital

cycle1.result: C3 used in 3.7% (555) and C4 in 3.9% (587), total 7.6%; 32% of C3 and 81% of C4 were malignant.

result.topic: Stroke unit care and stroke care standards
result.setting: 157 trusts in England, Wales and Northern Ireland (National Sentinel Audit of Stroke)
result.standard: Royal College of Physicians Intercollegiate Working Party stroke audit standards

cycle1.result: 19% of patients managed on stroke units.

cycle2.result: Stroke unit management rose to 26%; formal cognitive assessment 41%, weighed 46%, physiotherapy assessment within 72 h 67%, mood plan 24%, carers' needs assessed 36%.

result.other_findings: Many standards remained poor despite improvement on both stroke units and general wards.

result.topic: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination in diabetes
result.setting: Diabetes outpatients in Middlesbrough, Gateshead and Newcastle
result.standard: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination of patients with diabetes

cycle1.result: 35% (93/268) received both vaccines, 24% (64/268) influenza only, none pneumococcal only.

result.topic: Lymph node yield in pancreatoduodenectomy specimens
result.setting: Royal Liverpool University Hospital, one specialist pathologist

cycle1.result: Median 7.0 lymph nodes in non-grouped cases vs 12.0 in grouped cases (significantly lower).

result.other_findings: Suggests illustrations of lymph node sites in pathology proformas.

result.setting: 8 centres in the Yorkshire region
result.standard: Standard baseline investigations for new HIV patients (20 for men, 21 for women)

result.other_findings: not reported

cycle1.result: Proportion spending more than half their stay in stroke unit care varied from 10% to 27% between regions; 30-day mortality 21% to 33%.

result.other_findings: Institutionalisation of those admitted from home varied 6% to 19%, unexplained by case-mix.

result.standard: Recording of pain assessment and reassessment using quantified methods

cycle1.result: Pain reassessment not recorded in 29%; quantified methods used in 21% of initial assessments and less than 2% of reassessments.

result.other_findings: Quantified pain measurement was not standard physiotherapy practice.

result.topic: Antiepileptic drug use in learning disability
result.setting: Adult in-patients, Northgate and Prudhoe NHS Trust

result.setting: Eight genitourinary medicine clinics in Yorkshire

cycle1.result: Default rate 20/42 (47.6%); seroconversion 21/22 (95.5%) among completers.

result.other_findings: The only non-responder was HIV-positive.

result.standard: Nutritional adequacy of menus and recommended portion sizes

cycle1.result: Menus nutritionally inadequate for energy, fibre and vitamin D, with variable protein; meal wastage and inadequate portion sizes were of concern.

cycle1.result: 36 of 37 (97%) surgeons collected CEA data, two thirds prospectively; only three outcomes (postoperative TIA, stroke and death) common to all five tools.

cycle1.result: Three-year graft survival 74.2% (heart), 53.8% (lung), 57.2% (heart-lung).

result.setting: Nine GP practices in the UK and Republic of Ireland

cycle1.result: 60% prescribed 1-36 triptan tablets in 12 months, 7% 37-53, 15% 54-94, 9% 95-149 and 7% 150 or more.

result.setting: Stoma-care department, Addenbrooke's NHS Trust, Cambridge

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Abstract gives aims only; no results reported.

result.setting: Auckland Healthcare, large teaching hospital
result.standard: Early temporal artery biopsy of adequate length and osteoporosis prophylaxis with steroids

cycle1.result: Mean wait for biopsy 5.6 days (9.3 rheumatology vs 2.6 ophthalmology, P = 0.003); only 44/117 (37.6%) specimens longer than 10 mm; osteoporosis prophylaxis in 24/37 (65%) GCA patients.

result.setting: Neurobehavioural rehabilitation service, St Andrew's Hospital, Northampton

cycle1.result: 3914 acts of aggression recorded, 443 physical assaults on others.

result.setting: Beaumont Hospital, Dublin, university teaching hospital
result.standard: Royal College of Physicians stroke audit package (13 key areas)

cycle1.result: CT and carotid Dopplers documented in 93%; power 87%, sensation 70%, eye movements 63%, but cognition 3%, visual fields 13%, gait 7%, incontinence 1% and swallowing 0%.

result.setting: Acute trusts, health authorities and general practices in England and Wales (Audit Commission)

cycle1.result: Wide variation in routine care, lack of data on structured care, delays in access and insufficient information for self-management.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Neurology unit

cycle1.result: Audit tool used to review nursing care plans; no figures reported.

result.intervention: Use of an audit tool for care planning
result.other_findings: The authors report that the audit tool led to more patient-focused, individualised and holistic care planning.

result.setting: Internet-based survey of AIDA software downloaders (St Bartholomew's Hospital, London)

cycle1.result: 30-day stroke/death rate 3.9% (33/836); observed surgeon rates 2.9-4.4%; no surgeon diverged from predicted rates after risk adjustment (Bayesian p > 0.05).
