cycle1.result: Specialist review within two weeks in 67.7%; ART within 91 days in 83%.

result.other_findings: Delays in those tested at home or in general practice; community support and U = U seldom discussed; long ART delays mostly from initial declining or missed appointments.

result.setting: 51 UK rheumatology centres (BSR SLE audit data)

cycle1.result: 344 (34.3%) had a shielding score ≥3; previous or current lupus nephritis 2.6 times more likely in shielding group.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Age disparities in stroke rehabilitation care
result.setting: 127 Australian hospitals (Stroke Foundation national stroke rehabilitation audit)

cycle1.result: Age-related differences in characteristics, management and outcomes.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: UK sexual health and HIV services (BASHH 2018 national audit)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: National HIV partner notification standards (2015) developed in response to the 2013 audit, with clearer definitions.

cycle2.result: Significant improvement in the number of contacts tested per index case; scope remains to improve informing and testing contactable contacts.

result.other_findings: Recommends a national HIV partner notification proforma.

result.setting: National Association of Diabetes Centres and Australian National Diabetes Audit

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes national standards, accreditation and audit/benchmarking for Australian diabetes centres.

result.setting: National Diabetes Audit, England and Wales

cycle1.result: Included 98% of adults with diagnosed type 1 and type 2 diabetes compared with 2019/20 QOF.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Pre-admission clinic, Westmead Hospital, Sydney
result.standard: Australian Diabetes Society guidelines on pre-operative SGLT2 inhibitor cessation

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Protocolised pre-operative cessation of SGLT2 inhibitors.

cycle2.result: No clinically detected diabetic ketoacidosis among the 96 patients in the study; withdrawal did not significantly alter pre-operative glycaemia.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Neonatal unit, Princess Anne Hospital, Southampton
result.standard: National Neonatal Audit Programme: 90% normothermia on admission in infants born under 30 weeks

cycle1.result: Normothermia 58%.

result.intervention: Phase 1 (2011-2016) low-fidelity simulation; phase 2 (2017) in situ simulation, videos, allocated thermal care team member, thermal care protocol, 'lollipop man' coordinator, monthly feedback and servo-controlled continuous temperature monitoring.

cycle2.result: 90% normothermia standard achieved in 2018, just short in 2019 due to more hyperthermia.

result.other_findings: Phase 1 raised normothermia to 75% then plateaued; phase 2 cut hypothermia from 16% to 3%.

result.topic: Cardiovascular risk management in rheumatoid arthritis
result.setting: RA patients in 19 countries (international audit)
result.standard: 2016 European guidelines for CVD risk and lipid goals; BP goal <140/90 mmHg

cycle1.result: 44% of those with indication used lipid-lowering treatment; lipid goal attainment 45% (high risk) and 18% (very high risk); about half of 62% with hypertension at BP goal.

result.other_findings: Very high estimated CVD risk in 21%, ranging from 5% in Mexico to 31% in Central and Eastern Europe.

result.setting: Nottingham hospitals, acute stroke register

cycle1.result: A quarter unable to perform some everyday activities at 6 months; 18% received outpatient occupational therapy and 42% physiotherapy; a third had not seen their GP since discharge.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Glycaemic control trends in type 2 diabetes
result.setting: Australian National Diabetes Audit

cycle1.result: Mean HbA1c unchanged at 7.8%-8.3% (62-67 mmol/mol) despite more antihyperglycaemic agents.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Care Quality Commission, England

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes CQC use of national clinical audit outliers in regulation, with two case studies.

result.setting: National Diabetes Audit, England and Wales

cycle1.dates: 1 January 2009 to 31 March 2010, followed to 31 December 2019
cycle1.result: Completing five or fewer vs eight care processes: mortality HR 1.37 (type 1) and 1.32 (type 2).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Stroke audit data extraction by machine learning
result.setting: Three NHS hospitals (SSNAP comorbidity data)

cycle1.result: SSNAP reporting good for atrial fibrillation, hypertension and diabetes but poor for heart failure; MedCAT performed better for all four comorbidities.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: UK clinical biochemistry laboratories (ACB national audit)
result.standard: Endocrine Society guidelines on investigation and management of PPGL

cycle1.result: Most laboratories used urine or plasma metanephrines first line; all in-house assays used LC or LC-MS/MS; marked variation in reference ranges and sample requirements.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Burns service quality in low and middle income countries
result.setting: 11 burn services in Nepal and Bangladesh (Interburns)
result.standard: Internationally agreed operational standards for burn care service delivery

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Tool development paper; scores improved by more than 19% in both countries.

result.setting: National Diabetes Audit, England

cycle1.result: Remission incidence 9.7 per 1,000 person-years overall.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Large category B male prison, with regional specialist epilepsy service
result.standard: Standards of epilepsy healthcare provision (not named in abstract)

cycle1.result: Only 38.2% had a specialist review in the last 12 months; 67.3% needed further optimisation of anti-seizure medication; 12.7% seizure-free for 12 months; 76.4% did not recall guidance on precautions for duties or cell arrangements.

result.other_findings: Point prevalence of epilepsy was 2%; high rates of alcohol (40%) and drug (82%) misuse and mental health problems (85.5%); just over a third were prescribed medicines with potential for diversion.

result.setting: Renal service, Nepean Hospital, New South Wales

cycle1.result: Adjustment to illness and treatment was the commonest psychosocial issue (90%) before or at start of kidney replacement therapy, falling to 39% in the supportive and palliative care phase.

result.other_findings: Described as a secondary data audit but reports prevalence of psychosocial issues without a standard; need for aged care assistance rose from 7.6% to 63%.

result.setting: Secondary care hospital(s), Brighton and Sussex
result.standard: HIV testing of patients presenting with a clinical indicator condition (CIC)

cycle1.result: 222 (9.0%) of patients aged 50 or over with a CIC received an HIV test within 31 days of discharge.

result.other_findings: Patients who were tested were significantly younger (mean 68.6 v 75.3 years).

result.setting: Two specialist stroke units

cycle1.result: Readmission rates rose with stroke severity and comorbidity; longer stroke admission and early supported discharge reduced 90-day readmissions.

result.other_findings: Readmission rates differed between the two hospitals and between 30 and 90 days; authors recommend using both 30 and 90-day readmissions.

result.setting: 106 NHS hospitals (ABCD national audit)

cycle1.result: Mean time in range was 44.8% (±22.5); at 7.9 months mean follow-up HbA1c improved by -6.9 (13.5) mmol/mol.

result.other_findings: Of 16,427 participants, 1241 had time-in-range data; time in range above 70% was linked with no hypoglycaemia or DKA admissions and fewer paramedic callouts.

result.setting: 35 UK HIV care centres (national audit)
result.standard: BHIVA 2010 guidelines for management of HIV-2

cycle1.result: 79% (132/167) had taken ART; 79% (70/89) of treatment-naive people started a protease inhibitor-based regimen; 29% (15/52) with detectable viral load had no baseline resistance testing; virological failure in 16% (21/132).

result.other_findings: Nearly half (46%) were cared for at four London centres; integrase inhibitor use has increased over time.

result.setting: 120 specialist foot care services (National Diabetes Foot Care Audit)

cycle1.result: 12,925 (47.8%) were alive and ulcer-free at 12 weeks, 50.9% had an unhealed ulcer and 1.3% had died.

result.other_findings: After case-mix adjustment, four services were more than 3SD above and seven more than 3SD below the national mean; longer time to expert assessment was linked with worse outcome.

result.setting: UK hospitals (ABCD national FreeStyle Libre audit)

cycle1.result: HbA1c change from baseline across follow-up groups was -6, -6, -4 and -4 mmol/mol.

result.other_findings: 16,834 people with type 1 diabetes; improvements in HbA1c, hypoglycaemia awareness and distress were sustained for over two years.

result.setting: Inpatient prosthetic rehabilitation programme, rehabilitation hospital (Parkwood Institute)

cycle1.result: The oldest old (80+, n=63) achieved similar functional mobility outcomes to people aged 60-79.

result.other_findings: Retrospective chart audit of outcomes; authors conclude advanced age alone should not exclude prosthetic rehabilitation.

result.setting: Velindre Cancer Centre, Welsh NHS trust
result.standard: All Wales DNACPR policy and audit template

cycle1.result: Forms showed consistency in completion (figures not given in abstract).

result.intervention: Trust adopted the new national DNACPR form; education events on the all Wales policy; TalkCPR videos and e-learning modules disseminated.

cycle2.result: Clearer documentation of discussions with patients and families, and of reasons why and when conversations had not taken place; improved in several domains.

result.other_findings: Authors suggest a central electronic record for advance care plans could improve further.

result.setting: Pulvertaft Hand Centre, Royal Derby Hospital (tertiary hand centre)

cycle1.result: All approaches (Norwich regimen, RME plus, RME only) gave similar good to excellent outcomes by total active motion and Miller's classification, with no ruptures or secondary surgery.

result.intervention: Practice shifted from the Norwich regimen to the relative motion extension approach, guided by yearly audit review and emerging evidence.
result.other_findings: 56 RME and 23 Norwich patients; described as a prospective internal audit of outcomes used to support practice change.

result.setting: UK acute NHS radiology departments (national audit)

cycle1.result: 41% (inpatients) and 56% (outpatients) had the recommended PC-AKI risk assessment; 68% used the advised renal protection threshold; 9% had correct hypersensitivity risk assessment; 36% had the correct risk mitigation protocol.

result.other_findings: 61% (129/211) of departments responded; renal function testing was often over-used and documentation and follow-up of hypersensitivity reactions were inadequate.

result.setting: 25 hospitals with first seizure clinics (NAPIER national audit)
result.standard: Guideline standards for management of suspected first seizure and epilepsy (review within 2 weeks)

cycle1.result: Median time to review 48 days; 13.8% seen within 2 weeks; witness account documented in 85.0% and driving advice in 79.7%; SUDEP discussion in 30.1% of those diagnosed with epilepsy.

result.other_findings: 12.7% had seizure recurrence while awaiting first appointment; median time to MRI 37 days and EEG 30 days; 30.4% referred to epilepsy nurse specialists.

result.setting: 102 UK specialist diabetes centres (ABCD FreeStyle Libre audit)

cycle1.result: At mean follow-up of 6.9 months the Gold score improved from 2.3 ± 1.5 to 2.0 ± 1.3 in drivers with type 1 diabetes.

result.other_findings: 6304 had driving status recorded, of whom 4218 held a licence; authors suggest isCGM may reduce severe hypoglycaemia in drivers.

result.setting: Hull Royal Infirmary, UK tertiary centre
result.standard: Mechanical thrombectomy for acute ischaemic stroke with large vessel occlusion

cycle1.result: Only 6 (17%) patients presenting out of hours with anterior circulation LVO received mechanical thrombectomy.

result.other_findings: Service runs 08:00-16:00 weekdays; those treated presented early morning; poor communication between staff cited, and an in-hospital protocol for late-window thrombectomy proposed.

result.topic: Rehabilitation length of stay and disability funding delays
result.setting: Tertiary regional inpatient rehabilitation unit, John Hunter Hospital, NSW

cycle1.result: Patients referred to the NDIS significantly exceeded expected rehabilitation length of stay and had lower FIM efficiency.

result.other_findings: Recent improvement in NDIS acceptance timeframes did not reduce length of stay.

result.topic: Patient understanding of national audit data
result.setting: Outpatient neurosurgery clinics, Royal Victoria Infirmary, Newcastle

cycle1.result: 89.0% were unaware of the NNAP; 51.0% felt they understood consultant mortality outcomes; 35.1% understood the funnel plot.

result.other_findings: Understanding related to educational level.

result.setting: 137 hospitals in 41 countries (OGAA)

cycle1.result: Anastomotic leak rate 14.2% and conduit necrosis rate 2.7%.

result.other_findings: Leak risk score performed poorly (AUROC 0.618); conduit necrosis score validated with AUROC 0.775.

result.setting: Tertiary cancer centre (Tata Memorial Centre, ACTREC), elective head and neck surgery
result.standard: Six critical perioperative infection prevention and control standards (Clean Cut programme)

cycle1.result: Teams complied with a mean of 3.56 of the six critical infection control components at baseline.

result.intervention: Clean Cut programme: surveillance, audits and infection prevention training with a checklist for 6 months, then no active oversight.

cycle2.result: Compliance rose to a mean of 4.66 of six components after implementation, with reduced SSI rates in the short term.

result.other_findings: At 1-year follow-up (n=50) without oversight, compliance and SSI rates returned to baseline values.

result.topic: End of life care family experience
result.setting: Acute and community hospitals in England and Wales (NACEL bereavement survey)

cycle1.result: Over 70% rated care for the dying person as good, excellent or outstanding; at least 66% rated care for themselves the same; at least 76% felt staff communicated sensitively.

result.other_findings: Over 70% were happy with their involvement in decisions about care.

result.setting: Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: PVC bacteraemia incidence had risen by 267% compared with the previous year.

result.intervention: Educational poster on PVC infection severity and prevention messages, with teaching sessions delivered to each clinical area by the infection prevention team.

cycle2.result: 54.5% decrease in PVC bacteraemia incidence; an audit in January-March 2024 found zero cases for the first time in 2 years.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: UK clinical biochemistry laboratories (national survey audit)
result.standard: Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline on primary aldosteronism

cycle1.result: 50 of 147 laboratories (34.0%) responded; wide variation in reference intervals and cut-offs, and diagnostic algorithms were not universal.

result.other_findings: Saline infusion was the commonest confirmatory test; authors call for national harmonisation.

result.setting: STS General Thoracic Surgery Database

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Database update report; participant public reporting increased 50% over 2 years.

result.setting: National Early Inflammatory Arthritis Audit, England and Wales

cycle1.result: Patients with PsA had longer time from GP presentation to diagnosis than RA (mean 112 v 89 days); fewer DMARDs at baseline in polyarticular PsA (54.0% v 69.0%).

result.other_findings: Lower improvement in disease activity at 3 months in PsA, suggesting undertreatment.

result.setting: Diabetes centres in the Australian National Diabetes Audit
result.standard: Evidence-based clinical targets for modifiable cardiovascular risk factors (e.g. HbA1c ≤7% or 53 mmol/mol; physical activity ≥150 min/week)

cycle1.result: 25.9% met the HbA1c target, 45.5% the LDL cholesterol target, 30.2% the physical activity target, and 85.0% were non-smokers.

result.other_findings: People with type 2 diabetes and those with existing cardiovascular disease were less likely to meet targets.

result.setting: 11 surgical and obstetrics and gynaecology units, Obafemi Awolowo University Teaching Hospitals Complex, Ile-Ife (tertiary hospital)
result.standard: Recommendations for preoperative surgical site marking to prevent wrong-site surgery

cycle1.result: Surgical site was marked in only 36.4% of surgeries involving laterality.

result.other_findings: Marking was done by junior residents and nurses in 90.2% and with paper tape in 92.2%; marking varied significantly by specialty.

result.topic: Transition to adult type 1 diabetes care
result.setting: 5 paediatric diabetes centres, Ontario Pediatric Diabetes Network
result.standard: Completion of important transition care activities

cycle1.result: 10.3% of the early cohort reported completing all transition activities they considered important.

result.intervention: Bridging the Gap: an audit and feedback-based intervention on transition care.

cycle2.result: Mean number of important transition activities completed was 13% lower (adjusted rate ratio 0.87); 4.1% completed all important activities.

result.other_findings: The intervention did not improve transition care, possibly due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

result.setting: Department of Nephrology and Transplantation, University Hospitals Plymouth
result.standard: Cytomegalovirus infection within 6 months of kidney transplantation; valganciclovir dosing by Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance

cycle1.result: CMV infection rate within 6 months post-transplant was 22.5%.

result.intervention: Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance added to electronic renal software; dosing cards printed for clinics; staff awareness; valganciclovir prophylaxis offered to CMV IgG-seropositive recipients; considering reduced immunosuppression after MDT approval.

cycle2.result: CMV infection rate fell to 5.8%, with reductions in all risk categories; valganciclovir dosing accuracy increased.

result.other_findings: Two PDSA cycles after the baseline audit.

result.topic: Nasogastric feeding at end of life
result.setting: Acute hospital trust, East Sussex

cycle1.result: 84 (4.8%) had nasogastric tube flags; 28 (33%) died during admission and 40 (47.6%) within six months.

result.other_findings: Audit of outcomes; authors conclude NGT insertions in this group have a high likelihood of being non-beneficial.

result.topic: Cold ischaemia time in kidney transplantation
result.setting: 14 UK kidney transplant centres
result.standard: National recommended cold ischaemia time: 12 hours for DCD and 18 hours for DBD kidneys

cycle1.result: Median CIT 11:08 h; 42% of DCD and 15% of DBD kidneys exceeded the national recommended duration.

result.other_findings: CIT was longer in centres with dedicated transplant theatres (median 13:41 v 09:43 h).

result.setting: Neurointerventional centres in England and Wales (Delphi panel)

cycle1.result: Consensus reached on data entry methods and definitions for reporting clinically relevant complications after mechanical thrombectomy.

result.other_findings: Delphi consensus study to support national audit; 21 respondents in round two.

result.setting: UK hospitals (ABCD nationwide audit)

cycle1.result: Prevalence of high diabetes distress (DDS ≥3) was 42%; 43% in type 1 v 40% in type 2.

result.other_findings: Mean DDS score 2.7; BMI negatively correlated with high distress.

result.setting: St Andrew's Centre for Plastic Surgery and Burns, Broomfield Hospital (free flap audit registry)

cycle1.result: Triangular prism CT method overestimated flap weight by a mean of 41 g, with limits of agreement -530 to 614 g, exceeding the 100 g acceptable difference.

result.other_findings: Validation study using registry data; 164 DIEPs recorded, 73% with complete data.

result.setting: Royal Free London NHS Foundation Trust (hand trauma pathway)

cycle1.result: Estimated carbon footprint of a flexor tendon repair pathway was about 113.2 kgCO2eq; patient travel made up 79.4%.

result.other_findings: Rehabilitation phase contributed 52.9% of emissions; suggestions include virtual hand therapy, reusable gowns and drapes and WALANT.

result.setting: Australian National Diabetes Audit

cycle1.result: Prevalence of acute glycaemic emergencies was 7.1%.

result.other_findings: Odds of glycaemic emergencies were higher with comorbidities, highest with more than 4 comorbidities (OR 3.71).

result.setting: NHS hospital trusts in England (national survey)
result.standard: GIRFT 2020 national report recommendations for inpatient diabetes care

cycle1.result: About 85% of hospitals had access to Diabetes Inpatient Specialist Nurses but nearly two-thirds had no weekend DISN service; access to diabetes physician and out-of-hours advice was limited.

result.other_findings: Trusts with higher specialist staffing had shorter length of stay and fewer 30-day readmissions; authors call for reinstating a national bedside inpatient audit.

result.setting: Irish National Audit of Stroke hospitals

cycle1.result: 618 (5.7%) strokes occurred in hospital; stroke unit admission was less frequent for in-hospital strokes (44.2% v 70.2%).

result.other_findings: In-hospital stroke patients had longer delays to medical assessment and thrombolysis, poorer functional outcomes and higher mortality.

result.setting: National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery, London
result.standard: Guidelines on urinary catheterisation; trial without catheter within 24 hours

cycle1.result: 94% UTI rate with indwelling catheters; indwelling catheter use 25.6% in 2020; TWOC within 24 h 3% in 2021.

result.intervention: Nurse-led trial without catheter, early physiotherapy, bowel care and constipation prevention, tailored protocols, staff education and clinical champions.

cycle2.result: Indwelling catheter use fell to 11% by end-2023; CAUTI fell to 45.5% by 2024; TWOC within 24 h rose to 93% in 2024.

result.other_findings: Three sequential audits and six linked QIPs over five years; gains sustained with quarterly education and biannual data review.

result.setting: Stroke rehabilitation programme, Parkwood Institute, St Joseph's Health Care London, Ontario
result.standard: Stroke Sexual Health Practice Profile (PLISSIT model) documentation protocols

cycle1.result: Surveys identified gaps in patient awareness of post-stroke sexual health and provider confidence.

result.intervention: Stroke Sexual Health Practice Profile: scripts, educational materials and documentation protocols; online modules (86.3% completed) and workshops (62.1% attended).

cycle2.result: Chart audits showed increased documentation of sexual health discussions over time; staff knowledge and comfort improved and were partially sustained at 6 months.

result.other_findings: Patient awareness and comfort discussing sexual health improved after implementation.

result.setting: Acute geriatric wards in seven hospitals in France, Germany, Italy, Switzerland and the UK
result.standard: European guidelines on malnutrition screening and management

cycle1.result: 33.8% of staff rated their knowledge good or excellent; 44.6% estimated malnutrition prevalence at 25% or more.

result.intervention: Educational infographic displayed for 4 weeks on wards, with a QR code linking to national guidelines.

cycle2.result: Good or excellent knowledge rose to 56.1% and correct prevalence estimates to 62.3%; point-prevalence audits suggested increased documentation of nutritional screening at several sites.

result.other_findings: Confidence in screening (35.4% to 37.3%) and acting on malnutrition (35.4% to 39.3%) changed little.

result.setting: UK hospitals (ABCD National FreeStyle Libre Audit)

cycle1.result: High diabetes distress present in 51.5%; recurrent diabetes-related admissions independently associated with high distress (aOR 1.94).

result.other_findings: Structured education modified the association between admissions and distress.

result.setting: Tertiary breast referral clinic, Beaumont Hospital, Dublin
result.standard: Best practice guidelines on chaperone presence and its documentation during intimate examination

cycle1.result: Chaperone presence was observed in 100% of consultations but documented in only 7.6%.

result.intervention: First a 'chaperone stamp' in the notes before consultation; then, after moving to electronic records, a mandatory check field for chaperone documentation.

cycle2.result: Mandatory electronic check field achieved 100% documentation of chaperone presence.

result.other_findings: Three cycles, 388 patients in total; the stamp improved documentation by 51.1% but this fell by 13.6% at six months.

result.setting: 11 cytopathology laboratories serving 19 districts, former North Western region
result.standard: Laboratory fail-safe monitoring of action after an abnormal cervical smear

cycle1.result: Laboratories held complete follow-up records in 740 (78.4%) cases; FHSA records extended this to 910 (96.4%).

result.other_findings: Poor communication was the main problem; computerisation was not needed to improve fail-safe procedures.

result.setting: Regional Plastic Surgery Unit, Bangour General Hospital, West Lothian

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes using intermediate equivalents with case numbers to audit operative workload.

result.setting: Southern Derbyshire hospitals, GP premises, ambulance stations and dental practices

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes an infection control audit tool used to monitor compliance and prompt education; no figures given.

result.setting: Bacteriology laboratory, Addenbrooke's Hospital, Cambridge
result.standard: Internal quality assessment by specimen resubmission (consistency of results)

cycle1.result: Mean discrepancy rate nearly 15% in the first two years.

result.intervention: Audit of microbiologists' comments added with a standardised scoring scheme; laboratory techniques altered and staff training (sputum bacteriology, anaerobe recognition, better cabinet lighting).

cycle2.result: Overall discrepancy rate fell from 9.4% to 3.2%; 325 (7.4%) resubmitted specimens gave discrepant results.

result.other_findings: Staphylococcal and mixed-culture urine recognition and faecal microscopy remained hard to fix; 20.3% discrepancy in medical comments but only 0.4% likely to change outcome.

result.topic: Methotrexate with folic acid in rheumatoid arthritis
result.setting: Rheumatic Diseases Unit, Western General Hospital, Edinburgh

cycle1.result: Probability of continuing methotrexate and folic acid at 1, 2, 3 and 4 years was 87%, 76%, 74% and 74%.

result.other_findings: Toxicity was frequent (59% in those continuing, 89% in those stopping); only 69% of long-term patients felt better.

result.setting: Teaching and district hospitals, northern region (Northern Vascular Surgeons Group)

cycle1.result: Overall mortality 25.8%; emergency 50.0%; elective 3.9% in teaching and 12.0% in district hospitals.

result.other_findings: Prospective audit identified 31% more cases than regional audit data; elective patients over 80 had 76% survival.

result.setting: Department of Vascular Surgery, Royal Infirmary, Edinburgh

cycle1.result: Operations rose from 107 to 153; continuing smokers fell from 79% to 60%; stenoses over 50% rose from 58% to 71%.

result.other_findings: Trend towards a higher-risk population with more severe carotid disease.

result.setting: Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Eastman Dental Hospital, London
result.standard: Clinically sound indications for third molar surgery

cycle1.result: Over half of patients did not have clinically sound indications for surgery.

result.other_findings: Complication rates were similar to other studies and satisfaction was high, but some symptom-free patients sustained nerve damage.

result.setting: 16 geriatric continuing care facilities in greater Glasgow

cycle1.result: 82% scored eight or less on a modified Barthel scale; 79% thought to need ongoing consultant supervision; 88% had formal consultant review in the previous month.

result.other_findings: 41% had specialised pressure-relieving equipment and 30% had a major adverse medical event in the previous six months.

result.setting: Four centres (UK Stroke Audit Group)

cycle1.result: Inter-rater reliability of the RCP stroke audit form was acceptable, especially with medically qualified auditors.

result.other_findings: Development and reliability study of an audit form.

result.setting: Department of Neurology, Leicester Royal Infirmary
result.standard: Rational antiepileptic drug therapy (monotherapy where possible)

cycle1.result: 22% on monotherapy and 43% on three or more AEDs.

result.intervention: Attempts to rationalise antiepileptic drug therapy.

cycle2.result: 16% on monotherapy and 28% on three or more AEDs; 22 patients had significant seizure deterioration.

result.other_findings: Only six clinical decisions were based on 305 AED levels costing 2525 pounds; newer AEDs were 65% of AED cost.

result.setting: Department of Clinical Microbiology, University College Hospital, London

cycle1.result: 28% of catheters removed at 1 year.

result.intervention: Eradication of nasal and perineal staphylococcal carriage, occlusive exit-site dressing, improved aseptic technique for dressing changes and keeping dressings dry.

cycle2.result: 13% of catheters removed at 1 year (P < 0.001), with fewer S. aureus peritonitis episodes.

result.other_findings: Not prospectively controlled; before-after comparison of outcomes.

result.setting: Department of Neurological Surgery, Institute of Neurology, London

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes an MRI technique to measure resection volumes after temporal lobe surgery.

result.setting: Atkinson Morley's Hospital, London (stand-alone neurosurgical unit)

cycle1.result: 89% were intubated; hypoxia 9.7%, hypercarbia 25.9%; arterial pressure monitored in only 50% of transfers; 28.9% of intubated patients got no sedation.

result.other_findings: In 33% of transfers the accompanying doctor was an SHO with under 6 months' anaesthetic experience.

result.topic: Effect of audit in long-stay care
result.setting: Four hospital continuing-care wards and an NHS nursing home, Royal London Hospital

cycle1.result: Audit (RCP CARE scheme) was not associated with measurable improvement in outcomes; deaths 11% on control wards v 35% on audited wards.

result.other_findings: Controlled evaluation of an audit package; staff attitudes to the scheme were positive.

result.topic: Regional audit in genitourinary and HIV medicine
result.setting: South East Thames region genitourinary medicine and HIV units

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes setting up regional audit meetings; regional guidelines produced in eleven topics.

result.topic: Subarachnoid haemorrhage outcomes in older patients
result.setting: Department of Clinical Neurosciences, Western General Hospital, Edinburgh

cycle1.result: Surgical mortality 1.1% with favourable outcome at discharge in 83.9% of operated patients; overall management mortality 24.4%.

result.other_findings: In-patient mortality was 68.6% in those without angiography; 5-year survival probability 0.826 for those discharged in good condition.

result.topic: Emergency plastic surgery delay to theatre
result.setting: Regional plastic surgery unit, Queen Mary's Hospital, Roehampton

cycle1.result: Mean delay from injury to operation was 16.9 h; 38% of operations took place after 2300 hours.

result.other_findings: Lack of theatre availability was the main cause of delay; transfer times contributed little.

result.setting: Department of Pathology, University of Wales College of Medicine, Cardiff

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes a method for quantitative audit of histopathology report content against locally agreed guidelines.

result.setting: Epilepsy clinic, Western Infirmary, Glasgow

cycle1.result: 65% treated at referral (58% monotherapy) v 77% at audit (68% monotherapy); 50% of 519 patients with data were seizure-free.

result.other_findings: Sedative anticonvulsants were withdrawn in 29%; poorer response linked to learning disability, birth injury and partial seizures.

result.setting: Acute investigation unit, St Bartholomew's Hospital, London

cycle1.result: The test was technically successful in all but 5; one significant adverse event with full recovery.

result.other_findings: A screening cortisol cut-off above 500 nmol/l would have avoided 10 (8%) tests.

result.setting: Department of Plastic Surgery, Addenbrooke's Hospital, Cambridge

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes the Cambridge Classification for grading plastic surgery outcomes.

result.setting: Cardiff Epilepsy Unit

cycle1.result: SUDEP occurred in about 1 in 500 patients per year.

result.other_findings: SUDEP cases were more likely to be male, have idiopathic generalised tonic-clonic seizures or take carbamazepine.

result.setting: Crosshouse Hospital, Scotland

result.setting: Nurse-led urology/oncology clinic, Ayr Hospital

cycle1.result: not reported

result.topic: Alcohol screening in the emergency department

result.setting: Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, Singapore General Hospital

result.setting: 32 paediatric wards in south-east France
result.standard: Recommended hygiene procedures for control of hospital-acquired diarrhoea

cycle1.result: Handwashing before care in over 95% of procedures; glove use 39.4% for technical procedures and 20.3% for diapering or temperature measurement.

result.setting: Institutions supported by the Centro Nacional de la Transfusión Sanguínea, Mexico City
result.standard: Guidelines for transfusion therapy of blood products

cycle1.result: Indication adequate in 849 (55%) and inadequate in 724 (45%) of 1,573 request forms.

cycle1.result: Baseline prevalence survey (figures not given in abstract).

cycle2.result: Case-mix-adjusted prevalence of pressure ulcers decreased over 5 years while the percentage of patients receiving adequate prevention and the number of enabling conditions increased.

result.topic: Good clinical practice in bone densitometry trials

cycle1.result: not reported

result.setting: Comprehensive Dentistry Clinic, Faculty of Dentistry, University of Seville
result.standard: 46 quality criteria for dental records; standard 75% completion per criterion

cycle1.result: Standard of 75% reached in 12 criteria.

cycle2.result: Standard of 75% reached in 29 criteria; fulfilment improved in 41 criteria, significantly in 25.

result.other_findings: Follow-up of an earlier audit (Phase III, 50 records).

result.setting: Department of General, Visceral and Transplantation Surgery, University Hospital Tübingen

cycle1.result: Lower leg motor weakness 14.7%; premature catheter dislodgement 14.5%; weakness in more than half of patients with lumbar epidurals.

result.intervention: Lumbar insertion abandoned in favour of thoracic placement only; catheters inserted deeper into the epidural space (5.2 vs 4.6 cm).

cycle2.result: Motor weakness 5.1% (OR 0.35; 95% CI 0.16-0.74); premature dislodgement 5.7% (OR 0.35; 95% CI 0.17-0.72).

result.other_findings: Odds of dislodgement fell by 43% for each extra centimetre of catheter advancement.

result.setting: 99 primary care practices with electronic records in 36 states
result.standard: Clinical practice guidelines across eight clinical areas: 31 process and 5 outcome quality measures, Summary Quality Index

cycle1.result: Baseline quality measures from EMRs of 847,073 patients (baseline values not reported in abstract).

result.intervention: Practice performance reports (audit and feedback), site visits for academic detailing and participatory planning, and network meetings sharing best practice.

cycle2.result: Yearly adjusted absolute improvement in Summary Quality Index 2.43% (95% CI 2.24%-2.63%); significant improvement in 29 of 36 measures, including all 5 outcome measures.

result.other_findings: Demonstration project involving 530 clinicians and staff.

result.setting: SA Ambulance Service, statewide
result.standard: Comparison with success rates of comparable groups

cycle1.result: Success after one or two attempts 65% (107/164); overall success 74% (121/164).

result.other_findings: Failures mostly due to patient anatomy (13), technique (9) and airway soiling (7); results below comparable groups.

result.setting: Emergency Department, Singapore General Hospital
result.standard: Door-to-balloon time for primary PCI (target not reported)

cycle1.result: Median door-to-balloon time 130.5 minutes.

result.intervention: Guideline-based, institution-specific written protocol for triage and management of suspected STEMI, with process and workflow changes.
result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Chronic disease mini-clinics, King Saud City Family and Community Medicine Centre, Riyadh
result.standard: Appropriateness of diabetes management against locally agreed guideline criteria

cycle1.result: Random samples of 30 files every two weeks plotted on p charts; mean non-conformities 5.0 at the start.

result.intervention: Periodic process audits with statistical process control charts displayed for all staff (feedback).

cycle2.result: Process-measure series: mean non-conformities fell from 5.0 to 1.4; proportion non-conforming fell by 10% within 3 months.

result.other_findings: Audit series with mixed outcome and process measures detected no change over a year.

result.setting: Referral centre, Military Hospital, Port Harcourt

cycle1.result: 110 indications: trauma 46.4%, tumours 39.0%, cysts 12.7%; 73% had surgery and 19% defaulted.

result.other_findings: Case series; defaults due to cost and preference for traditional treatment.

result.setting: New Zealand Cancer Registry compared with clinical record review

cycle1.result: Registry accuracy: age 96%; diagnosis date within 6 weeks >97%; tumour site >95%; sub-site 86%; grade 83%; stage 80%.

result.other_findings: Data quality study; registry accuracy improved over the period.

result.topic: Diabetes care process and outcome indicators
result.setting: Three diabetes care centres in Alexandria
result.standard: Selected indicators for structure, process and outcome of diabetes care

cycle1.result: Structure poor (no appointment and recall system, limited laboratory resources, no educational material); process of care poor for 69.2% of patients; control poor for 49.2%; only 30.6% free of complications; appointment compliance about 80%.

result.other_findings: Better outcome was associated with poorer process of care, probably because complications prompt more care.

result.setting: Telephone encounters between nurses and standardised patients, University of Ottawa

cycle1.result: DSAT-10 analysis of 76 encounters showed strengths in information provision and weaknesses in discussing values and support needs; kappa 0.55 (95% CI 0.49, 0.61).

result.other_findings: Instrument evaluation study; scores discriminated trained from untrained nurses.

result.setting: Derby anaesthetic department, district-wide (Derbyshire Royal Infirmary)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes implementation of an audit form for every anaesthetic read by optical mark reader into a database; no audit results reported.

result.topic: Postoperative pain management after cardiac surgery
result.setting: 18-bed surgical intensive care unit, University Hospitals of Geneva
result.standard: Acute pain management algorithm; implementation complete when adherence to 2 of 3 process indicators reached at least 70% over 2 months

cycle1.result: Pain at rest VAS 2.7 +/- 1.4 cm; no pain or often without pain 11%; sleep disturbance 68%.

result.intervention: Pain management algorithm implemented with training, pocket guidelines, regular audits and feedback.

cycle2.result: Pain at rest VAS 2.2 +/- 1.4 cm (P = .008); no pain or often without pain 37% (P = .005); sleep disturbance 35% (P = .012).

result.other_findings: No differences at 1 and 6 months postoperatively.

result.setting: Hospital-based breast imaging department, Chi-Mei Medical Center, Tainan
result.standard: ACR BI-RADS medical audit recommendations, with adjusted targets for Taiwan (PPV1 1.7%-3.4%; cancer detection 0.7-3.4 per 1,000)

cycle1.result: 89 biopsies, 22 cancers; PPV1 3.1%, PPV2 16.2%, PPV3 24.7%; cancer detection 2.7 per 1,000; minimal cancer 50%; node-negative 71.4%; recall rate 8.5%.

result.other_findings: Results fitted the proposed population-adjusted BI-RADS benchmarks.

result.setting: Seven referral hospitals in the five southernmost provinces
result.standard: Criterion-based clinical audit standards for severe pre-eclampsia/eclampsia, obstructed labour and postpartum haemorrhage

cycle1.result: 515 severe morbid conditions in 486 women (13.2%). Substandard care: no record of respiratory rate and tendon reflex in severe pre-eclampsia/eclampsia (35%); no antibiotic prophylaxis for obstructed labour (28%); no urine output record in postpartum haemorrhage (32%).

result.other_findings: Documentation for diagnosis of obstructed labour often incomplete; standard of care varied between hospitals.

result.topic: Breast screening diagnosis and treatment quality indicators
result.setting: Italian mammography screening programmes (GISMa national survey)
result.standard: GISMa quality indicators for screen-detected lesions

cycle1.result: Overall good quality; pre-operative diagnosis reached the acceptable target; sentinel node biopsy in more than 70% of screen-detected invasive cancers. Critical issues in waiting times, avoiding frozen section on small lesions and performing specimen X-ray.

result.other_findings: Results distributed to local programmes; possible overuse of sentinel node biopsy flagged. Preliminary 2006 data mentioned.

result.topic: Breast fine needle aspiration cytology accuracy
result.setting: Symptomatic breast clinic, General Hospital, Northampton

cycle1.result: FNA complete sensitivity 95.7%, specificity 100%; combined sensitivity with mammography and clinical assessment 99.7%.

result.other_findings: Reduced unnecessary biopsies and outpatient revisits.

result.setting: Pretoria Academic Hospital

cycle1.result: Severe morbidity 11.6%; case fatality 3.3%; mean gestation at delivery 35 weeks; 18 (9.7%) babies born before 34 weeks.

result.other_findings: Outcome review; most lesions were rheumatic valvular disease.

result.setting: Quebec hospitals performing 20 or more segmental breast resections for cancer
result.standard: 7 diagnostic elements chosen by a pathologist committee as essential in the surgical pathology report

cycle1.result: Overall conformity 85.0% (51 hospitals).

result.intervention: Centralised surveillance with feedback of results to hospitals.
result.other_findings: Sample sizes are hospitals.

result.setting: Tertiary referral hospital, Monash Medical Centre

cycle1.result: 56% of patients started haemodialysis with an AVF (earlier audit showed less than 50%).

result.intervention: Vascular access nurse coordinator and an algorithm to prioritise access surgery on the waiting list.

cycle2.result: 75% started with an AVF (P = 0.007); adjusted OR 2.85; catheter-days 2,833 vs 4,685.

result.other_findings: 184 patients started haemodialysis over 2005 and 2006 in total.

result.setting: 17 provincial hospitals providing endoscopy (3 tertiary, 5 regional, 9 district), Western Cape
result.standard: Internationally accepted standards for endoscope maintenance, disinfection and staffing

cycle1.result: 89 endoscopes (mean age 6.1 years); 26,434 procedures; mean delay to gastroscopy 9.25 weeks and colonoscopy 8 weeks; most units did not meet international standards for maintenance and disinfection; only 2 hospitals employed fully trained nurses.

result.other_findings: Sample is hospitals; at least 60% of adult endoscopy done at tertiary centres.

result.setting: Records of the Professional Practice Audit Service of the State of São Paulo, 1892-1932

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Historical study of physician origin, sex and training; not a clinical audit.

result.setting: School Dental Care Service, Hong Kong

cycle1.result: 58 children with true talon cusps identified from 11,537 records; supernumerary teeth, dens evaginatus and hypodontia each 5 (8.6%).

result.other_findings: Prevalence study; supernumerary teeth more common than in the general population.

result.topic: Low back pain referrals to neurosurgery
result.setting: Neurosurgical outpatients, Western Hospital, Victoria

cycle1.result: Prior physiotherapy, epidural injection or no pre-clinic imaging predicted MRI (p<0.02); neurogenic claudication (p<0.01) and neurological signs (p=0.02) predicted surgery.

result.other_findings: Referral guidelines for GPs and selective use of CT and MRI proposed.

result.setting: Re-examination of UK multicentre nuclear medicine audit data

cycle1.result: 12 of 13 datasets showed non-significant differences; probable ranges for each kidney defined (average SD/mean 3.6%); for five kidneys the mean exceeded the audit median by 3.5-15.3 SD.

result.other_findings: Methodological re-analysis; underestimation of MTT in some audit results attributed to analysis technique.

result.topic: Diagnostic x-ray radiation dose quality assurance
result.setting: State diagnostic x-ray inspection programme, New Jersey
result.standard: New Jersey regulation 'Quality Assurance Programs for Medical Diagnostic X-ray Installations' (quality control tests, frequencies and standards)

cycle1.result: Traditional machine-parameter inspections (baseline values not reported).

result.intervention: Outcome-based inspection of image quality and entrance skin exposure, credentialing of medical physicists and a mandatory facility quality assurance programme (regulation adopted 16 January 2001).

cycle2.result: Entrance skin exposure reduced by 34% for lumbar spine, 46% for chest and 66% for foot x-rays; image quality improved by 22%.

result.other_findings: Quality improvement extended to dental x-ray facilities.

result.setting: Aga Khan University Hospital, Karachi

cycle1.result: 42 cardiac arrests (2.99 per 10,000); anaesthesia primarily responsible in 9 (0.64 per 10,000); 26 considered avoidable; 10 discharged home.

result.other_findings: Higher rates with poor physical status, emergency surgery, infants and over-60s.

result.setting: Twenty community family practices in south-central Ontario

cycle1.result: Time-appropriate mammography rate 66.4% by sequential sample versus 58.8% by full practice audit (r2 = 0.50).

result.other_findings: Methodological comparison of sampling approaches for audit.

result.setting: Consecutive suicides in New Brunswick (psychological autopsy)

cycle1.result: More than half had contact with a mental health specialist in the last year but under 5% with addiction services; in one-third, service gaps called for better coordination of mental health and addiction services.

result.other_findings: Unmet needs for public awareness and professional training found in half of cases.

result.setting: SNOMED CT Procedure and Clinical Finding domains, Mayo Clinic

cycle1.result: Number of anonymous nodes correlated negatively with the number of fully defined concepts within a context.

result.other_findings: Informatics method paper; not a clinical audit.

result.setting: General surgical unit, Taranaki Base Hospital

cycle1.result: 243 admissions; complications 47.1% emergency, 18.3% elective, 23.3% non-operative; 30-day mortality 15.7% emergency, 0% elective, 17.4% non-operative; emergency laparotomy mortality 31.6%.

result.other_findings: Risk-adjusted outcome study; observed deaths fitted predicted.

result.setting: Single semi-rural general practice
result.standard: Quality and Outcomes Framework (2006) depression screening in patients with diabetes and ischaemic heart disease

cycle1.result: 365 of 435 (84%) screened; only 3 (1%) of those not already depressed screened positive, none diagnosed with depression.

result.other_findings: Screening produced no new diagnoses of depression.

result.setting: Community children's nursing team, Child Health Department, Bath

cycle1.result: 70% of letters from medical staff copied; community children's nurses copied 19%.

result.intervention: Implementation of the national copying-letters initiative.

cycle2.result: 74% of medical letters copied; community children's nurses copied 47%.

result.other_findings: Only 13 of 466 letters were sent to the child; 14 nurses interviewed about communication practice.

result.setting: Ophthalmology outpatients, Royal Glamorgan Hospital, Llantrisant
result.standard: Agreement of community referral data with hospital ophthalmic opinion at first outpatient assessment

cycle1.result: 23 (76.7%) of patients referred with cataract were listed for surgery; 86% (n = 7) of those not listed were not listed for lifestyle reasons; no association between lifestyle compromise on the referral and listing (P = 0.62).

result.other_findings: Referrals lacked quality-of-life information; a nurse-led direct referral service suggested.

result.setting: General medical and orthopaedic units, Royal Melbourne Hospital
result.standard: Best practice recommendations for pharmacological management of delirium (baseline before new Australian guidelines)

cycle1.result: Antipsychotics used for most patients with severe behavioural or emotional disturbance; less than a quarter started on a low dose; very few reviewed regularly; prescribing and documentation of management plans varied.

result.other_findings: Baseline audit before guideline implementation; patients aged 65 years and over coded with delirium.

result.setting: Epworth Hospital, Melbourne

cycle1.result: 5 deaths (1%); no mortality in 248 de novo isolated coronary bypass patients.

result.other_findings: Major mortality and morbidity confined almost entirely to patients over 80.

result.setting: Two general practices in Nottingham

cycle1.result: Gynaecological examination in 51%; urine dipstick in 40%; follow-up in 34% of 65 women with newly reported incontinence.

result.intervention: Results fed back to GPs in a feedback session.
result.other_findings: Most women were not managed according to the NICE guideline; incontinence often raised last in a consultation.

result.setting: Cardiac catheterisation laboratory, Epworth Hospital, Richmond, Victoria

cycle1.result: Procedural success 96.1%; mortality 0.53%; stenting in 93.3% (drug-eluting 88%); 0.53% needed same-admission surgical revascularisation.

result.other_findings: Annual activity and outcome report.

result.setting: Department of Pediatric Surgery, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi

cycle1.result: Overall survival 65-70% after surgery in nearly two thousand newborns.

result.other_findings: Outcome review; authors call for risk stratification of surgical newborns.

result.setting: Pediatric Pulmonology Division, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi

cycle1.result: Diagnostic yield highest for structural abnormalities and poor for suspected drug-resistant tuberculosis and interstitial lung disease.

result.other_findings: Serious complications seen in children with pulmonary arterial hypertension.

result.setting: BC Children's Hospital, Vancouver

cycle1.result: Only 10 (19%) had an outpatient diagnostic procedure; 50% of 117 inpatient procedures within working hours; 31% needed two or more general anaesthetics; mean lag to biopsy 2.6 days and to diagnosis 1.2 days.

result.other_findings: Suggested improvements: more outpatient work-up, dedicated oncology theatre time, better coordination to reduce anaesthetics.

result.setting: Six surgical wards, general hospital, Diyarbakir
result.standard: Appropriate perioperative antibiotic prophylaxis (indication, agent, timing, duration under 24 h)

cycle1.result: 331 of 391 (84.7%) received prophylaxis; not indicated in 15.1% of those given it; only 18.4% lasted less than 24 h; timing inappropriate in 135 (40.8%); all steps correct in only 44 (13.3%).

result.other_findings: Antimicrobial density 330.2 DDD/100 operations.

result.setting: All departments, CHU de Besançon (university hospital)
result.standard: Local antifungal prescribing guidelines (2003, updated 2005 and 2006): indication, absence of better alternative, dosage, loading dose and timing

cycle1.result: Overall conformity 54%; therapy justified in 113 prescriptions (96%); a better alternative existed in 30%; dosage correct in 92% and loading dose in 80%.

result.other_findings: Over-prescription of caspofungin and sometimes insufficient voriconazole dosing in children; 81 patients.

result.setting: Pediatric Institute, General Hospital Kuala Lumpur

cycle1.result: 730 oncology and 73 haematology patients; 51% of oncology patients had leukaemia or lymphoma.

result.other_findings: Descriptive case-mix study.

result.setting: Dermatologic Surgical Paediatric Outpatient Clinic, Children's Hospital, Bordeaux

cycle1.result: 108 of 192 children included in follow-up survey of management and satisfaction.

result.other_findings: Recurrence after early surgery; early surgery associated with better scar quality.

result.setting: Queensland Liver Transplant Service, Royal Children's Hospital, Brisbane

cycle1.result: 4 of 130 surviving children (3%) diagnosed with eosinophilic oesophagitis; 12% of the 34 followed in Queensland.

result.other_findings: Incidence study; likely underestimate as many patients are followed elsewhere.

result.topic: Neonatal radiograph quality and request completion
result.setting: Tertiary neonatal intensive care unit, McMaster University, Hamilton
result.standard: Standards defined a priori for radiographic technique and essential clinical information on X-ray requisitions

cycle1.result: Baseline review of all neonatal X-rays and requisitions identified areas of suboptimal image quality and documentation (figures not given in abstract).

result.intervention: Brief educational sessions and printed pamphlets targeting suboptimal areas, delivered jointly by radiology and neonatology staff.

cycle2.result: Improvements in requisition completion and image quality, including legibility (P = 0.019) and completeness of medical history.

result.other_findings: A re-audit at 1 month (n = 93) also showed improvement; gains were sustained at 1 year.

result.topic: Diabetes quality of life questionnaire validation
result.setting: National Institute of Endocrinology and Diabetology, Lubochna

cycle1.result: Audit of Diabetes-Dependent Quality of Life questionnaire had a one-dimensional structure with high internal consistency (alpha = 0.93).

result.other_findings: Questionnaire validation study; 'audit' is the instrument name.

result.setting: 48 public acute care hospitals in Catalonia
result.standard: Indicators from the stroke clinical practice guideline (six dimensions of care)

cycle1.result: Compliance: medical records 78.5%; initial interventions 92.4%; neurological assessment 38.3%; assessment of rehabilitation needs 44.9%; prevention and management of complications 68.4%; initial preventive measures 78.9%.

result.other_findings: Baseline audit before guideline implementation; inter-observer agreement 0.7.

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, Policlinico S. Orsola-Malpighi, Bologna

cycle1.result: Observed mortality 6.25%, lower than predicted by CR-POSSUM (9.14%) and ACPGBI score (19.42%).

result.other_findings: Evaluation of an audit database; ACPGBI score greatly overestimated 30-day mortality.

result.setting: Ambulatory Surgery 23-hour ward, Tan Tock Seng Hospital
result.standard: Proposed same-day discharge criteria (minimal pain, tolerating feeds, independent walking, spontaneous voiding after 6-8 hours)

cycle1.result: 84% of patients listed for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy were admitted to the 23-hour ward; 66 admitted as inpatients (41 due to conversion). Projected day-case success rate at least 50%.

result.other_findings: Previous cholecystitis or cholangitis predicted conversion to open surgery (OR 5.73 and 5.74).

result.setting: 18 family medicine teams at 5 primary health centres
result.standard: Pre-determined explicit criteria for long-term diabetes management

cycle1.result: Poor compliance overall; metabolic control acceptable in 69.5%; foot examination 53.4% and fundus examination 53%.

result.other_findings: Considerable variation between centres and between teams in the same centre.

result.setting: Health visitor and midwifery services across Greater Manchester
result.standard: Seven standards for evidence-based interventions to reduce child health inequalities (postnatal depression, breastfeeding, parental support, looked-after children, nutrition, day care, smoking in pregnancy)

cycle1.result: Recommendations not implemented consistently across areas, services or populations, particularly smoking cessation, postnatal depression management and breastfeeding.

result.other_findings: Multidisciplinary supradistrict audit of children under five.

result.setting: Gastrointestinal surgery, CHU Rangueil, Toulouse
result.standard: Toulouse teaching hospital and SFAR prophylactic antibiotic guidelines; Haute Autorité de Santé criteria (indication, antibiotic, timing, duration)

cycle1.result: Prophylaxis prescribed in 58%; compliance with indication 85%; antibiotic choice 82.8%; timing 39.7%; duration excessive in 5 cases; overall compliance 42%.

result.other_findings: Timing of administration was the main failure.

result.topic: Intestinal pseudo-obstruction after gynaecological cancer treatment
result.setting: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Mayo Clinic, Rochester

cycle1.result: Of 21 surgical patients, 6 had mechanical obstruction and 15 pseudo-obstruction; symptoms improved in 67% with fibrinous coating vs 17% with idiopathic dysfunction.

result.other_findings: Case series.

result.setting: Three central clinics in Slovenia

cycle1.result: 55% of women with cervical cancer had a gynaecological examination in the five years before diagnosis; regular attenders were younger and diagnosed at lower stage (p = 0.01).

result.other_findings: Descriptive analysis of cervical cancer cases.

result.setting: Referrals to the Finnish Institute of Occupational Health
result.standard: Quality indicators with criteria for sufficient care: exposure assessment, spirometry, bronchodilator response, serial workplace PEF, time to diagnosis

cycle1.result: Exposure assessment 92%, spirometry 87%, bronchodilator response 79%; workplace PEF in 51% (sufficient quality in 52%); median time from symptoms to diagnosis 3.2 years.

result.other_findings: Exposures assessed more often in occupational health care than other units.

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, Kasturba Medical College, tertiary hospital, Manipal

cycle1.result: POSSUM over-predicted morbidity and mortality by linear analysis but predicted well by exponential analysis; P-POSSUM predicted mortality well by both methods.

result.other_findings: Validation of risk-scoring systems.

result.topic: Dental practice audit and peer review scheme
result.setting: Personal dental services and general dental practitioners in Devon, Somerset, Avon and Gloucester PCTs
result.standard: 'Cookbook' audits devised by the Local Assessment Panel

cycle1.result: First-cycle patient satisfaction averaged 99%; other first-cycle results not reported.

cycle2.result: All audits showed improvement except patient satisfaction; improvement in clinical record keeping was particularly marked.

result.other_findings: Patient satisfaction audit redesigned to be more challenging.

result.setting: Three Danish counties (A, B and C)
result.standard: Generally accepted standards of satisfactory perinatal and neonatal care

cycle1.result: County without a neonatal intensive care unit had significantly more potentially avoidable deaths than the county with a fully staffed NICU; suboptimal care in another county linked to inadequate staffing and inexperienced junior doctors.

result.other_findings: Fewer liveborn infants under 28 weeks were reported to the Birth Register in the county without a NICU.

result.topic: Mesorectal excision quality in rectal cancer surgery
result.setting: Spanish Association of Surgeons audited teaching programme, multicentre

cycle1.result: Mesorectum complete in 464 (76.8%), nearly complete 91 (15.1%), incomplete 49 (8.1%); CRM negative in 534 (88.4%); no difference between laparoscopic and open surgery.

result.other_findings: Mortality 0.5% laparoscopic vs 3.5% open (P = 0.021); comparative outcome study.

result.setting: General surgery residency, Yale New Haven Hospital

cycle1.result: 30 of 99 (30%) failed to complete training: 21 withdrew, 5 transferred, 4 dismissed; annual attrition 6.7% (national rate 5.8%).

result.other_findings: 77% of attrition occurred before the third clinical year.

result.setting: 16 hospitals across Australia (VTE Task Force Audit)
result.standard: Current guidelines for thromboprophylaxis in high-risk acutely ill medical patients

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: 4-month programme led by a VTE nurse educator raising awareness of VTE risk, risk assessment and prophylaxis, with feedback of local audit results.
result.other_findings: Methods paper only; about 9600 patients planned, no results reported.

result.setting: Two medical teaching units, general internal medicine, Calgary
result.standard: A clear clinical question posed to the subspecialist

cycle1.result: Clear clinical question in 69.7% (131/188); MTU member contacted the subspecialist in 74.2%; urgent consultations had a clear question in 63.3%.

result.other_findings: More than one in four consultations lacked a clear clinical question.

result.topic: ICU prophylaxis bundle compliance (VTE, VAP, stress ulcer)
result.setting: Intensive Care Unit, Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center
result.standard: Evidence-based prophylaxis against venous thromboembolism, ventilator-associated pneumonia and stress ulcers

cycle1.result: Baseline implementation rates measured per patient-shift (values not given in abstract).

result.intervention: Systematic approach to delivering safety measures, team communication tools, daily prompts in the ICU progress note and a data wall for real-time feedback.

cycle2.result: Mean implementation rose for each measure, with reduced variation and narrower control limits.

result.other_findings: Control data also collected at an interim time point; success defined by both appropriate delivery and appropriate withholding.

result.setting: All acute-care hospitals in Catalonia; retrospective review of consecutive stroke admissions
result.standard: 13 evidence-based performance measures of in-hospital stroke process of care

cycle1.result: Eight performance measures achieved compliance >=75%, 4 of which were more than 90%; the remaining showed lower adherence.

result.other_findings: Care was heterogeneous across hospital levels; rehabilitation-related measures showed poor compliance compared with acute care measures. Global interobserver agreement was 0.7.

result.setting: Christchurch Hospital Oncology Service inpatients; cross-sectional chart review over two 4-week periods
result.standard: 2004 American College of Chest Physicians consensus guidelines on VTE prophylaxis

cycle1.result: 38/113 (33.6%) had indications for prophylactic anticoagulation; 23 of these had contraindications, leaving 15 (13%) appropriate; only one was appropriately given prophylaxis.

result.other_findings: Authors suggest local promotion of VTE prophylaxis to improve uptake.

result.setting: Surgical Division I, multidisciplinary day surgery unit, University of Insubria, Varese

cycle1.result: Day surgery rose from 18.7% to 32% of Surgery Division I activity; complication rates described as low and similar to literature.

result.intervention: Changes introduced included complication and infection data collection, quality questionnaire, follow-up, information leaflet and meetings with nursing staff.
result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Clinical Research Center expert workshop for the Audit of Diabetes Control and Management project

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Workshop summary on using clinical IT for diabetes care; plans for a national Adult Diabetes Registry.

result.setting: 22 residency clinics using the Preventive Cardiology Practice Improvement Module

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Qualitative interviews; residents reported increased QI knowledge and confidence; barriers were lack of resident buy-in, discontinuity of care and lack of institutional support.

result.setting: Victoria's largest public pregnancy advisory service; audit of electronic records

cycle1.result: 5462 women made contact; records created for 3827; data available in >80% of records for 77% (13/17) of items; 79% made contact within 2 weeks of discovering pregnancy; 72% referred by a GP.

result.other_findings: 16% reported violence; later gestation at contact was associated with younger age.

result.topic: Perioperative red cell transfusion in children
result.setting: Royal Children's Hospital, Melbourne; tertiary paediatric hospital theatre, trauma and blood bank databases

cycle1.result: 6.3% of 32 511 anaesthetics were associated with RBC transfusion; 4070 of 9838 units released (41%) transfused perioperatively; cardiac surgery used 2359 units.

result.other_findings: Highest transfusion frequency: liver transplant (87%), cardiac on bypass (79%), cranioplasty (61%), cardiac off bypass (55%).

result.setting: All imaging units in the southwest hospital district of Finland; external clinical audits by independent experts
result.standard: Generally accepted standards for good medical radiological procedures (audit criteria list)

cycle1.result: All units used radiation in accordance with requirements; 80 recommendations made, most (22/80) on instructions for the fundamental practice of examining a patient.

result.intervention: Recommendations from the first audit implemented by units.

cycle2.result: Audit criteria fulfilled clearly better; 53 recommendations made, most in the category of radiation doses.

result.other_findings: Most recommendations from the first audit had been taken into consideration by the second audit.

result.setting: Department of Radiation Oncology, National University Hospital, Singapore
result.standard: Departmental prostate IMRT protocol with 18 dose objectives to target and critical organs

cycle1.result: 39/1140 (3.3%) dosimetric end points did not meet protocol criteria; no plans required revision at QA rounds; one major protocol violation.

result.other_findings: Two grade 3-4 acute and two late toxicities; 5 (8.8%) developed proctitis, one needing argon laser therapy.

result.setting: Anatomic pathology department, Sunnybrook Health Sciences Center, tertiary care centre

cycle1.result: Patient care potentially negatively impacted in 14 IOCs (2 by gynaecologic pathologists, 12 by surgical pathologists); gross inspection only had accuracy of 94.7%.

result.other_findings: Primary versus metastatic ovarian tumour correctly answered in only 35%; surgery proceeded as planned in 96%, modified in 2%, terminated in 2%.

result.setting: Department of Digestive and Laparoscopic Surgery, Maggiore Hospital, Bologna

cycle1.result: Uneventful outcome in 1250 (94.7%); no mortality; 71 grade I-II complications; no readmission for biliary disease up to 10 years.

result.other_findings: Median operating time 58 minutes; median stay 2 days; 142 patients had preoperative ERCP for suspected stones.

result.setting: Neurosurgery Department, Istanbul Medical Faculty

cycle1.result: Stroke morbidity 1.4%, mortality 1.4%; 6 (8.45%) intolerant to carotid clamping; mean stay 2.07 days.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Primary care dental sedation service, Queensway Dental Practice, Billingham
result.standard: Contemporary standards and guidance for alternative conscious sedation (no loss of consciousness)

cycle1.result: 11 children (1.9%) scored level 5 on modified Wilson scale, mostly for under a minute and no more than five minutes; no children became unresponsive.

result.other_findings: 99% of children who would otherwise have needed general anaesthesia completed treatment with the technique.

result.setting: US National Surgical Quality Improvement Project limited data set

cycle1.result: Open colectomy had higher mortality (4.9% vs 0.8%), SSI (12% vs 8.0%), wound disruption, pneumonia and renal failure than laparoscopic.

result.other_findings: Open colectomy patients had higher preoperative risk (diabetes, smoking, COPD, heart failure).

result.setting: University hospital antimicrobial audit system
result.standard: Criteria for rational use of imipenem from a literature review

cycle1.result: Baseline appropriateness of indication, consumption and outcomes reported; 4 associations with spectrum superposition; 4 therapy changes.

cycle1.result: Clinically significant neutropenia 7% and thrombocytopenia 12%; 7 (7%) needed transfusion or growth factors; grade 3-4 lymphopenia 32%; 2 (2%) deaths from pneumonia.

result.setting: Postnatal wards, tertiary maternity hospital, Sydney
result.standard: Local clinical guideline for screening and prevention of neonatal hypoglycaemia (early feeding and timely blood glucose measurement)

cycle1.result: 115 neonates screened; one IDM and one SGA not screened; 41 of 106 (39%) fed in the first hour; blood glucose measured later than recommended in 41 of 106 (39%).

result.other_findings: 22 neonates screened for no identifiable reason and 13 classed as SGA by a non-guideline definition; staff education on early breastfeeding recommended.

result.setting: Dr B.R.A. Institute Rotary Cancer Hospital, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi

cycle1.result: Mean diagnostic workup 33 days and registration to RT referral 31 days; median wait to start RT 41 days; overall RT compliance 75%; non-completion 12% and interruption 13%.

result.topic: Diabetes care quality in primary care versus hospital
result.setting: Primary health care centres and hospitals, State of Qatar

cycle1.result: Primary care provided generally better quality diabetes care and higher satisfaction than hospitals (figures not given in abstract).

result.topic: Heart rate control before coronary CT angiography

result.standard: Target heart rate before coronary CTA

cycle2.result: Mean HR 64.9 +/- 9.8 (5 mg) and 63.2 +/- 10.6 (7.5 mg) beats/min; significantly lower use of intravenous beta-blockers.

result.other_findings: Retrospective comparison of three pre-treatment regimens.

result.setting: Dutch Surgical Colorectal Audit, national
result.standard: Dutch guideline: preoperative radiotherapy indicated in all cT2-4 rectal tumours

cycle1.result: 85% of resected patients received RT; 75% with Charlson 2+ and 80% aged 70 or over; 77% of stage I tumours received RT with hospital variation 0-100%.

result.other_findings: Proportion of chemoradiotherapy among RT varied by hospital from 0 to 73%.

result.setting: Central Region Fetal Medicine Unit, Wellington Regional Hospital
result.standard: Fetal Medicine Foundation criteria and Herman score, mandated by the National Screening Unit and Ministry of Health

cycle1.result: 4 (7.7%) images unacceptable and 5 (9.6%) intermediate; mean Herman score 5.87 of 9.

result.setting: 32 of 37 radiotherapy centres across Canada
result.standard: Published suite of quality indicators for prostate cancer radiotherapy

result.other_findings: No centre was 100% compliant on all indicators; centres were fully compliant on a median 7 of 13 assessment and 8 of 8 treatment indicators.

result.topic: Stroke care processes and outcomes in atrial fibrillation

result.setting: Aged psychiatry patients, Melbourne

result.setting: Haemodialysis units served by Nambour General Hospital, Queensland (ANZDATA registry)

result.setting: Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Ayub Teaching Hospital, Abbottabad

cycle1.result: Normal delivery 14 (46.66%), caesarean 8 (26.67%), miscarriage 8 (26.67%); PPH 8 (26.67%), preterm delivery 10 (33.33%); 4 (13.33%) intrauterine deaths.

result.other_findings: Multiple intramural and large (>10 cm) fibroids were linked to miscarriage and preterm labour.

result.setting: Hospitalised medicine patients, Missouri
result.standard: Optimal DVT prophylaxis for hospitalised medical patients

cycle1.result: Optimal DVT prophylaxis 75%.

result.other_findings: Improvement sustained at 95% on chart review 1 year after implementation.

result.setting: Dutch Surgical Colorectal Audit, all Dutch hospitals
result.standard: Dutch colorectal cancer guideline compliance (diagnostics, preoperative MDT, standardised reporting)

cycle1.result: Case ascertainment 92% in 2010 (baseline compliance figures not given).

cycle2.result: Case ascertainment 95% in 2011; guideline compliance for diagnostics, preoperative MDT and standardised reporting increased, and complication, re-intervention and postoperative mortality rates fell significantly (no figures given).

result.setting: 79 hospitals in the Spanish Association of Surgeons Rectal Cancer Project
result.standard: Quality standards of the Norwegian Rectal Cancer Project

result.other_findings: Outcomes similar to those of the Norwegian project.

result.setting: All dental practices in Australia

cycle1.result: Three-quarters of suburbs had no dental practice; about one-third of the population lived in them; 86.6% lived within 5 km of a private practice and 84.4% within 10 km of a government practice.

result.other_findings: Mapping study, not a clinical audit.

result.setting: Post-anaesthesia care unit, Sir Charles Gairdner Hospital, Perth

cycle1.result: Prevalence of postoperative urinary retention 20.6%.

result.other_findings: Recommended a PACU bladder scanning guideline and adding bladder management to discharge criteria.

result.topic: Surgical resource planning from audit data
result.setting: One surgical firm, Ashford Hospital, Middlesex, district general hospital

cycle1.result: Baseline mean stay just over 5 days in 15 beds, theatre occupancy 94%, total cost 812,000 pounds.

result.topic: Urological complications after inguinal hernia repair

cycle1.result: 62 urological complications from 335 claims among 92,000 hernia operations; 34 testicular injuries; 17 orchiectomies; 11/17 (65%) pain-free after orchiectomy.

result.topic: Blinded central review audit in trials

cycle1.result: In a 722-participant trial with HR 0.48, an average audit of 28% of data confirmed the treatment effect; moderate effects needed 57% to 100% audited.

cycle1.result: A final set of 14 healthcare quality indicators for RA (2 structure, 11 process, 1 outcome) developed from 56 topics.

result.topic: Gonorrhoea treatment and test of cure

result.standard: Local protocol of ceftriaxone 250 mg with test of cure; CDC 2010 and BASHH 2011 gonorrhoea guidelines

result.standard: Surgeon-selected quality markers: preoperative imaging, reporting of rectal radial margin, positive radial margin rate

result.other_findings: Participating surgeons treated about 70% of regional colorectal surgery patients.

result.setting: Hospice of Sacred Heart, Eugene, Oregon

cycle1.result: Spiritual care referrals falling while hospice census rose (no figures given).

cycle2.result: DLP per examination fell 32-69% for all regions between 2007 and 2009; DRLs reduced by 20-78%, mean DLP per examination by 18-75% and collective dose by 30%.

result.setting: 10 randomly selected sites of the STS General Thoracic Surgery Database

cycle1.result: 28 omissions among 559 lobectomy cases, 94.6% agreement with operative logs; overall data accuracy 94.9%; all category agreement rates above 90%.

cycle2.result: 53 patients referred; improved documentation of referral to local and national databases.

cycle1.result: HbA1c every six months recorded in 59%; haemodynamic status, weight and height in 30%; complication screening in half; adherence assessed in 97% of 27 consultations; foot examination in 18%.

result.other_findings: Documentation of minimum standards specifically addressed by the sticker improved.

result.setting: Southern District Health Board, Dunedin
result.standard: Diagnostic colonoscopy within 42 days; treatment within 62 days

result.other_findings: Work-up longer than international benchmarks; waiting time not associated with stage.

result.topic: Insulin infusion glucose control in ICU

result.standard: Local dynamic insulin infusion guideline, target blood glucose 6-9 mmol/L

result.topic: Pelvic radiotherapy field and nodal failure in cervical cancer

cycle1.result: Aortic bifurcation above the radiation field in 82 of 116 (70.7%); of 9 recurrences above the field, 5 (55%) between aortic bifurcation and L4/5 and 4 (45%) para-aortic.

result.setting: Italian Melanoma Intergroup expert consensus panel

result.topic: Time to analgesia in the emergency department

result.standard: Timely analgesia (within 30 minutes) and pain score documentation

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle1.result: not reported

result.standard: Overtransfusion defined as discharge haemoglobin above 10 g/dL

result.topic: Continuous EEG monitoring use in neuro ICU

cycle1.result: 3.4% readmitted with haemorrhage; 1.3% returned to theatre (0.4% primary, 0.9% secondary); return to theatre 0.3% under 12 years vs 2.0% aged 12 or older.

result.topic: Hypertension management in the very elderly

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle1.result: not reported
