result.standard: Modified Ministry of Health audit tool quality of care and outcome indicators (blood pressure and glycaemic control)

cycle1.result: About two-thirds had electrolytes, lipids and ECG within the last year; adequate blood pressure control in about one-fifth (18.5% men, 19.8% women); poor glycaemic control in 69% of those with diabetes.

result.other_findings: Moderate to substantial inter-rater agreement for the simplified audit tool.

result.setting: IAMSPE outpatient service, São Paulo

cycle1.result: Moderate to high alcohol use in 3.9% of women and 21.7% of men; no correlation between alcohol abuse and depression.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Paediatric emergency department, McMaster Children's Hospital

cycle1.result: 146 threats affected 43 (93%) visits; no visit error-free; communication errors and protocol non-adherence the commonest errors; unintended patient states in 30 (65%).

result.other_findings: No cerebral oedema or deaths.

result.setting: Paediatric ward

cycle1.result: Baseline medication error rates and policy compliance (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Bundle of five nurse-developed interventions through action research.

cycle2.result: Medication error rates fell by 56.9%; nurses more compliant with policy.

result.other_findings: Safety Attitudes Questionnaire improved in five of seven domains.

result.setting: Urban skilled nursing facility (nursing home)
result.standard: Congruence between prescribed, performed and charted functional maintenance programmes

cycle1.result: Existing charting and auditing process allowed variability and lost revenue (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Six Sigma DMAIC process redesign of the functional maintenance programme.

cycle2.result: Charting congruence of 90% to 100% achieved; capacity increased by 17 residents ($200,000 revenue).

result.other_findings: Limited success attributed to poor skill diffusion, team communication, manager availability and prioritisation.

result.setting: Emergency department, single tertiary hospital
result.standard: Antibiotics within 4 and 24 hours of ED arrival

cycle1.result: Antibiotics within 4 hours in 44.7% of afebrile vs 55.6% of febrile patients; within 24 hours 89.5% vs 95.2%.

result.other_findings: 30-day mortality higher in afebrile patients (27.6% vs 10.1%); only about half received antibiotics within 4 hours.

result.topic: Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm repair outcomes
result.setting: Dutch Surgical Aneurysm Audit, national registry

cycle1.result: Unadjusted postoperative mortality 34.9% after open repair and 22.6% after EVAR (risk difference 12.3%); instrumental variable RD 8.9% (95% CI -1.1 to 18.9%).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Primary care centre (Tean Surgery)
result.standard: NICE guidance on management of diverticulitis, including review within 48 hours

cycle1.result: Antibiotics prescribed after 68.4% (n = 39) of consultations; inflammatory markers in 19.3% (n = 11); review within 48 hours in only 3.5% (n = 2); referral to surgical assessment unit 12.5% (n = 8).

result.other_findings: Only 3.5% (n = 2) deteriorated and needed admission; antibiotic regimen choice needs improvement.

result.setting: Emergency and Trauma Centre, Alfred Health, major trauma centre

cycle1.result: First-attempt success rate 88.5%.

result.intervention: Bundle of monthly airway registry audit, monthly tailored airway education and an intubation checklist.
result.other_findings: First-attempt success rose by 13.4% in the first month after introduction.

result.setting: Shaare Zedek Medical Center
result.standard: Local institutional guidelines for empirical antibiotic treatment

cycle1.result: Empirical treatment matched bacterial susceptibility in 227 (77%); matched first-line guideline choice in 64% and second-line in 24%.

result.other_findings: Guideline-appropriate therapy associated with lower mortality (OR 0.392); infectious disease consultation increased appropriateness (85% vs 76%).

result.setting: General practitioners in Torbay area health authority

cycle1.result: Response rate 78.3%; 46.4% took endocervical specimens, only 25.0% gave antibiotic therapy covering C. trachomatis, and 39.3% considered investigating or referring the male partner.

result.other_findings: Questionnaire-based; management of pelvic inflammatory disease in general practice was often incomplete.

result.setting: Society of Thoracic Surgeons General Thoracic Surgery Database, over 283 participant sites

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Database report on outcomes, volume trends and research; participant sites audited at random annually for completeness and accuracy.

result.topic: Attributing patients to residents using EHR data
result.setting: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (primary care clinic, ED and inpatient)

cycle1.result: 579 patient interactions over 111 shifts; time-in-chart the best predictor; c statistic above 0.98 in clinic and ED models and 0.89 inpatient.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: East Lille mental health services (working visit)

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Descriptive report of a Dutch delegation's visit; care built on a shared-values charter with reflection and appreciative auditing.

result.topic: Minimally invasive non-surgical periodontal therapy outcomes
result.setting: Private periodontal practice, Milan

cycle1.result: Mean pocket closure rate 71.6 ± 15.7% for sites with initial probing depth of 5 mm or more at 2-month re-evaluation.

result.other_findings: 2,407 teeth analysed; single-rooted and shallow pockets had the best closure.

result.topic: Palliative radiotherapy use at end of life
result.setting: Large cancer centre network (UPMC Hillman Cancer Center)

cycle1.result: 693 of 1038 (66.8%) patients predicted to die within a year were prescribed long-course radiotherapy or stereotactic ablative radiotherapy.

result.other_findings: Treatment at an academic site was associated with lower long-course radiotherapy use (OR 0.30).

result.setting: 60-bed level IV NICU, academic referral centre (Children's National)
result.standard: Aim to reduce vancomycin prescribing rate by 50% within 1 year and sustain for 1 year

cycle1.result: 112 vancomycin days of therapy per 1000 patient-days, substantially higher than peer institutions.

result.intervention: Physician education with benchmarking, pharmacy-initiated 48-hour antibiotic time-outs, clinical pathways for sepsis and NEC, and daily prospective audit with feedback.

cycle2.dates: After 1 year, sustained for a further year
cycle2.result: 38 vancomycin days of therapy per 1000 patient-days (66% reduction).

result.other_findings: Vancomycin-associated acute kidney injury fell from 1.4 to 0.1 events per 1000 patient-days.

result.setting: Paediatric inpatient units, NYU Winthrop Hospital
result.standard: Central line maintenance bundle compliance greater than 90%

cycle1.result: Maintenance bundle compliance 87.9% (monthly range 44%-100%); CLABSI rate 1.71/1000 central line days.

result.intervention: Directly observed Kamishibai card audits replaced checklists, plus family 'key card' education.

cycle2.result: Maintenance bundle compliance 97.1% (monthly range 86%-100%); CLABSI rate 0.63/1000 central line days.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Paediatric emergency department, Princess Margaret Hospital for Children, tertiary
result.standard: Local bronchiolitis guideline based on the 2017 Australasian bronchiolitis guideline

cycle1.result: Chest X-ray 24 (5.2%), salbutamol 23 (4.9%), antibiotics 11 (2.4%), nasopharyngeal aspirate 172 (37%); admission 303 (65.2%).

result.intervention: Dissemination of the updated local bronchiolitis guideline.

cycle2.result: Chest X-ray 17 (5.0%), salbutamol 10 (2.9%), antibiotics 5 (1.5%), nasopharyngeal aspirate 124 (36.2%); admission 192 (56.0%, P = 0.008).

result.other_findings: No significant reduction in unnecessary interventions; glucocorticoid use 0.4% vs 1.5% and PICU admissions unchanged.

result.setting: Nurse practitioner-led primary care practice
result.standard: American Cancer Society mammography screening guidelines

cycle1.result: 12% adherence for clinicians ordering mammograms.

result.intervention: Screening checklist completed by the woman at registration and given to the clinician during the examination.

cycle2.result: Mammogram recommended and ordered for 69.6% of women (p = .01).

result.other_findings: Authors recommend a paperless system as adherence still needs improvement.

result.setting: Oral pathology service, Piracicaba Dental School (UNICAMP)

cycle1.result: Exfoliative cytology in 312 (29.1%) and fine needle aspiration cytology in 770 (70.9%) cases; 65 different cytological diagnoses.

result.other_findings: Exfoliative cytology used mainly for infections and FNAC for salivary tumours, odontogenic and reactive lesions and cervical metastases.

result.setting: Two tertiary newborn nurseries and NICUs at one medical centre
result.standard: Aim to improve targeted newborn CMV screening by 25% from a baseline rate of 22%

cycle1.result: Median targeted CMV screening rate 22%.

result.intervention: Formal teaching with an algorithm and nurse educator, electronic order sets, huddle board reminders and regular audits.
result.other_findings: Four infants screened positive and received treatment; small for gestational age was the commonest indication (46%).

result.topic: Neonatal cardiac surgery outcomes by birth weight
result.setting: Referral paediatric hospital (Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences), Southern India

cycle1.result: 123 (21.6%) operations were in low birth weight neonates; low birth weight associated with higher in-hospital mortality.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: All MRI machines nationally

cycle1.result: 18 MRI machines in five regions, 15 (83.3%) in Greater Accra and Ashanti; examinations more expensive on privately owned machines.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Head and neck cancer post-treatment surveillance
result.setting: 89 UK head and neck cancer outpatient centres
result.standard: UK multidisciplinary guidelines for head and neck cancer surveillance

cycle1.result: 30% of consultations in dedicated multidisciplinary clinics; allied health input on the day in 23%; suspected recurrence investigated with MRI in 29.6% (n = 102) and PET-CT in 14.2% (n = 49); recurrence symptom education 20.4%, smoking advice 6.2%, alcohol advice 5.3%.

result.other_findings: Recurrence detected in 35% of expedited appointments vs 5.2% of planned follow-ups; dyspnoea the strongest predictor (PPV 16.2%).

result.setting: Three chronic haemodialysis units, Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital

cycle1.result: 876 of 1584 sessions audited (452 usable); 74 episodes of intradialytic hypotension; most nurses assessed before HD and as required (n = 85; 63%), with few hourly assessments.

result.other_findings: Audit led to a change to hourly assessments; follow-up audit recommended but not reported.

result.topic: Routine chest X-ray after thoracic surgery
result.setting: Section of Thoracic Surgery, Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center
result.standard: Adapted evidence-based guidelines; aim to reduce empiric post-thoracic surgery chest X-ray use by 25% over 1 year

cycle1.result: 99% (69/70) received a post-anaesthesia care unit chest X-ray; daily rate of other chest X-rays 1.6.

result.intervention: Three 3-month PDSA cycles: education with literature and baseline data, EMR order-set modification, and audit and feedback with monthly reports.

cycle2.result: Significant reduction in chest X-ray use (figures not given in the abstract).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Two pairs of matched wards, private hospital

cycle1.result: Quasi-experimental study; audit with quarterly infographic feedback had no significant effect on monthly reported medication error rate.

result.other_findings: Across both groups reporting rose by 80% over the pre-implementation and implementation phases.

result.setting: Inpatient wards (Interior Health, Covenant Health, Island Health)

cycle1.result: Fluoroquinolone use 39.19 days of therapy per 1,000 patient days; appropriateness 68%.

result.intervention: Prospective audit and feedback by the antimicrobial stewardship team.

cycle2.dates: During prospective audit and feedback period
cycle2.result: Fluoroquinolone use 29.58 days of therapy per 1,000 patient days (P < .001); appropriateness 88% (P < .001).

result.other_findings: High-yield targets were non-infectious urinary and respiratory presentations.

result.topic: Antibiotic stewardship for suspected urinary tract infection
result.setting: Skilled nursing facility
result.standard: Facility antibiotic stewardship protocol for suspected urinary tract infection

cycle1.result: Baseline urine culturing, antibiotic days and C. difficile rates (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Stewardship protocol with auditing of culturing and prescribing, prescriber feedback, staff engagement and educational in-services.

cycle2.result: Urine culturing, antibiotic days for suspected UTI and C. difficile infections per 1,000 resident-days each fell by more than 50%.

result.other_findings: No urosepsis events.

result.setting: 114 breast screening facilities across Illinois
result.standard: 13 mammography quality measures and benchmarks (tracking, callback, cancer detection, loss to follow-up, timeliness)

cycle1.result: Baseline benchmark attainment (figures not reported in abstract).

result.intervention: Repeated participation in a quality measurement programme with benchmark reporting.

cycle2.result: Number of facilities meeting benchmarks increased with length of participation for many measures, including cancer detection, timely imaging and not lost at biopsy.

result.other_findings: Not all measures improved.

result.setting: Mixed ICU, University Hospital of Liège
result.standard: Weight-based energy and protein targets; receiving at least 80% of targets

cycle1.result: Fed patients received 14.3 kcal/kg/day and 0.53 g/kg/day protein; orally fed patients 9.7 kcal/kg/day and 0.35 g/kg/day; of orally fed patients staying 7 days or more, 51% and 94% never received 80% of energy and protein targets.

result.other_findings: Protein deficit was larger than energy deficit.

result.topic: Physical activity promotion documentation in rehabilitation

result.standard: Evidence-based assessment, promotion and prescription of physical activity for older adults

cycle1.result: No use of validated physical activity assessment tools; prescription documented in 55/56 (98%); goal setting 7 (12.5%); post-discharge advice 28/56 (50%); community referral 4/56 (7%).

result.standard: Best clinical evidence from literature review (no local guideline)

cycle2.result: Guideline-concordant agent for UTI median 69.2% and duration 70.4%; URI agent 86.8%; median URI duration 7 days.

cycle2.result: Mean consult to decision time 4.18 hours.

result.other_findings: Reduction was sustained over 12 months.

cycle1.result: No defects in 534 (62.7%) audits; slight defects in 98 (11.5%); serious defects in 220 (25.8%).

cycle1.result: 117 healthcare-associated infections in 79 patients (34.6%); length of stay 28.9 days longer; resistance to recommended empirical antibiotics 26.9-57.7% (LRI) and 54.2-67.8% (UTI).

cycle2.result: Mean knowledge score rose to 7.0; knowledge partly retained at six months compared with 73 controls.

cycle1.result: Baseline self-assessment and independent audit of standards (figures not reported).

cycle1.result: Baseline chart audits confirmed disparities in patient/disease characteristics, treatment history, clinical practice metrics and patient-centred measures (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Comparative patient and team surveys, live team-based audit-feedback sessions and team action plans.

cycle2.result: Follow-up chart audits measured changes in documented practice behaviour (figures not reported).

result.other_findings: Surveys showed significant discordance between patients' and teams' views of treatment goals.

result.setting: Two haemodialysis units
result.standard: McIntyre Audit Tool haemodialysis nurse-sensitive indicators

cycle1.result: 97 audits by 30 nurses; 75% of structural and 73% of process indicators achieved; outcome indicators varied from 5.9% to 94.1%.

result.other_findings: Most nurses (79%) found the tool quick to complete; it was judged feasible and acceptable.

result.setting: Single-centre ICU (Ghent University Hospital / OLV Aalst authors)

cycle1.result: Non-survivors had a more positive fluid balance on day 1 (37.24 ± 31.98 ml/kg vs 24.97 ± 23.76 ml/kg) owing to lower output; fluid input did not differ.

result.other_findings: A more positive fluid balance was associated with acute kidney injury and death after adjustment for confounders.

result.topic: Intravenous therapy medication preparation and vascular access device management
result.setting: Twenty-one tertiary care hospitals across south-east Asia
result.standard: Patient safety compliance parameters for medication preparation and vascular access device management (JCI-designed programme)

cycle1.result: Baseline compliance and knowledge assessed (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Standardised 6-month cascade training programme: JCI consultants trained clinical consultants, who trained hospital safety champions, who trained nursing staff; monthly audits.

cycle2.result: Overall 29% increase in compliance with medication preparation and vascular access device management parameters.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Department of Radiology, Duke University Medical Center
result.standard: PI-QUAL image quality standard for multiparametric prostate MRI

cycle1.result: Mean PI-QUAL score 3.67 ± 0.75 at start of project.

result.intervention: Non-endorectal coil prostate MR protocol changes informed by PI-QUAL scoring, led by a multidisciplinary team of radiologists, technologists and a physicist.

cycle2.result: Mean PI-QUAL score improved to 4.16 ± 0.59 (p value truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: With training, radiologists, technologists and physicists scored PI-QUAL with similar performance.

result.setting: Health system in the southeastern US (family and community medicine)

cycle1.result: Screening rate 60.4%; about half of screening orders were not completed; 32% of completed screenings were low-value and 38% associated with low-value preoperative testing.

result.other_findings: Sludge categories included communication, time, technology, administrative tasks, paperwork and low-value care, with long colonoscopy waits and duplicate orders; vulnerable patients were more affected.

result.setting: Outpatient respiratory clinics in 45 hospitals (EPOCONSUL 2021)
result.standard: Current COPD guidelines and GesEPOC risk-level criteria

cycle1.result: Risk levels analysed in 2678 patients: 74.5% high risk and 25.5% low risk; ICS use common in low-risk COPD, associated with asthma-like symptoms (OR 6.70).

result.other_findings: Few changes to inhaled therapy were made at follow-up; exacerbation history and eosinophil count did not predict triple therapy.

result.topic: CLABSI and CAUTI prevention bundle audits
result.setting: Loma Linda University Medical Center

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Nursing students deployed during the COVID-19 pandemic to assist with prevention bundle audits and interventions.

cycle2.result: Low rates of CLABSI and CAUTI were sustained (figures not reported).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Child mental health symptom screening tool use
result.setting: Community Health System outpatient and school-based counselling sites, Miami
result.standard: DSM-5 parent/guardian-rated level 1 cross-cutting symptom measure (child 6-17)

cycle1.result: Baseline diagnosis and treatment rates in 6-17 year olds (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Nurse-led training on the tool, including a PowerPoint presentation and individual coaching for five clinicians.

cycle2.result: Chart audit showed an increase in diagnosis and treatment of 6-17 year olds (figures not reported).

result.other_findings: Clinician knowledge was assessed with pre- and post-training surveys.

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, Tan Tock Seng Hospital

cycle1.result: Any morbidity 12.4%, open conversion 5.0%, subtotal cholecystectomy 14.6%, bile duct injury 0.1%; one 30-day death; after matching, HPB surgeons had shorter operative time (115.5 vs 133.4 min).

result.other_findings: HPB surgeons had less open conversion but more subtotal cholecystectomy; 40.1% of those operated at 72 hours or more had dense adhesions.

result.setting: Paediatric postanaesthesia care unit, Duke University Medical Center
result.standard: Standardised EHR handoff tool covering six handoff phases (introductions, situation, background, assessment, recommendations, questions)

cycle1.result: EHR handoff tool used in 4% of handoffs.

result.intervention: Reintroduction of a standardised EHR handoff tool, with training for anaesthesia providers and PACU nurses on giving and receiving handoffs.

cycle2.result: EHR handoff tool use rose to 19%; items communicated increased significantly in three of the six handoff phases when the tool was used.

result.other_findings: The tool improved completeness but was not widely adopted and did not improve user satisfaction; compared with 2014 pilot data for sustainability.

result.setting: Institute of Neurology, National Hospital of Sri Lanka (tertiary)
result.standard: 2015 AHA/ASA guideline for management of spontaneous intracerebral haemorrhage

cycle1.result: Blood pressure control achieved in 51.3% (39) and blood sugar control in 15.8% (12); almost 70% started on prophylactic antiepileptics (not recommended); 51% on steroids; 81% referred to neurosurgery regardless of indication.

result.other_findings: Only 15.8% had overt convulsions; authors plan a management protocol and re-audit.

result.setting: City general practice

cycle1.result: 89% of patients could be offered an appointment by the next day but only 60% accepted; 98% of urgent requests were offered same-day appointments and 96% accepted.

result.other_findings: Only 17% of urgent requests expressed a preference for a particular doctor or time versus 68% of non-urgent; longer waits reflected patient choice rather than lack of appointments.

result.topic: Empty pelvis syndrome after pelvic surgery
result.setting: Colorectal Division, Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai (tertiary cancer centre)

cycle1.result: Empty pelvis syndrome in 95/1224 (7%): APR 55/1024 (5%), posterior exenteration 8/39 (20.5%), total pelvic exenteration 32/143 (21.9%).

result.other_findings: Small bowel obstruction was the commonest presentation (43/95, 45.2%); 60% presented after 30 days; 57% managed conservatively.

result.topic: Tracheostomy timing in traumatic brain injury
result.setting: Muthoot Hospital, Kozhencherry, Kerala

cycle1.result: Most tracheostomies (24) done between days 6 and 14; mortality 1/6 (16.67%) first week, 9/19 (47%) second week, 3/8 (37.5%) third and fourth week.

result.other_findings: Complications: reversible GCS worsening in 3 (early group), bleeding 2, subglottic stenosis 1, tracheocutaneous fistula 1; 12 had pneumonia.

result.topic: Cardiac arrest outcomes in the emergency department
result.setting: Accident and Emergency Department, Royal Hallamshire Hospital

cycle1.result: 90 out-of-hospital arrests with 9 surviving to leave hospital; 33 arrests in the department with 10 surviving to leave hospital.

result.other_findings: Causes of death are presented; prospective computerised audit ongoing.

result.topic: MRI liver fat and iron quantification quality control
result.setting: Department of Radiology and Imaging Sciences, Emory University School of Medicine
result.standard: Technical acceptability criteria for chemical shift-encoded sequences and single-voxel spectroscopy

cycle1.result: Data handling errors in 11% (10/87); 27% (23/86) of q-Dixon/IDEAL-IQ and 28% (21/75) of SVS sequences technically unacceptable.

result.other_findings: Main causes were incomplete liver field (39%) and water-peak broadness (67%); authors suggest a technologist checklist and routine auditing.

result.topic: Rectal cancer response to neoadjuvant therapy
result.setting: Bi-National Colorectal Cancer Audit (BCCA) registry data

cycle1.result: Pathological complete response in 704 (21.8%) and partial/no response in 2526 (78.2%).

result.other_findings: cN0 stage and long-course neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy were independent predictors of complete response.

result.topic: Diabetes training for primary care physicians
result.setting: Online continuing medical education for primary care physicians across 47 counties

cycle1.result: Pre-test knowledge and confidence (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Online continuing medical education programme on diabetes care.

cycle2.result: Statistically significant improvement in knowledge and self-reported confidence (exact figures truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: 1286 of 1750 nominated participants completed the training.

result.topic: Access to paediatric dental care by insurance type
result.setting: Dental offices eligible to bill Medicaid, Illinois (telephone audit)

cycle1.result: Privately insured callers had 5.9 times (95% CI 4.55 to 7.69) greater odds of obtaining an appointment than Medicaid callers.

result.other_findings: Suburban callers had slightly better odds than Cook County, and rural counties had lower odds.

result.topic: Head and neck cancer waiting times
result.setting: National multicentre Dutch Head and Neck Audit (DHNA)
result.standard: Dutch national quality norm: 80% of patients starting treatment within 30 days of first visit (CPI-indicator)

cycle1.result: Median care pathway interval 37 days and time to treatment interval 37 days; CPI-indicator 39% and TTI-indicator 35%.

result.intervention: National audit with feedback and benchmarking; hospital-level process improvement plans.

cycle2.result: Median CPI 26 days and TTI 33 days; CPI-indicator 64% and TTI-indicator 40%; four hospitals exceeded the 80% norm.

result.other_findings: All hospitals improved and variation between hospitals declined.

result.topic: Clinical trial enrolment in radiation oncology
result.setting: Multisite tertiary cancer network, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center

cycle1.result: Median enrolment 3.2% (IQR 1.1%-10%) in the feedback group and 1.6% (IQR 0%-4.1%) in the control group.

result.intervention: Quarterly physician audit and feedback reports comparing trial enrolments with peers (randomised).

cycle2.result: Median enrolment 6.1% (feedback) and 4.1% (control); no significant effect of feedback (-0.6%; 95% CI -3.0% to 1.8%; P = .6).

result.other_findings: Enrolment fell among high accruers who received feedback (interaction P = .005); enrolment rose in both groups over time.

result.setting: European multicentre NECTARINE study

cycle1.result: Invasive monitoring in 66%; perioperative clinical events 69%; 30-day complications 47%; 30- and 90-day mortality 2.1% and 2.6%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Six comprehensive cancer centres in Poland, Spain, Italy, Portugal, France and Romania
result.standard: Core set of consensus-based radiotherapy quality indicators

cycle1.result: Radiotherapy practice varied between countries; institutions had developed their own processes (no figures reported).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Goals of care discussions in older ED patients
result.setting: Wellington Emergency Department
result.standard: No current standard for goals of care in the ED

cycle1.result: 62% of patients aged 80 and over had no goals of care discussion in the ED; of those who did, only 14% were initiated by ED clinicians.

result.other_findings: Authors suggest protocols and education to improve goals of care discussions.

result.topic: Out-of-hours home palliative care telephone support
result.setting: Home palliative care programme, La Maddalena Cancer Center, Palermo

cycle1.result: Main reasons for calls were caregiver uncertainty, need for information or reassurance, and technical problems with peripheral intravenous central catheters.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Mammography and tomosynthesis dose quality assurance
result.setting: Sites of the ECOG-ACRIN EA1151 TMIST screening trial (central physics quality control programme)

cycle1.result: 812 651 images from 135 525 examinations on 6 system models; mean proxy dose per examination 2.76-4.54 mGy for DM and 3-4.84 mGy for tomosynthesis; combination examinations 6.6-7.6 mGy (maximum 44.5 mGy).

result.other_findings: DM had greater variability in number of views and dose than tomosynthesis; header data were also useful for cross-checking study data consistency.

result.topic: Mental health questions on nursing licensure applications
result.setting: US state Boards of Nursing RN and APRN licensure applications
result.standard: Dr. Lorna Breen Heroes' Foundation toolkit checklist for removing intrusive mental health questions from licensure applications

cycle1.result: Applications obtained from 50 states (both RN and APRN from 42); only 13 states (26%) fully adhered to the toolkit checklist.

result.other_findings: Authors call for national guidance and state legislation to remove or revise probing mental health and substance use questions.

result.setting: Cardiovascular medical-surgical unit, National University Heart Centre (tertiary hospital)
result.standard: Four evidence-based nurse-led ward round audit criteria (JBI)

cycle1.result: Criterion 4 (patient involvement during ward rounds) 30%; criteria 1-3 below full compliance (figures not reported).

result.intervention: Introduction of structured nurse-led ward rounds with stakeholder-informed format, nurse preparation and audit and feedback cycles.

cycle2.result: Criteria 1, 2 and 3 reached 100% compliance; criterion 4 improved to 46.7%.

result.other_findings: Length of stay, best medical therapy rates and inpatient complications improved; nurses' confidence to lead rounds improved significantly (p = 0.026).

result.topic: Culturally safe cancer care for Aboriginal children
result.setting: Department of Haematology and Oncology, Women's and Children's Hospital, North Adelaide

cycle1.result: Interviews with families and healthcare workers identified individual, systemic and cultural barriers to equitable, culturally safe care.

result.other_findings: Facilitators and recommendations for improvement were also identified.

result.topic: Colorectal surgical site infection prevention bundle
result.setting: Two Central Virginia health system hospitals
result.standard: Colorectal bundle: antibiotics, chlorhexidine wipes or baths, separate closing instrument trays, nasal decolonisation, bowel preparation and normothermia

cycle1.result: Nine colorectal surgical site infections.

result.intervention: Colorectal SSI prevention bundle with a compliance checklist for all users, supported by staff education.
result.other_findings: Education was critical to staff engagement and bundle compliance.

result.topic: Gynaecological cancer health resources for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander women
result.setting: Online resources from Google and Australian gynaecological cancer organisation websites

cycle1.result: 16 resources were generally understandable, actionable, readable and culturally relevant, but most focused on cervical cancer prevention.

result.other_findings: Areas for improvement included transparency about Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander involvement and more visual formats.

result.topic: Single-stage nasolabial flap for oral cavity reconstruction
result.setting: Department of Head Neck Surgical Oncology, Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai

cycle1.result: No flap losses; 6 patients had minor wound breakdown needing secondary suturing; median closest margin 6 mm.

result.other_findings: Buccal mucosa and lip were the most common primary sites; 15 were recurrent cancers.

result.topic: Maternal care standards for pregnant women in prison
result.setting: Indiana Department of Correction prisons
result.standard: Maternal standards of care (MSOC) audit tool

cycle1.result: Strengths in prenatal care, STI and substance use screening/treatment, contraception and health education; weaknesses in mental and nutritional health care.

result.other_findings: Barriers included a punitive culture, lack of resources and communication problems; staff motivation and community partnerships helped.

result.setting: Network of 30 paediatric primary care practices across two states (Children's Hospital of Philadelphia)
result.standard: HPV vaccine series completion by 13th birthday

cycle1.result: HPV vaccine completion by age 13 was 30%.

result.intervention: Clinical decision support defaulting HPV vaccine orders from age 9, data audit and feedback to providers and practices, strong provider recommendation, and standing orders.

cycle2.result: Completion by age 13 increased to 55% with special cause variation.

result.other_findings: Gap between publicly and privately insured patients fell from 9% to 1%.

result.topic: Holistic wound care in community nursing
result.setting: Community home health care nursing (VHA Home HealthCare, Toronto)
result.standard: Referral of clients with hard-to-heal lower limb wounds to the multidisciplinary team

cycle1.result: Pre-intervention referrals and quality of life scores (figures not reported).

result.intervention: WounDS app, wound care education for nurses and client quality of life self-assessment.

cycle2.result: Referrals to the multidisciplinary team increased by 78%; wellbeing, physical symptoms and overall QoL ratings improved by 27%, 38% and 54%.

result.other_findings: Sustainability strategies include a champion group and education based on nurses' needs.

result.setting: UK anaesthetists and anaesthesia associates (NAP7 baseline survey)

cycle1.result: In-date adult ALS training 90% and paediatric 66%; 84% confident leading a perioperative arrest but 56% confident leading a debrief and 68% communicating with next of kin.

result.other_findings: Only 38% attended a debrief after the last arrest and formal wellbeing support was uncommon (11%).

result.setting: NHS anaesthetic departments (NAP7 organisational survey)

cycle1.result: Defibrillator in every theatre suite in 99% of departments; advanced airway equipment missing from all remote locations in 57%; departmental resuscitation lead in 58%.

result.other_findings: Annual chest compression updates in 76% and defibrillation in 67%; peer support programmes in only 29%.

result.setting: Outpatient psychiatric clinic
result.standard: Standardised depression screening (PHQ-9) at follow-up appointments; aim of 50% effective depression care

cycle1.result: None of the patients (0/56) received standardised depression screening at follow-up.

result.intervention: 8-week rapid-cycle PDSA project: PHQ-9 screening, an effective care log, chart audit every 3 days and fortnightly tests of change.

cycle2.result: Effective depression care rose to 74%; PHQ-9 completion 76% and effective care log completion 91%.

result.other_findings: Team engagement score also increased (27.1).

result.topic: Heart failure readmissions from home health care
result.setting: Home health agency
result.standard: Agency-wide evidence-based best practices for heart failure self-management

cycle1.result: 30-day hospital readmission rate 32%.

result.intervention: Supportive Heart Failure Care programme: agency-wide best practices, nursing education sessions and implementation of self-management practices.

cycle2.result: Readmission rate fell to 21%; nurses' knowledge increased 4.1% (N = 35).

result.other_findings: Chart audits showed varying levels of documented practice in line with best practices.

result.setting: Hospitals participating in the Hospital National Antimicrobial Prescribing Survey (Hospital NAPS)
result.standard: Guideline compliance and appropriateness assessed with the standardised Hospital NAPS auditing tool

cycle1.result: Metronidazole accounted for 5.7% (n = 14,197) of 250,863 antimicrobial prescriptions; guideline compliance and appropriateness were suboptimal (exact figures truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: The proportion of metronidazole prescriptions fell by 2% from 2013 to 2021; use with an unnecessarily broad spectrum was a key area for improvement.

result.setting: 352 UK hospital sites (NAP7 activity survey over 4 days)

cycle1.result: 1922 potentially serious complications in 1337 (6%) cases; in 20,996 non-obstetric cases, 1705 complications in 1150 (5%), mostly circulatory (36%) and airway (25%).

result.other_findings: Emergency surgery was 16% of non-obstetric cases but 42% of complications.

result.setting: Te Whatu Ora Counties Manukau accepted colonoscopy referrals

cycle1.result: 33.4% of 751 Māori patients were removed from the waiting list versus 24.1% of 4,047 NZ European patients (adjusted OR 1.68).

result.other_findings: Pasifika patients were also more likely to be removed from the list (adjusted OR 2.30).

result.setting: UK hospitals (NAP7 12-month registry)

cycle1.result: Incidence 3 in 10,000 anaesthetics; commonest causes major haemorrhage (17%), bradyarrhythmia (9%) and cardiac ischaemia (7%).

result.other_findings: Arrest was most prevalent in orthopaedic trauma (12%) and lower GI surgery (10%); patient factors were a key cause in 82%.

result.setting: UK hospitals (NAP7 12-month registry)

cycle1.result: 75% survived the initial event and 52% survived to discharge; overall care rated good in 464 (53%) and poor in 18 (2%), with poor care elements in a further 245 (28%).

result.other_findings: Care before arrest was most often rated poor (11%); survival was lowest after PEA (34%) and in non-elective patients (37%).

result.setting: Emergency department

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes a spreadsheet-based daily chart audit with feedback to physicians within 24 hours of discharge.

result.topic: HLA alleles in pulmonary alveolar proteinosis
result.setting: Department of Pathology, West China Hospital, Sichuan University

cycle1.result: HLA-DRB1*14:54 detected only in autoimmune PAP (19.4% vs 0.0%, p = 0.030).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Fluocinolone implant for diabetic macular oedema
result.setting: Five Portuguese public hospitals (Retina.pt registry)

cycle1.result: 222 eyes of 152 patients; visual and anatomical improvements after the implant (figures truncated in abstract).

result.other_findings: Some patients were undertreated or unresponsive to standard care before implantation.

result.setting: Laboratory study, City University of Hong Kong

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Animal study: hippocampal removal did not stop seizures in kainic acid mice.

result.topic: Antibacterial prophylaxis in paediatric stem cell transplantation
result.setting: Paediatric transplant centre, University Children's Hospital Münster
result.standard: International guidelines do not recommend antibacterial prophylaxis

cycle1.result: Overall survival to discharge 90.4%; fever 92.3%; bacterial infections 34.6%.

result.intervention: Routine antibacterial prophylaxis (penicillin, metronidazole, ciprofloxacin) stopped from 2015.

cycle2.result: Overall survival to discharge 96.1% (p = .06); fever 94.1%; bacterial infections 25.5%.

result.other_findings: Antibacterial days fell (39 vs 34; p = .002); resistant organism detection was low.

result.setting: Canadian paediatric tertiary care hospitals (national survey and policy review)

cycle1.result: Only 13/18 hospitals had paediatric-specific massive haemorrhage protocol content; trauma was the commonest activation indication (54%); all protocols used tranexamic acid and 8 sites used an audit tool.

result.other_findings: Plasma and platelets were usually not in the first container and there was little emphasis on balanced ratios; 12/13 used laboratory-guided transfusion.

result.setting: Tertiary oncology centre, Gujarat Cancer Research Institute, Ahmedabad

cycle1.result: 92 patients included; of 86 with biopsy-proven osteosarcoma, 52 had bone scan for initial staging and 34 for follow-up; 9 showed distant skeletal metastases (5 staging, 4 follow-up).

result.other_findings: Bone scan had optimal sensitivity but low specificity for skeletal metastases.

result.topic: Pregnancy outcomes in cystic fibrosis with diabetes
result.setting: Two tertiary obstetric hospitals in Southeast Queensland

cycle1.result: 38 pregnancies in 26 women: CF-related diabetes in 4 women (5 pregnancies) and gestational diabetes in 12 women (15 pregnancies).

result.other_findings: Diabetes was associated with more delivery complications, prematurity and NICU admission.

result.setting: Two adult acute care facilities, Atrium Health, Charlotte
result.standard: National Database of Nursing Quality Indicators mean fall rate

cycle1.dates: Same 9-month period in the previous year
cycle1.result: 744 total falls across both facilities.

result.intervention: Hester Davis Fall Program implemented through PDSA cycles led by clinical nurse specialists, with sustainability coaches and audit data dashboards to target risk assessment and interventions.

cycle2.result: 692 total falls; one facility had rates below the NDNQI mean.

result.other_findings: Estimated cost savings of $202 176 to $491 400.

result.setting: Seven medical wards, Waikato and Thames hospitals
result.standard: 10 audit standards from the regional antimicrobial prescribing policy and adult antimicrobial guidelines

cycle1.result: Microbiological sampling standard met in 87/126 (69.0%); guideline-adherent choice in 89/163 (54.6%); indication documented and 48-72 hour review over 90%; only 2/13 (15.4%) on piperacillin/tazobactam or carbapenem discussed with ID.

result.other_findings: Indications and durations on paper medication charts were documented in only about 12%; results were similar for Māori and non-Māori.

result.setting: Kaiser Permanente Washington primary care

cycle1.result: Test-retest reliability excellent for total scores (ICC 0.87) and the binary unhealthy alcohol use indicator (kappa 0.79).

result.other_findings: Reliability was highest when both screens were done online (ICC 0.93) and lower in American Indian/Alaska Native and multiracial patients (ICC 0.82).

result.topic: Quality measures for long-term care medical providers
result.setting: Seven North American long-term care homes

cycle1.result: 343 resident charts from 49 providers reviewed on 33 quality measures; data sufficient for 26; 10 measures were feasible with good test performance.

result.other_findings: 95 candidate measures were rated in a RAND-modified Delphi process.

result.setting: Paediatric antimicrobial stewardship programmes in 24 US hospitals (focus groups)

cycle1.result: 18 physicians and 14 pharmacists described advantages and limitations of prospective audit and feedback and preauthorisation.

result.other_findings: Prospective audit and feedback built relationships but was time-consuming; preauthorisation reduced broad-spectrum use but offered little education.

result.topic: CT number calibration for radiotherapy planning
result.setting: 24 Japanese photon radiotherapy institutes (postal phantom audit)
result.standard: Theoretical stoichiometric CT number calibration curves

cycle1.result: Mean ± SD density difference for Gammex phantom curves -1.1 ± 1.2 (lung), -0.3 ± 0.9 (soft tissue), -0.9 ± 1.3 (bone); Tomotherapy TPS soft tissue difference 2.1 ± 1.4, larger than other systems.

result.other_findings: The Gammex brain plug (BRN-SR2) showed slightly inferior tissue equivalence.

result.setting: General Surgery trainee logbooks, national

cycle1.result: Overall operative numbers fell significantly, by 2.0% in 2020 (IRR 0.980).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Single tertiary care academic endoscopy unit (Kansas City Veterans Affairs Medical Center)

cycle1.result: Total waste 1398.6 kg (61.6% landfill, 33.3% biohazard, 5.1% sharps), 3.03 kg per procedure; 20% of waste potentially recyclable.

result.other_findings: Carbon footprint 1501 kg CO2 equivalent per 100 procedures; reprocessing generated 13.85 gallons of liquid waste per procedure.

result.topic: Antibiotic use in transient tachypnoea of the newborn
result.setting: Neonatal unit, NewYork Presbyterian-Weill Cornell Medicine
result.standard: Aim to reduce ampicillin and gentamicin days of therapy by 10% within 12 months in low-risk infants with TTN

cycle1.result: 71% of infants with suspected TTN started on antibiotics.

result.intervention: Evidence-based clinical pathway, admission huddles, and prescriber audit and feedback (Model for Improvement).

cycle2.result: Starting antibiotics fell sequentially from 71% to 41%, 13% and 0%; ampicillin use fell 26% and gentamicin 23%.

result.other_findings: No cases of missed bacteraemia.

result.setting: Breast imaging service (University of Utah and Stanford authors)
result.standard: Overall mammogram quality passing criteria; QI goal of 90% (EQUIP era)

cycle1.result: 74% (1098/1489) of audited mammograms met overall passing criteria.

result.intervention: Long-term technologist coaching programme started September 2015, after an earlier QI initiative.

cycle2.result: 90% (8902/9929) of audited mammograms met overall passing criteria.

result.other_findings: Post-improvement period (February to August 2015) pass rate was 93% (501/541); both later periods were significantly higher than the improvement period.

result.topic: Pharmacist-led antimicrobial prospective audit and feedback
result.setting: Single public hospital (Ogaki Municipal Hospital)

cycle1.result: MRSA among inpatient Staphylococcus aureus 50.9%.

result.intervention: Weekday pharmacist-led prospective audit and feedback for hospitalised patients, evaluated annually over 8 years.
result.other_findings: The proportion of antimicrobial courses over 10 days decreased significantly between 2014 and 2021.

result.topic: Coagulation factor dosing for haemophilia in the emergency department
result.setting: Tertiary children's emergency department, Nationwide Children's Hospital
result.standard: In-range factor dose of 90%-120% of goal (50% correction for minor and 100% for major bleeds); aim to increase appropriate treatment from 65% to 85%

cycle1.result: Mean 71.1% of encounters received optimal factor dosing; 33.3% of encounters had out-of-range dosing in the earlier publication.

result.intervention: PDSA cycles: communication via the EMR problem list and physician education.

cycle2.result: Mean optimal dosing 82.2% (not statistically significant); cumulative out-of-range dosing fell to 18%.

result.other_findings: Out-of-range dosing still occurs; simulation education for ED staff is planned.

result.setting: Rehabilitation department, Nanfang Hospital, Southern Medical University, Guangzhou
result.standard: Standardised tracheostomy tube change bundle and documentation

cycle1.result: Aspiration pneumonia incidence 43.8%; staff knowledge score 46.57 ± 11.10.

result.intervention: Tracheostomy tube change bundle (timing, assessment, personnel, location, preparation, maintenance), a tube change workflow and staff training.

cycle2.result: Pneumonia fell to 27.8% (p = .013); knowledge score 88.14 ± 6.76; audit implementation rate 67.32%-100%.

result.other_findings: 88 tube change episodes (23 before, 65 after); 35 staff completed training.

result.setting: In situ simulations across settings at Montefiore Medical Center

cycle1.result: 20 simulations identified 12 human errors and 15 latent safety threats; only 50.0% of teams replaced the tube within five minutes; median pre-simulation quiz score 46%.

result.other_findings: Latent safety threats involved communication, equipment and infection control.

result.topic: Mechanical VTE prophylaxis compliance in trauma
result.setting: Trauma units, Charleston Area Medical Center
result.standard: Consistent sequential compression device use as mechanical VTE prophylaxis in adult trauma patients

cycle1.result: Initial direct observation audit: SCD compliance 12%; perioperative VTE rate 10.60 per 1,000.

result.intervention: Nurse-led strategy engaging multidisciplinary team members to improve consistent SCD use.

cycle2.result: Average SCD compliance 65%; perioperative VTE rate 4.95 per 1,000.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Dutch branch of the European Pediatric Surgical Audit; two national CDH expert centres

cycle1.result: National prevalence 2.06 per 10 000 live births; population, treatment and 1-year outcomes comparable between the two centres except length of stay.

result.other_findings: Treating hospital was the strongest predictor of length of stay.

result.setting: Department of Transfusion Medicine, Kasturba Medical College, Manipal

cycle1.result: 442 components returned (0.4% of issued) in 218 instances; returned within 30 minutes in only 27% (59/218); 44.5% (97/218) preventable by clinical assessment.

result.other_findings: Wards (39.4%) and HDU/ICU (31.6%) had most instances; 77.9% were for routine requests.

result.setting: Eight paediatric urology centres
result.standard: ERAS protocol for complex lower urinary tract reconstruction; pilot-phase adherence outcomes
