result.standard: Unit Antibiotic Guidelines to reduce treatment of culture-negative sepsis

cycle1.result: Early-onset sepsis antibiotic DOTs 18.3/1000 patient days; overall unit DOTs 232.5/1000 patient days.

result.intervention: Antibiotic guidelines, case audits, weekly antibiotic stewardship rounds and biweekly review of culture-negative sepsis cases at staff meetings (sequential PDSA cycles).

cycle2.result: Antibiotic DOTs for culture-negative sepsis fell 81%; early-onset sepsis DOTs 3.9/1000 patient days; overall unit DOTs 176.7/1000 patient days.

result.other_findings: No change in balancing measures (initiation, re-initiation events, antibiotic spectrum index).

result.setting: Tertiary neonatal unit, Cork University Maternity Hospital
result.standard: Down Syndrome Medical Interest Group (DSMIG) Neonatal Best Practice Guideline

cycle1.result: ECHO performed in 66 (90%); all screened for haematological and thyroid abnormalities; growth parameters documented in 8 (11%); audiology referral 60 (82.2%), ophthalmology 17 (23.3%).

result.other_findings: 13 (18%) babies had unnecessary thyroid function bloods; adherence was good for cardiovascular and haematological monitoring but needed improvement elsewhere.

result.setting: Dosimetry audit analysis using in-house VIGO software

cycle1.result: Choice of calibrated size and shape of the region of interest introduced the most variability in gamma index results.

result.other_findings: Methodological sensitivity analysis, not a clinical audit.

result.setting: Emergency department, Sunshine Hospital, Melbourne
result.standard: American Academy of Pediatrics 2021 febrile infant guideline (22-28 days) and Australian guidelines recommending LP and empiric antibiotics in all febrile neonates

cycle1.result: 31% had no LP and 18% were observed without antibiotics (48% and 27% with normal inflammatory markers); 51% would have been eligible for observation without LP or antibiotics under the AAP algorithm.

result.other_findings: Two bacteraemia cases, both with abnormal inflammatory markers; 77% observed for 48 h.

result.setting: Midwest Federally Qualified Health Center
result.standard: Uniform Data System cervical cancer screening measure; target 79.2% by July 2024

cycle1.result: Cervical cancer screening 46.3%; outside-facility results accounted for 27% of underperformance.

result.intervention: Chart auditing and reconciliation from Epic reports with tip sheets, modifying or discontinuing Pap smears, updating hysterectomy history, and scheduling outreach messages.

cycle2.result: 2023 quarterly screening rates rose by 9% or more each quarter and 8.7% year-to-date; 2024 quarters 1 and 2 rose by 4% and 3%; target not reached.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Viral load result return in adolescents with HIV
result.setting: Six HIV care facilities in Kiambu and Nakuru Counties

cycle1.result: 86% (179) of charts matched the national database; 7% (14) of results missing from clinic EMR; 8% (17) incongruent.

result.other_findings: Only 52% of 132 surveyed adolescents reported receiving their last viral load result.

result.setting: Stroke-certified neurological intermediate care unit
result.standard: Dysphagia screening with a validated tool (Yale Swallow Protocol) within 24 hours of admission

cycle1.result: Aspiration incidence 42.5% among acute stroke patients; existing screening tool not validated.

result.intervention: Yale Swallow Protocol added to the nurses' admission bundle with SLP referral on failure, plus nurse education and weekly audits.

cycle2.result: 37 of 63 (59%) screened within 24 h of admission; 3 of 37 screened had aspiration pneumonia.

result.other_findings: Overall compliance with using the tool was 59%.

result.topic: Regional anaesthesia for major limb amputation
result.setting: Vascular Surgery department, large academic institution (University of Maryland Medical Center)
result.standard: Evidence-based regional anaesthesia for all eligible major limb amputation patients

cycle1.result: Average 2,352.2 total MME per admission; mean length of stay 21 days.

result.intervention: Formalised pain pathway: pain score at consent with pain team referral for regional anaesthesia if score 4 or higher, and an embedded checklist in the daily progress note.

cycle2.result: Checklist compliance 64%; 57% of those with pain score 4 or higher received regional anaesthesia; average 842.5 MME (about 65% reduction); length of stay 28.4 days.

result.other_findings: Pain scores improved on day one (4.7 to 3.2) but rose to 5 by discharge.

result.setting: Neuroscience ICU, large academic medical centre (NYU Langone Health)
result.standard: Unit-based practice standard (sedation targeting RASS -1 or lower, soft wrist restraints, continuous observation)

cycle1.result: 9 unplanned extubations (0.93/100 ventilator days).

result.intervention: Multidisciplinary unit-based practice standard on communication, escalation, sedation/analgesia targeting RASS -1 or lower, soft wrist restraints and continuous observation.

cycle2.result: 6 unplanned extubations (0.22/100 ventilator days); all 6 had RASS goal -1 or lower and restraints.

result.other_findings: Before the initiative, 4 of 9 patients had no sedation order or a RASS goal of 0 and none were in restraints.

result.setting: Second national morbidity survey and practice activity analysis study

cycle1.result: 'Persons consulting' and 'total consultations' correlated at 0.99 in the practice activity analysis study; 'persons consulting' and 'list size' r > 0.9.

result.other_findings: Methodological study supporting consultations over two weeks as an audit denominator.

result.setting: Dutch Lung Cancer Audit for Surgery registry

cycle1.result: Uniportal VATS use rose from 13% (2017) to 21% (2021); 429 resections in 2021 with median stay 4 days and complication rate 27%.

result.other_findings: Hospitals using the technique rose from 30% to 41%, plateauing in 2020-2021.

result.topic: Perioperative education for day-case anorectal surgery
result.setting: Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Evidence-based perioperative health education programme for patients, following the JBI model.

cycle2.result: Significant improvement in execution rates of audit indicators 1, 2, 5, 6, 8 and 10 to 17 (figures not reported).

result.other_findings: Patient knowledge, satisfaction and complications were also compared.

result.setting: La Maternidad Renee Klang Viuda Guzman Hospital, Santiago
result.standard: Eight evidence-based criteria for postpartum haemorrhage management

cycle1.result: 25% compliance with evidence-based criteria; gaps in maternal risk assessment, provider training and protocol use.

result.intervention: PPH toolkit, protocol and simulation-based training.
result.other_findings: 12 of 13 toolkit users (92%) felt it improved timely management; 59 healthcare workers surveyed.

result.setting: Single tertiary hospital (St Louis University)

cycle1.result: 18 operations audited for waste (lower extremity bypass highest at 85.75 kg CO2e, carotid endarterectomy lowest at 57.22 kg) and 97 for fluoroscopy energy (EVAR highest at 41.11 kg, TCAR lowest at 7.33 kg).

result.other_findings: Vascular operations averaged 108.47 kg CO2e from waste and fluoroscopy; fluoroscopy time correlated with CO2e (r2 = 0.76).

result.setting: Urban outpatient surgery centre, Kirkland, Washington
result.standard: Clinical practice recommendations for safe thermoregulation; target 80% over 8 weeks

cycle1.result: Safe thermoregulation 62%.

result.intervention: PreOp and PACU warming bundle introduced through biweekly PDSA tests of change.
result.other_findings: The warming bundle was the most effective intervention and reduced staff-perceived workload.

result.setting: Kaiser Permanente Washington primary care

cycle1.result: AUDIT-C scores were positively associated with HDL cholesterol across subgroups.

result.other_findings: 'AUDIT-C' is an alcohol screening questionnaire, not a clinical audit; most characteristics modified the association.

result.topic: Genetic testing in early-onset breast cancer
result.setting: Breast Care Centre of Excellence, private accredited specialist breast unit, Johannesburg

cycle1.result: Only 5 of 196 women diagnosed with breast cancer at 35 years or younger received BRCA1/2 genetic testing.

result.other_findings: Authors call for better availability and funding of genetic services.

result.setting: Tertiary colonoscopy service, Northern Health, Melbourne

cycle1.result: NLP code had 98.9% accuracy for ADR and SDR in training, improving to 100% after modification; 99.9% in a validation cohort of 2022 colonoscopies.

result.other_findings: Auditing with NLP in the validation phase took less than 1 hour.

result.setting: Emergency department, University of Massachusetts Chan Medical School

cycle1.result: Overutilisation rates 46%-47% of CT C-spine studies in low-risk patients.

result.intervention: Randomised trial of digital, hybrid face-to-face/digital or no audit-and-feedback (three rounds).
result.other_findings: Randomised controlled trial of 78 clinicians rather than a clinical audit.

result.topic: Diabetic ketoacidosis at type 1 diabetes diagnosis
result.setting: Townsville University Hospital, regional hospital

cycle1.result: 78 (53.4%) presented with DKA; family history of T1DM was protective (OR 0.35).

result.other_findings: No relationship with presence or titre of pancreatic autoantibodies.

result.setting: Choithram Hospital & Research Centre, Indore

cycle1.result: Neonatal hypoglycaemic brain injury was the leading cause (35.71%), then HIE (25%).

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: One VA hospital in North Carolina (Durham VA Healthcare System)

cycle1.result: Of 122 current or former smokers, only 71 (58%) had a current screen; 66 offered behavioural interventions but only 2 referred to cessation clinic; 68 offered pharmacotherapy and 8 prescribed.

result.other_findings: Women and minoritised veterans were less likely to be assessed and offered cessation strategies.

result.setting: Inpatient palliative care, Austin Health

cycle1.result: Most common indication was agitation; common loading dose 200 mg and starting CSCI 800 mg/24 hours; 22 patients comfortable at death.

result.other_findings: Inconsistent dosing and concurrent sedative use suggest a need for standardised protocols.

result.setting: Urban teaching general practice

cycle1.result: 89% managed entirely in the practice; 15% investigated; 17 (11%) referred; only 3 true surgical emergencies.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: General practice with a policy of opportunistic blood pressure screening
result.standard: Blood pressure screening within the last five years for patients born 1930-44

cycle1.result: 80% had been screened in the last five years.

result.intervention: Patients not screened were identified and contacted.
result.other_findings: Only four possible new hypertensives were identified; authors felt the extra effort was not worthwhile.

result.setting: Substance use in pregnancy and parenting service, Illawarra Shoalhaven Local Health District

cycle1.result: Cannabis history documented in 34% of 232 ED presentations and 53% of 183 admissions; substance use screening in 45% and 53%; referral to SUPPS in 7% of admissions and none from ED.

result.other_findings: Withdrawal symptoms documented in 3% of ED presentations and 13% of admissions.

result.setting: University hospital multidisciplinary team (Pathology Queensland, Sunshine Coast)
result.standard: Australian structured pathology reporting guidelines for non-melanoma skin cancer (2023)

cycle1.result: Macroscopic criteria reported in 95%-100%; most microscopic criteria 94%-100%; lymphovascular invasion 80%, depth of invasion 33%, satellitosis/in-transit metastasis 0%.

result.other_findings: 156 cSCC cases were referred to MDT, 87 met inclusion criteria; authors suggest structured reports may improve completeness.

result.topic: Diabetes prevention programme completion after gestational diabetes
result.setting: State-funded Life! programme, Victoria

cycle1.result: 55% completed the programme; lower completion in regional areas, overweight or obesity, low or high income and South or Central Asian background.

result.other_findings: Enrolment after 2019 was associated with higher completion (AOR 2.3).

result.setting: Two 26-bed adult acute care units, large community hospital

cycle1.result: Average of 19.44 alarms/patient/hour.

result.intervention: Evidence-based alarm bundle (daily electrode changes, parameter customisation and documentation, use of standby) with weekly audits.

cycle2.result: Adherence: daily electrode change 80% (n=118), EMR documentation 75% (n=110), shift parameter documentation 75% (n=194), customised parameter documentation 86% (n=117), standby use 75% (n=166).

result.other_findings: Lead V sticker placement errors occurred at 34%; nurse-driven heart rate customisation 17%. Post-intervention alarm rate not given in abstract.

result.setting: 83 children's hospitals in the Solutions for Patient Safety collaborative (neonatal, paediatric and cardiac ICUs)

cycle1.result: 0.662 unplanned extubations per 100 ventilator days.

result.intervention: Spread of the UE bundle using workgroups for peer discussion and sharing of resources, tools and ideas.

cycle2.result: 0.53 unplanned extubations per 100 ventilator days (19.9% reduction); 53 hospitals (74%) had significant rate reductions or increased bundle reliability.

result.other_findings: Barriers to bundle implementation and auditing were addressed in workgroups.

result.setting: NSIA-LUTH Cancer Center, Lagos University Teaching Hospital

cycle1.result: Group A mean HR-CTV D90 77.48 ± 6.95 Gy.

result.other_findings: Group B (next 12 patients over 5 months) had mean HR-CTV D90 88.93 ± 4.20 Gy, a significant improvement attributed to team proficiency.

result.setting: Nine maternity hospitals in Kyrgyzstan and ten in Tajikistan
result.standard: WHO neonatal care quality assessment tool (scores 0 to 3)

cycle1.result: Neonatal care quality suboptimal (scores 1.0-1.9) in all areas.

result.intervention: Two-year QI project: QI teams, action plans, provider capacity building, supportive supervision and policy changes, with semi-annual collaborative meetings.

cycle2.result: Improvements in routine care (+0.4 Kyrgyzstan, +0.5 Tajikistan), sick newborn care (+0.6 both), accessibility (+0.5, +0.8) and monitoring/follow-up (+0.3, +0.9).

result.other_findings: Hospital support services remained below good practice standards.

result.setting: Adult primary care patients

cycle1.result: AUDIT-C AUC about 0.90 vs TAPS 0.81-0.84 for problem use and alcohol use disorder.

result.other_findings: 'AUDIT-C' is an alcohol screening questionnaire; this is a diagnostic accuracy study.

result.setting: General practice population of 57 000

cycle1.result: 26 received L-dopa and 10 an anticholinergic; three quarters of Sinemet patients received less than 75 mg carbidopa per day; average L-dopa 468 mg per day.

result.other_findings: GP made the diagnosis in 20 of 32 cases and controlled therapy in 15; 25 were referred for specialist advice.

result.setting: Department of Surgery, Lagos University Teaching Hospital

cycle1.result: Appropriate prescribing in 323/655 (49%); reason documented in 522 (80%); stop/review dates in 77 (15%) of treatment prescriptions.

result.intervention: Recommendations based on guidelines fed back to prescribers through the head of the antimicrobial stewardship committee.
result.other_findings: Inappropriateness included wrong antibiotic choice, prolonged use and too many antibiotics.

result.setting: Western Health (hospital-wide)
result.standard: Clinical care standards and expected benchmark for PIVC-related bloodstream infection per 10,000 occupied bed days

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Hospital-wide taskforce evidence-based practice strategies aligned with clinical care standards (details not reported).

cycle2.result: PIVC-related bloodstream infection rate fell below the expected benchmark; 7 of 12 months (58.3%) had no infections.

result.other_findings: Governance transparency and leadership support were important.

result.setting: 18 general and community hospitals in the SIP trial

cycle1.result: Pathway implementation fidelity 94%; audit and feedback was the least used strategy; implementation time about 14 hours per month.

result.other_findings: Barriers were time limitations and resistance to change.

result.setting: 14 antibiotic referral centres advising general practitioners
result.standard: Existing guidelines for urinary tract and respiratory infections, scored out of 5 by three senior infectious disease specialists

cycle1.result: Mean score 2.7 ± 1.9 out of 5; seniors scored 2.9 vs residents 2.0 (p = 0.019).

result.other_findings: 106 of 112 requested recommendations were obtained (95%).

result.setting: Tertiary care centre, Seth GSMC and KEMH, Mumbai

cycle1.result: 22 emergency obstetric hysterectomies; abnormal placentation most common indication; bladder injury most common complication; 2 deaths.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Cleveland Clinic
result.standard: Guideline recommendations for pre-resection photodocumentation relative to an open snare or forceps and post-resection photodocumentation of a clear base

cycle1.result: High-quality pre-resection images 49% to 82% and post-resection 51% to 70% by reviewer; only 1% of pre-resection images showed an open snare or forceps.

result.other_findings: Only 74% to 89% of polyps were estimated as 10 mm or more (kappa 0.66); a prior report found pre- and post-resection photodocumentation in 82% and 52% of 1693 polyps.

result.topic: Preventable deaths after emergency general surgery
result.setting: Australian and New Zealand Audit of Surgical Mortality

cycle1.result: 875 deaths (18.5%) potentially preventable and 3,848 (81.5%) not preventable; postoperative complications 57.0% vs 37.0%.

result.other_findings: Most clinical management issues in preventable deaths occurred preoperatively, across 14 areas of care.

result.setting: Multiple hospitals, Hartford HealthCare, Connecticut
result.standard: CDC Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship (appropriate total days of therapy)

cycle1.result: Appropriate total DOT 59.5% without vs 66.3% with transitions of care pharmacist intervention (P = 0.337); discharge DOT 3.8 vs 3.4 days.

result.intervention: Prospective audit and feedback by transitions of care pharmacists at discharge.
result.other_findings: When interventions were accepted (62) vs rejected (18), appropriate total DOT was 82.3% vs 11.1%.

result.setting: Level 1 paediatric trauma centre emergency department (Riley Hospital for Children)
result.standard: Paediatric guidelines reserving cervical spine CT for GCS less than 14; aim 15% reduction in 8 months

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Cervical spine clearance pathway, clinical decision support, education, and provider audit and feedback.

cycle2.result: Cervical spine CT rate in trauma activations with GCS 14 or more fell by 20%.

result.other_findings: No missed injuries and no change in ED length of stay; annual savings of $33 600.

result.setting: Level IV neonatal intensive care unit, Children's Memorial Hermann Hospital, Houston
result.standard: Gold standard two-person length board measurement; discrepancy of 1 cm or less between nurse and audit measurements

cycle1.result: Desired minimal difference in 38%.

result.intervention: Nursing interventions over two PDSA cycles, including more length boards and education.

cycle2.result: Desired minimal difference 74% after PDSA 2 (p = 0.003) and 71% in sustainability cycle (p = 0.007).

result.other_findings: Consistent length percentiles improved from 42% to 74%; perceived ease of length board use rose from 51% to 71%.

result.setting: New Zealand urologists receiving PCOR-ANZ reports

cycle1.result: 76% (25) found reports valuable for auditing and 70% (23) for improving practice; 42% (14) found them too lengthy.

result.other_findings: Survey and interview study of 33 of 49 eligible urologists.

result.setting: Assistance Publique-Hôpitaux de Paris university hospitals
result.standard: Clinical guidelines for diagnostic workup of suspected child physical abuse (skeletal survey, eye fundus examination, head CT or MRI)

cycle1.result: At least one key diagnostic test not performed in 14 (14%); bone metabolism investigation in 33% of 43 with unexplained fractures; haemostasis tests in 82% of 76 with bruises or bleeding.

result.other_findings: 8% of children died; 60% had intracranial injuries.

result.setting: Australian diagnostic imaging clinics listed by Services Australia

cycle1.result: Most clinics owned by for-profit corporations (public limited 33.6%, investor-backed 22.6%); high ownership concentration in four jurisdictions.

result.other_findings: Four companies own 50% or more of Medicare-rebatable MRI clinics.

result.topic: SGLT-2 inhibitor prescribing in chronic kidney disease
result.setting: Local nephrology outpatient clinic, south-eastern United States
result.standard: Clinical practice guideline recommending SGLT-2 inhibitors in adults with type 2 diabetes and CKD

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Audit and feedback delivered to providers every 3 weeks with a clinical decision guide and structured interviews.

cycle2.result: Significant increase in SGLT-2 inhibitor prescribing (figures not reported).

result.other_findings: Providers reported barriers to prescribing.

result.setting: Tertiary hospital laboratory, National Health Laboratory Service, Stellenbosch University, Cape Town
result.standard: Acceptable quantity not sufficient (QNS) rate for sweat tests

cycle1.result: QNS rate 30% for sweat chloride and 12% for sweat conductivity.

result.intervention: Technologist training, clinician education, patient preparation protocols and revised testing procedures.

cycle2.result: QNS rate 25% for sweat chloride; 12% unchanged for sweat conductivity.

result.other_findings: Over 2 years 425 tests on 291 patients; QNS rates were higher in young infants and malnourished or acutely ill patients.

result.setting: Radiotherapy units, King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre and King Abdulaziz University Hospital, Jeddah

cycle1.result: Planning delays in 42 (8.3%) of 503 cases.

result.intervention: Automated customised electronic quality checklists in MOSAIQ assigned to radiotherapy staff.

cycle2.result: Planning delays in 25 (4.2%) of 590 cases; errors from verification checks reduced by 50%.

result.other_findings: More than 50% of errors were detected at radiotherapy chart checks.

result.topic: Cervical screening in women with HIV
result.setting: Alfred Hospital, tertiary HIV care centre, Melbourne
result.standard: National cervical screening guidelines: three-yearly screening for women with HIV

cycle1.dates: Women in care up until January 2023
cycle1.result: 57/115 (49.6%) up to date with screening; 58 (50.4%) overdue, of whom 52 (89.7%) more than 6 months and 45 (76.3%) more than 12 months overdue.

result.other_findings: 156 women with HIV identified, 115 analysed. Among those overdue, 7 (12.1%) had an abnormal last result.

result.topic: Quality indicators for pharmacist diabetes care
result.setting: Belgian community pharmacy; multidisciplinary Delphi panel

cycle1.result: Delphi study: 82 recommendations assessed, 24 high-potential recommendations merged into 14 quality indicators; 3 extractable from pharmacy records.

result.other_findings: Extractable indicators related to influenza and pneumococcal vaccine delivery and dispensing of glucose-influencing and sugar-containing medication.

result.topic: Medication safety with high-alert and nephrotoxic drugs
result.setting: Single-centre urban academic children's hospital; 1 acute care and 3 intensive care units, New York
result.standard: Aim to increase days between medication safety events by 5% over 28 months; high-alert and nephrotoxic medication bundles

cycle1.result: not reported

result.intervention: Targeted medication list, rounding script modifications, provider education, review of medication orders and rounding audits.

cycle2.result: Days between high-alert medication events increased by 10 days with a centreline shift; no shift for nephrotoxic medications. Mean bundle compliance 90% (monthly range 67%-100%) high-alert and 76% (25%-100%) nephrotoxic.

result.other_findings: Process compliance varied but was unchanged overall; electronic health record changes proposed next.

result.topic: Early palliative care referral in advanced cancer
result.setting: Two centres: academic institution and standalone cancer centre, India
result.standard: Guideline recommendation for early palliative care integration in advanced cancer; timely referral

cycle1.result: Timely palliative care referral 37% at Centre A and 30% at Centre B.

result.intervention: A3 methodology: raising oncologists' awareness, holistic symptom assessment and an established referral process.

cycle2.result: Timely palliative care referral rose to 66% at Centre A and 60% at Centre B.

result.other_findings: Advanced gastric, colorectal and lung cancers included.

result.setting: A.C. Camargo Cancer Center, São Paulo, paediatric leukaemia

cycle1.result: 329 febrile neutropenia episodes in 84 patients; inappropriate empirical antibiotic treatment 40%: inadequate Gram-positive cover 2%, failure to de-escalate 78%, maintenance of antibiotics despite negative cultures 62%.

result.other_findings: Bloodstream infection in 77% of episodes; age over 13 years (p 0.003) and bloodstream infection (p 0.002) were risk factors for mortality.

result.setting: University of Rochester Medical Center, with ACR Learning Network
result.standard: PI-QUAL v1: exams scoring 4 or more and at least one DWI sequence rated optimal

cycle1.result: PI-QUAL score 4 or more in 90% (95% CI 87-94%); DWI criteria met in 77% (95% CI 74-79%).

result.intervention: Standardised pre-MRI patient instructions and documentation on nil by mouth and bladder emptying, technologist image quality education and weekly PI-QUAL scoring embedded in the reporting system (May-September 2023).

cycle2.result: PI-QUAL score 4 or more in 97% (95% CI 95-99%); DWI criteria met in 83% (95% CI 78-88%).

result.other_findings: 1206 MRI prostate exams audited overall; improvement achieved without enema.

result.setting: Four radiotherapy centres in India

cycle1.result: Measured versus computed dose deviations within ±3% for all measurements in each hospital.

result.other_findings: Phantom development study; phantom mimicked female pelvis radiological properties.

result.topic: Early warning score and rapid response activation
result.setting: Wellington Regional Hospital, general medicine and surgery admissions
result.standard: NZEWS calculation and mandated medical emergency team (MET) activation criteria

cycle1.dates: January 2022 to August 2022 (medicine) and to February 2023 (surgery)
cycle1.result: NZEWS correctly calculated and documented in 75.8%; 46.8% of 47 NZEWS instances mandating MET activation resulted in a callout; only 12.8% had documented, accurately calculated NZEWS.

result.other_findings: 491 admissions screened; 20 of 23 patients meeting MET criteria had a callout. Mean nurse minus audit NZEWS difference -0.19 (limits of agreement -3.64 to 3.26).

result.setting: Paediatric emergency department, Yale
result.standard: Aim: 10% increase in RVU per encounter over 2 years; 20% reduction in LOS 99282 billing; 90% of admitted patients billed at LOS 99285

cycle1.result: LOS 99285 billing 9% overall and 50% among admitted patients.

result.intervention: PDSA cycles: billing dot phrase, revised note templates, billing reference sheets and a level of service calculator.

cycle2.result: RVU per encounter up 11%; LOS 99282 billing down 25%; LOS 99285 billing 13% overall and 70% among admitted patients.

result.other_findings: Billing discordance remained at 28%; provider satisfaction rose from 6% to 49% and documentation time stable at 6.6 min.

result.topic: Acute stroke care quality in aphasia
result.setting: Australian acute hospitals, Stroke Foundation National Stroke Audit (2017, 2019, 2021)
result.standard: Quality of care indicators aligned with national evidence-based stroke guidelines

cycle1.result: Patients with aphasia less often assessed for mood (23% vs 30%), given risk factor education (59% vs 70%) or involved in care planning (83% vs 95%).

result.other_findings: 3122 (26.9%) had aphasia; they had more complications (aOR 1.46) and in-hospital deaths (aOR 2.86).

result.setting: NSW Collaborating Hospitals' Audit of Surgical Mortality database

cycle1.result: 1103 aspiration pneumonia-related deaths, 5.2% of 21 038 surgical deaths; main factor in 53.5% and contributory in 46.5%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency testing in COPD
result.setting: Onvida Health primary care
result.standard: Evidence-based standard of care: AATD testing in adults with COPD; target 75% in eight weeks

cycle1.result: 2.0% of patients with COPD tested for AATD.

result.intervention: Four PDSA cycles over eight weeks: shared decision-making checklist and standard of care log.
result.other_findings: No AATD diagnoses; 19.7% (12 of 61) identified as carriers.

result.topic: CT KUB scan length and radiation dose
result.setting: Radiology department, Regional Hospital Heilig Hart Tienen
result.standard: Departmental standard operating procedure: scan from T10 vertebra endplate to inferior margin of pubic symphysis

cycle1.result: Internal audit identified variability in CT KUB doses and over-scanning.

result.intervention: Phase 1: new SOP with osseous anatomical landmarks; phase 2: SOP amended to use a sagittal scout view to identify the T10 endplate.

cycle2.result: Phase 1 reduced scan length by 14% and DLP by 32%; phase 2 reduced scan length by a further 7%; overall scan length down 20% and DLP down 55%.

result.other_findings: 247 CT KUB scans analysed in total.

result.setting: Universities of Oviedo and Bern

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Describes an open-source Python library for evaluating MRI brain tumour segmentation models; not a clinical audit.

result.setting: 5 VA Sierra Pacific Network (VISN 21) sites

cycle1.result: Direct-to-consumer education mailed to 1260 veterans; no significant difference versus propensity-matched comparator in pharmacotherapy initiation or specialist consultation (P > .59).

result.intervention: Direct-to-consumer education materials mailed about 2 weeks before appointments.
result.other_findings: Comparator group drawn from the previous year.

result.setting: Mid-Atlantic maternity unit with Level III NICU
result.standard: Use of an interprofessional communication tool before non-emergent caesareans

cycle1.result: Tool compliance averaged 62%, peaking at 77% during active education and declining to 33% after implementation.

result.intervention: Four PDSA cycles: adapted communication tool and addition of individual nurse NTSV caesarean rates to audit and feedback.
result.other_findings: Individual nurse NTSV caesarean rates varied widely (0.00%-45.45%) among nurses managing 10 or more births.

result.topic: Alcohol screening score change and mental health care use
result.setting: Northwest US health system primary care

cycle1.result: Mental health acute care utilisation risk 0.9% after first and 0.8% after second AUDIT-C screen; decreases in AUDIT-C category linked to lower risk.

result.other_findings: Retrospective cohort study, not an audit.

result.setting: Group-based peer review of general practitioners in 23 groups

cycle1.result: 253 general practitioners took part (about 30% of area GPs; 72% of those approached).

result.other_findings: Threat posed by audit disappeared rapidly once physicians started; expert-defined criteria were feasible.

result.setting: General practices; prescription data from the UK Prescription Pricing Authority

cycle1.result: Self-audit did not appear to influence prescribing; group 1 reductions attributed to shortfall of prescription forms, no differences in group 2.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Australian general practice with computerised records
result.standard: Audit objectives: case finding against community prevalence, classification, investigation, seizure freedom in 12 months, monotherapy

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Concluded that even a sophisticated record system is inefficient for chronic disease monitoring; a practice register and protocol are needed.

result.setting: Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist, inpatient units
result.standard: Evidence-based Opioid Withdrawal Screening Pathway using COWS

cycle1.result: Baseline screening of illicit drug use was low.

result.intervention: 2-week education programme for nurses and providers, then 12-week screening pathway with COWS assessments and chart audits.

cycle2.result: Screening rates increased significantly; discharge against medical advice and length of stay significantly reduced (figures not stated in abstract).
